3099.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3099.description: Jethalal narrates the situation to Mehta Sahab who advises him to tell Iyer and Babita the truth about their order. Jethalal arrives at Babitaji's house and tells the truth. Babita is shocked to know that Jethalal couldn't arrange for her order.

3100.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3100.description: Jethalal gets extremely upset as Babitaji gets angry at him and ignores him. Jethalal thinks of going to the client's office, and say that he is corona positive but Mehta tells him that this plan will have severe consequences. Jethalal and Mehta are planning to do something in a way that the client gets caught.

3101.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3101.description: Jethalal and Mehta Sahab decide a plot where Bhide and Sodhi will become clients of Bhogilal's hotel so that they can catch him and ask for Jethalal's payment. Later, Jethalal calls Bhide and Sodhi to his shop and explains everything.

3102.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3102.description: Bhide and Sodhi prepare their plan to visit Bhogilal's place. Sodhi calls his friends as their bodyguard for protection. Later, Jethalal also receives a call from Iyer asking for his delivery. Will Jethalal deliver the order in time?

3103.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3103.description: Bhide and Sodhi get ready and meet Sodhi's friends, who will go as their bodyguards. They meet with Jethalal to discuss their plan again. Soon, everyone leaves to visit Bhogilal's office to get Jethalal's money back.

3104.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3104.description: Sodhi and Bhide arrive at Bhogilal's office and act as clients to set up the trap. Finally, Jethalal comes and they all threaten Bhogilal to give them the money. However, Bhogilal informs them he is in a poor financial situation due to which he won't be able to give the money.

3105.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3105.description: Bhogilal reveals that the financial situation of his company has taken a massive hit during these trying times. He apologizes to Jethalal and Bagha for mistreating them and not being able to make the payment. Later, Sodhi and Bhide offer to take money from them to make the order for the tabs but Jethalal denies it.

3106.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3106.description: Jethalal feels guilty about not being able to fulfill Iyer's order. He visits Iyer's office, to tell the truth, and apologize to everyone. Later, he seems depressed as sits down to wonder, how to save his company.

3107.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3107.description: Bagha helps Jethalal come to his senses and go back home. On reaching home, he finds that everyone is gathered at his house and Babitaji has told Bapuji the truth. Later, Jethalal reveals his plans to come out of this slump.

3108.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3108.description: Everyone tries to come up with alternate business options for Jethalal. However, Jethalal has decided that it will be best if he sells his shop to clear his dues and go back to his hometown. Everyone feels that the Gokuldham Society won't be the same without Jethalal.

3109.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3109.description: Jethalal finds a party that is interested to buy his shop immediately. The next day, the man arrives to give the cheque for Gada Electronics, but Bagha doesn't hand over the keys. Jethalal gets furious and wakes up to realize that it was just a dream.

3110.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3110.description: Bapuji and Tapu make dinner and sweets for Jethalal to lift his spirit. However, Jethalal does not respond to Bapuji and Tapu's surprise. Jethalal narrates his situation and talks about his decision to sell Gada Electronics. Bapuji tells Jethalal that they can sell their ancestral property and clear the debt.

3111.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3111.description: Jethalal reluctantly agrees to take Sundar's help for selling their ancestral property. Later, Sunder calls back to give them the good news that a party is ready to buy that property for Rs. 1 crore.

3112.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3112.description: Jethalal informs everyone about the good news that he has received from Sundar. Later, everyone goes back home and expresses their gratitude for being safe and healthy during these trying times. At night, Jethalal's grandfather visits him in his dream and gives him a warning.

3113.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3113.description: Jethalal wakes Bapuji in the middle of the night and informs him about the dream that he saw. Bapuji explains that it is not Dadaji who is denying to sell the land but his own guilt. Next day, Sundar and his friends arrive at Jethalal's house to leave for the meeting but Jethalal has changed his mind.

3114.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3114.description: Bapuji dreams of his father, where he is told that he is doing a good job by selling the property. However, Bapuji is also told to protect and keep the business running. Later, the client contacts Sundar and tells him that he is ready to pay Rs. 1 crore for Jethalal's ancestral property.

3115.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3115.description: After listening to Sundar talking to his client, everyone gets suspicious about his catchphrase. On questioning Sundar they find out that it is Bhogilal who wants to buy Jethalal's property for Rs. 1 crore. Everyone gets extremely angry and decides to set him up.

3116.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3116.description: The residents of the Gokuldham society gather at Jethalal's house and make a plan to trap Bhogilal.

3117.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3117.description: Bhogilal arrives at Gokuldham Society. Taarak and Sundar keep him busy downstairs while everyone at Jethalal's house is hiding inside the rooms and kitchen.

3118.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3118.description: Bhogilal is at Jethalal's house and questions Bapuji about his land and his son. Meanwhile, other members of the Gokuldham Society are hiding in different rooms.

3119.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3119.description: Though Bhogilal gets suspicious, he manages to trust Bapuji and gives him papers to sign. However, Bhogilal shows his true colours when Sundar asks him to make the payment.

3120.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3120.description: Bhogilal is still making excuses for not being able to transfer the money. Everyone else is trying to find ways to procure the money that he owes to Jethalal. Will they succeed?

3121.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3121.description: After finding out that the members of the Gokuldham Society were trying to set him up, Bhogilal plans to turn the tables and get them arrested.

3122.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3122.description: Boghilal threatens that he will make sure Jethalal will be put behind bars for harassment. However, Jethalal has an ace up his sleeve that will put him in the clear.

3123.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3123.description: Everyone celebrates as Boghilal is taken to prison, and Jethalal's problems come to an end. Later, Jethalal manages to fulfill Iyer's order.

3124.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3124.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society are happy as they celebrate and dance together. Later, the ladies of Gokuldham gather near the vegetable stall and chat with each other.

3125.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3125.description: At Bhide's house, the parents of the students arrive and ask him to give a discount on tuition fees. All members of the Gokuldham Society want to go to Abdul's soda shop. However, his shop is closed, so they gather at Taarak's house to have a chat.

3126.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3126.description: Bhide shares his online class issues with Taarak and Jethalal. He reveals the times have hindered the learning process for the children.

3127.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3127.description: Bhide's students play antakshari during their online classes. Later, he complains about his students to other members of the Gokuldham Society. Everybody is tensed about the future of students as they have lost track of their studies due to lockdown.

3128.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3128.description: Jethalal goes back and checks on Tapu's online classes. Later, Taarak shares Bhide's worry with Anjali and talks about the new normal.

3129.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3129.description: Jethalal spends time with Babitaji on his balcony as Bapuji comes from behind and scolds Jethalal for wasting time. Later, Jethalal is stopped by Iyer and Popatlal who ask him for the society's maintenance cheque.

3130.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3130.description: Babita is planning to cook a special dinner for Iyer. Suddenly, Jethalal starts getting calls from an unknown number. Who could it be?

3131.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3131.description: Jethalal comes back home to find a worried Babita standing outside. He asks her to not worry anymore as he is there to solve all her problems.

3132.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3132.description: Jethalal manages to deliver the gas cylinder with the help of Doctor Hathi and Taarak Mehta. Later, Bapuji comes home and thinks that he has been robbed because of all the mess that Jethalal created.

3133.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3133.description: Babita invites Jethalal and his family to join them in celebrating her special day with Iyer. Later, Tapu makes everyone dance on this memorable day.

3134.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3134.description: Popatlal receives a message that makes him furious. He shares his anger and worries with Bapuji and Jethalal. Who sent the message?

3135.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3135.description: Popatlal gets a call from a girl named Pooja who says that she is a big fan of him and wants to meet him. Popatlal figures out that the girl is single. What are his plans?

3136.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3136.description: Popatlal dreams of getting married to a girl whom he is going to meet soon. The next morning, Popatlal is excited and prepares to meet the girl of his dreams.

3137.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3137.description: Popatlal is excited and receives the gift that he had ordered for Pooja. After opening the parcel, he realises that he has received the wrong parcel.

3138.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3138.description: Delivery boy comes with the right parcel and to collect the wrong one. However, Popatlal realises that he has lost the parcel that he was supposed to return.

3139.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3139.description: Popatlal is in search of his wrong parcel that he is supposed to return. He visits every house in the Gokuldham Society to find clues for his missing mangoes.

3140.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3140.description: Popatlal gets impatient with the search for his lost parcel. He visits Jethalal and Iyer's house to look for it. Later, Popatlal and Sodhi get in a fight with the delivery boy.

3141.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3141.description: Popatlal, tired of searching for his mangoes, resorts to Inspector Pandey's help. After questioning the delivery guy, he calls all members of the Gokuldham society to come out. Will Popatlal manage to meet Pooja with her gifts on time?

3142.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3142.description: Inspector Pandey tries to find a middle ground between Popatlal and the delivery boy but fails to do so. Later, he manages to find the mangoes in someone's home. Who could this be?

3143.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3143.description: Popatlal finally finds the parcel he has been looking for and is happy about getting to meet Pooja. However, he never imagined the action Inspector Pandey will take for wasting the police's precious time.

3144.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3144.description: Jethalal gets scolded by Bapuji for not remembering where he has kept his chequebook. Later, Popatlal finally gets to sit down with Pooja and have a conversation.

3145.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3145.description: The news that Pooja is coming to Gokuldham Society spreads quickly. Mahila Mandal decides to cook for Poaptlal and Pooja, while Tapu Sena prepares to welcome them.

3146.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3146.description: Pooja arrives at the Gokuldham Society, where she gets welcomed by Tapu Sena. Later, Pooja reveals a shocking fact to Popatlal that breaks his heart.

3147.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3147.description: The members of the Gokuldham Society wait downstairs to celebrate with Popatlal. However, they get shocked to know that Pooja sees him as her Guru. Later, everyone asks Popatlal to stay hopeful and look at the bright side.

3148.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3148.description: Popatlal calls Jethalal, Taarak, Bhide, Sodhi, Iyer, Dr. Hathi to his place for a party. Later, Asit Bhai calls Taarak as he wants to give a piece of good news to everyone, but they will have to wait for it.

3149.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3149.description: When Babita asks about the stains on his clothes, Iyer tells her the entire incident. All of them return to their homes and tell their families about Asit Bhai's surprise.

3150.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3150.description: Jethalal thanks Bhide for saving his mobile by heroically catching it. Soon, Asit Bhai sends a link on everyone's mobile and asks them to play it to reveal his surprise for them.

3151.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3151.description: Bhide is troubled with his online classes, and Jethalal arrives at Bhide's house to talk about one of his students. The next day Bhide gets annoyed further by his friends in the Gokuldham Society.

3152.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3152.description: Bhide teaches a new maths chapter and asks the kids to prepare as he will take a test later in the evening. Bhide leaves for delivery and meets Iyer and Popatlal on the way. He shares his worry about the future of his students with Popatlal.

3153.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3153.description: Popatlal and Bhide take a scooter ride to the marriage bureau, where Bhide forgets his phone. Later, during his regular classes, Bhide gets angry and calls for a parent meeting with his students.

3154.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3154.description: Tapu Sena sees Bhide in a foul mood and tries to cheer him up. Later, Bhide informs the students and their parents that he is not going to teach them further.

3155.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3155.description: Jethalal fails to reason with Bhide and seeks help from Taarak Mehta regarding the same. Soon, all the parents arrive at Gokuldham Society to request Bhide to resume the online classes.

3156.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3156.description: Taarak talks to Bhide and tries to give him an outsider's perspective. Soon, Bhide calms down and counsels the kids about the importance of education as he agrees to start the online classes immediately.

3157.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3157.description: Mr. Mehta sits in his house reminiscing about the past year. He prays to God to keep everyone safe in the upcoming year as well.

3158.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3158.description: Popatlal gets a call from one of his informants, who tells him that his life could be in danger. Popatlal immediately gathers his team and leaves for his new mission.

3159.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3159.description: Popatlal and Bharti explain the situation to Dr. Hathi and request his cooperation to discover the truth. Later, Dr. Hathi meets a probable suspect to extract information about their leader.

3160.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3160.description: Popatlal and his team continue with their "Kala Kauwa" mission at the Rang Tarang Resort. However, Popatlal gets distracted when he finds an eligible life partner for himself.

3161.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3161.description: Dr Hathi gets tired after eating too much at the resort. Meanwhile, Popatlal and Bharti get worried about the mission and try to get in touch with him.

3162.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3162.description: Popatlal and Bharti meet a waiter who is scared as her mother does not have the medicines she needs. This makes Popatlal more determined to uncover the people behind the medicine scam.

3163.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3163.description: Dr Hathi receives an important message and leaves to complete the mission. Meanwhile, Popatlal and Bharti have to overcome multiple hurdles to keep up with Dr Hathi.

3164.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3164.description: Dr Hathi faces difficulty in getting the deal and fails to record the boss' face. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets distracted as his tour guide takes him sightseeing.

3165.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3165.description: Dr Hathi gets escorted out of the resort by one of the goons and he is not allowed to get in touch with Popatlal. Meanwhile, Bharti and Popatlal are kept busy and distracted by the resort's staff.

3166.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3166.description: Popatlal and Bharti check the pen camera that Dr Hathi left behind in the bathroom. They take a boat ride to clear their minds and come up with a new plan to revive "Mission Kala Kauwa".

3167.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3167.description: Bagha and Jethalal have to deal with surplus goods at their godown. Later, Popatlal calls Jethalal to give him a piece of good news.

3168.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3168.description: Popatlal lures Jethalal to the resort so he can assist him with the Mission Kala Kauwa. Later, Dr Hathi calls Popatlal from his home to let him know that he is safe and sound.

3169.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3169.description: Bhide calls Popatlal, hoping he could help him get an order for his pickles from the resort. Later, Jethalal calls Popatlal to give him an update.

3170.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3170.description: Popatlal and Bharti get paranoid as they think that a waiter at the resort is onto their secret. Meanwhile, Jethalal enjoys a game of antakshari while on the way to the resort.

3171.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3171.description: Jethalal inquires about the resort so he can confirm his order for the appliances in 200 rooms. Popatlal tells him to be patient till they manage to meet in person.

3172.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3172.description: After Jethalal agrees to get on the boat with Popatlal, he gets reeled in about everything Popatlal has done for Mission Kala Kauwa. Will Jethalal accept the mission?

3173.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3173.description: Popatlal explains what Jethalal will have to do to bring the mafia down. Jethalal puts on a disguise and tries to set up a meeting with the boss.

3174.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3174.description: Bagha drops the pen camera for Bharti so Popatlal can check what transpired at Jethalal's first meet. They meet again at the swimming pool to decide the next step for their mission.

3175.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3175.description: Popatlal realises that one of the waiters at the resort must be providing information to the main boss. Jethalal suggests that they should follow him to find more information about the gang.

3176.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3176.description: The main boss comes up with a new code word and prepares for an important meeting. Meanwhile, Jethalal meets the manager and tries to extract information about all the employees.

3177.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3177.description: Popatlal and others keep their covers intact and steer clear from any suspicion. Jethalal also reveals the name of the person he thinks is the mole in the resort.

3178.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3178.description: Popatlal is sure that the receptionist has more allies in the resort. He devises a plan to make sure they can catch them.

3179.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3179.description: Popatlal sets a romantic mood to propose Sanjana. Little does he know that she is involved in the dealing of the medicines.

3180.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3180.description: After revealing his true identity to Sanjana, Popatlal gets caught by the gang. She calls Popatlal to meet him and sets him up to get captured.

3181.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3181.description: Jethalal bumps into Sanjana and deals with her discreetly. Popatlal finally comes face to face with the boss of the gang.

3182.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3182.description: The boss continues to torture Popatlal while his assistant checks for more clues. Jethalal plans to go through the CCTV footage to look for Popatlal in the resort.

3183.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3183.description: The boss discovers about Jethalal, who is Popatlal's accomplice. Jethalal, Bagha, and Bapuji take a new disguise to escape from the clutches of the gang.

3184.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3184.description: Popatlal waits for a miracle as he is tied in the pool and will be electrocuted if he tries to move. Jethalal is running around the resort in a disguise trying to look for Popatlal.

3185.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3185.description: Jethalal, Bagha and Bapuji are still on the run from the goons at the resort. Soon, Inspector Chalu Pandey arrives at the resort to investigate the situation.

3186.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3186.description: Jethalal stumbles onto the boss of the operation and they find out that they are old acquaintances. Madan further tortures Popatlal who is still tied at the centre of the pool.

3187.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3187.description: Jethalal, Babuji, and Bagha celebrate when they see that Inspector Pandey has arrived from Mumbai. They share all the information about the goons that they have.

3188.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3188.description: Inspector Pandey suspects that there must be a secret at the pool since it is closed for everyone. To their surprise, they find more clues linked to Popatlal there.

3189.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3189.description: Inspector Pandey finds Popatlal, who tells them how he escaped death. Inspector Pandey's men also catch hold of Madan.

3190.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3190.description: Madan demands to be set free, as Popatlal does not have any proof against him. Popatlal manages to find a piece of video evidence that incriminates Madan.

3191.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3191.description: With Madan's arrest, Popatlal's top-secret mission is completed successfully. Popatlal and Jethalal also extend the services of Gokuldham's members to the Rang Tarang resort's owner.

3192.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3192.description: The colony members are in a festive mood as they celebrate the success of Popatlal's secret mission. Bhide and his wife consider going to a resort along with everyone else to congratulate Popatlal.

3193.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3193.description: Bagha puts Jethalal in the spotlight by asking him a hypothetical question. Everyone from Gokuldham calls Jethalal to show him the excitement for the celebration at the resort.

3194.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3194.description: Popatlal and his gang get a 5-star treatment at the resort. Meanwhile, everyone at Gokuldham prepares to leave for Rang Tarang resort.

3195.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3195.description: Jethalal locks himself out of his room and has to wake up Bapuji to get in. Everyone from Gokuldham boards the bus to leave for the resort.

3196.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3196.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society board the bus and begin their journey to Rang Tarang resort. They decide to have all the fun and take necessary precautions as well.

3197.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3197.description: The families have a blast on the bus, playing different games and teasing each other on their way to Rang Tarang Resort.

3198.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3198.description: Everyone on the bus decides to take a small break before proceeding further. Jethalal plans to get done with his meeting quickly so he can prepare for everyone's arrival.

3199.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3199.description: Everyone continues to play a variety of games throughout their journey. The gents plan to set up a grand party for Popatlal to celebrate his success.

3200.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3200.description: Popatlal ensures that all his friends from Gokuldham receive a warm welcome at the resort. Jethalal reaches the owner's office for his meeting.

3201.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3201.description: Gokuldham members reach the resort reception and start checking themselves in. Popatlal plans to welcome them in a better way.

3202.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3202.description: Jethalal finally gets to meet K.K. but faces issues in communication as he wants to converse in English. Sodhi and Iyer panic as they can't find the bag with party goods in it.

3203.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3203.description: The gents of Gokuldham seek the manager's help in looking for Sodhi's missing bag. Everyone decides to take a walk around the resort together.

3204.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3204.description: Gokuldham members find a mango tree from which they pluck a few mangoes. They later discover the swimming pool area and are amazed by the ambiance.

3205.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3205.description: Jethalal comes back from his meeting with KK. He tries to give Taarak Mehta a bottle of concoction.

3206.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3206.description: Taarak Mehta meets the manager of the resort to book a hall. Later, everyone gathers at the hall for a Gokuldham style function.

3207.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3207.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society gather at the hall. Bhide reveals to Jethalal and Popatlal the reason for their gathering.

3208.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3208.description: Dr Hathi, Jethalal and Popatlal narrate the details of Mission Kala Kauwa to all Gokuldham members.

3209.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3209.description: Jethalal continues to narrate every detail about their mission to everyone. Gokuldham members show their appreciation for Popatlal's efforts by giving him a trophy.

3210.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3210.description: All gents of the Gokuldham Society meet to discuss the party. They ask Popatlal to use his contacts for managing the party.

3211.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3211.description: Tapu Sena enjoys a game of pool in the play area. Everyone decides to meet up for a Gokuldham style dinner at the resort.

3212.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3212.description: Everyone gathers at the hall to enjoy a lavish dinner at the resort.

3213.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3213.description: Bagha gets drunk and wants to keep dancing. Everyone tries to stop him and take him to his room.

3214.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3214.description: Everyone tries different strategies to get Bagha to calm down and go back to his room. Bapuji finds out that Bagha is missing and gets furious.

3215.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3215.description: Bapuji catches Bagha and scolds him for his behaviour. The resort's manager gets medicine to help Bagha come back to his senses.

3216.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3216.description: Bapuji has a severe case of hiccups and decides to consume some 'kadha.' How will he react when he finds out the original contents of the bottle.

3217.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3217.description: Bapuji punishes all the men of the Gokuldham Society for lying about the bottle. All the men later apologise for their plan to party.

3218.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3218.description: Everyone is happy that they broke out of their regular lockdown routine to visit the resort. Jethalal and Taarak get into separate teams and play a game in the swimming pool.

3219.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3219.description: Everyone relaxes in the swimming pool area of the resort. Later, everyone gathers at the lake and divide into teams to compete in a boat race.

3220.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3220.description: Everyone goes back to their rooms to rest after the boat race. The next morning, the Gokuldham members start checking out from the resort.

3221.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3221.description: Jethalal arrives late at the lobby for his check out. The owner of the resort sends a present to everyone for helping the resort.

3222.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3222.description: Anjali makes delicious dinner for Taarak as all the colony members meet at Mehta's residence and re-live their resort memories.

3223.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3223.description: The men of the society sit around and remember the trip. They talk about the party incident and come to a conclusion that it is their right to party occasionally.

3224.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3224.description: The colony members get nostalgic and remember one of the icons of Indian cinema, Dilip Kumar. They cherish his memories by singing his songs.

3225.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3225.description: Everyone gets back to their daily routine and life goes back to normal in Gokuldham. Taarak gets to know that Anjali has plans for him and will only give him healthy food to eat.

3226.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3226.description: Bapuji's glasses go missing and they are nowhere to be found. Where could his glasses be? Meanwhile, Taarak gets late for office.

3227.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3227.description: Mr Mehta is running late for work, and there seems to be no available mode of travel for him. Jethalal, as usual, is running late, and Bhide is going in the opposite direction. How does Mr Mehta get to work in time?

3228.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3228.description: Jethalal gets the shock of his life when he reaches his warehouse and finds that it is empty. He panics and calls Bagha but, he too is of no help. Jethalal decides to call Mr Mehta for help, who is in a tricky situation with his boss for coming late.

3229.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3229.description: To get Mr.Mehta a day off from work, Jethalal calls Mr.Mehta's boss and pretends to be Anjali, who has fallen sick all of a sudden.

3230.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3230.description: Jethalal and the society members celebrate the fact that the electronic stock was saved and nothing was stolen. Mr Mehta gets furious that because of Jethalal's misunderstanding he had to take a day off from work.

3231.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3231.description: Mr. Mehta's boss finds out that he lied and took a day off from work. He confronts him in the restaurant. Is Mr. Mehta's job in danger?

3232.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3232.description: Taarak reaches home to discover that his wife is going to her friend's place. He is worried that he will have to lie to everyone who question him.

3233.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3233.description: Bapuji reminisces about his younger days with Tapu. Jethalal asks Baupuji to accompany him for a special breakfast.

3234.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3234.description: Jethalal asks Taarak to accompany him for a plate of 'Jalebi' and 'Fafda.' Bapuji does not allow Taarak to eat the 'Jalebi' that Tapu orders online.

3235.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3235.description: Dr Hathi reveals that he will be conducting a vaccination drive and helping everyone in the society to get their shots. Taarak and Jethalal get into a fight when Jethalal declares that he doesn't want to get vaccinated.

3236.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3236.description: Bhide informs everyone that Popatlal will publish an article about the vaccination drive. Tapu Sena seeks the help of Ritu for advertising their new song.

3237.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3237.description: Jethalal and Taarak get into another quarrel as Jethalal has a new excuse for not taking the vaccine. Tapu Sena performs the vaccination song that they have been preparing with Taarak.

3238.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3238.description: Bhide and Dr. Hathi are excited to make all the arrangements and start with their vaccination drive. Bhide finds out that Sodhi does not want to take the vaccination either.

3239.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3239.description: Everyone gets up early to prepare for the Gokuldham Vaccination Drive. Jethalal comes up with a clever plan to save himself from the needle.

3240.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3240.description: Everyone gathers at the camp and gets vaccinated for COVID-19. Taarak reveals that Jethalal isn't sick and is lying to escape the camp.

3241.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3241.description: After his lie gets caught, Jethalal runs away from everyone to save himself from the injection. He seeks Taarak's help to protect himself from the other members of Gokuldham.

3242.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3242.description: With all the members of the society vaccinated, everyone prepares for outsiders to arrive for the vaccine. They are shocked when no one turns up for getting vaccinated.

3243.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3243.description: Tapu Sena finds that someone has taken all their vaccination drive banners down. Bhide calls for the police's help to catch the people spreading misinformation.

3244.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3244.description: Inspector Pandey comes to the colony to arrest the members for running a fake vaccination drive. Are the colony members in trouble?

3245.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3245.description: As the misunderstanding around the vaccination drive clears out, the colony members decide to go out and convince people to come and get vaccinated.

3246.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3246.description: The colony members celebrate the successful vaccination drive and find out that the people who had spread rumours have been caught.

3247.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3247.description: Jethalal has a sore arm and Tapu, a fever. Champaklal calls Dr Hathi over. Dr Hathi tactfully rids Jethalal of the sore arm. What will his solution for Tapu be?

3248.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3248.description: Popatlal returns from Hyderabad. Bhide takes offline classes. His students are extremely happy to be back for offline classes. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena decides to meet to come up with ideas to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi.

3249.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3249.description: Bhide has decided to plan for the Ganesh Utsav this year, instead of Tapu Sena. He tries to come up with a unique idea to celebrate Ganesh Utsav, but cannot think of anything. Who will plan the celebrations for Ganesh Utsav?

3250.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3250.description: Bhide speeds up his preparations for Ganesh Utsav and asks Iyer to meet him to decide the budget. Tapu Sena has also started their preparations for Ganesh Utsav, as they do every year. Will Bhide beat Tapu Sena's budget and get to prepare for Ganesh Utsav?

3251.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3251.description: Bhide believes he will beat Tapu Sena and get to organise the upcoming Ganesh Utsav. Everybody waits for Jethalal to reach the clubhouse so that the meeting can begin. Will Jethalal arrive on time?

3252.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3252.description: The conflict between Tapu Sena and Bhide continues to ascertain who gets to prepare for the upcoming Ganesh Utsav. On seeing the argument escalate at the society meet, Champaklal intervenes and comes up with a solution that is accepted by all. Who will get to prepare for the upcoming Ganesh Utsav?

3253.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3253.description: Bhide enumerates the names of Lord Ganesh. Later, he dreams of meeting Lord Ganesh himself, after following Mushak.

3254.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3254.description: Bhide is at a loss for words because of his dream. He talks to various members of the Gokuldham Society about his dream and everybody tries to think of a way out.

3255.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3255.description: Popatlal takes Bhide to a Pandit so they can help Bhide understand his dream. They come back and call everyone to give an update about the situation.

3256.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3256.description: Everyone gets ready to welcome Ganpati Bappa at the Gokuldham Society. Bhide gets anxious before Lord Ganesh arrives.

3257.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3257.description: The members of Gokuldham Society welcome Lord Ganesh to their care. Bhide reveals the programmes he has planned with Tapu Sena for the celebrations.

3258.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3258.description: Sunderlal arrives at Jethalal's house with a deal. Bhide calls everyone to let them know about the programmes that are lined up for the celebration.

3259.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3259.description: The Gokuldham members are ready to start the Ganpati Utsav. To celebrate the 75th year of independence, everyone dresses up as the freedom fighters of India.

3260.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3260.description: Bhide takes the Ganesh Utsav forward at the Gokuldham Society. The members take turns to display their costumes.

3261.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3261.description: Sodhi, Taarak and Bhide put on their costumes and perform their acts. Everyone enjoys the visual and knowledgeable performances that the participants illustrate.

3262.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3262.description: The spotlight lands on Anjali, Iyer, and Babita next. They put on their costumes and portray stories from India's freedom fighting days.

3263.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3263.description: Impressed by the freedom fighters, everyone hopes that their spirit keeps inspiring our future generations. Members of Tapu Sena put up a joint performance for the society members.

3264.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3264.description: It is finally Popatlal and Jethalal's turn to put on a show. Everyone has tears of joy as they bid farewell to Lord Ganesha.

3265.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3265.description: Bhide realises that his scooter has gotten old and needs extra care. He calls Sodhi hoping that he might know a mechanic who can help.

3266.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3266.description: Everyone at the Gokuldham Society gets ready to go to their jobs. Someone suspicious walks into the society who has his eyes set on Bhide's Sakharam.

3267.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3267.description: Sodhi calls Bhide to tell him that he sent a mechanic to repair his scooter. Popatlal and Bapuji give Tapu Sena a small history lesson.

3268.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3268.description: Bhide needs hard cash that he has to give to Ramakant Kaka. Bhide decides to send Sonu, with Tapu Sena, to the bank to withdraw the money he needs.

3269.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3269.description: Bhide hands the cheque to his daughter and asks Tapu Sena to head directly to the bank. After losing the cheque at the market, Tapu Sena frantically searches for it everywhere.

3270.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3270.description: Tapu Sena returns to Gokuldham Society and lies to Bhide about his money. Bhide receives a message from his bank that money has been withdrawn from his account.

3271.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3271.description: Tapu Sena is in shambles due to the problem they have gotten themselves into. Bhide gets a call from an officer who tells him that he found his cheque lying on the road.

3272.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3272.description: Tapu Sena calls their parents and tries to borrow cash so they can give it to Bhide.

3273.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3273.description: Tapu Sena contacts a loan shark to help Sonu give the cash to her father. The loan shark informs them about his terms and conditions for lending them the money.

3274.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3274.description: Bhide plays along with the lies that Tapu Sena tells him. He decides to call their parents to tell them about their blunders.

3275.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3275.description: Abdul follows Tapu Sena and updates Bhide of their movement. Tapu Sena's parents gather at Bhide's house and find out about their lies.

3276.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3276.description: Bhide gets enraged by the string of lies Tapu Sena has been telling and blames himself for being a poor teacher. Tapu Sena decides to tell the truth to their parents.

3277.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3277.description: Bapuji tells Tapu Sena that he will always support them if they always stay on the right path. Bhide and Sodhi visit Ramakant Kama to hand him the money.

3278.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3278.description: With Abdul missing from his shop, Bhide prepares soda for everyone. Bhide has a terrible nightmare that keeps disturbing his sleep.

3279.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3279.description: Bhide calls Sodhi and Jethalal for help in the middle of the night as he thinks there is some trouble at the door. Jethalal and Taarak carry any weapon they can get their hands on and rush to Bhide's home.

3280.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3280.description: Popatlal receives Kashmiri Kahwa from a fan and calls everyone to his home to have some. Bhide, who leaves his phone at home, looks for all his friends everywhere in the Gokuldham Society.

3281.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3281.description: Bhide gets Bapuji and everyone else's wives to Popatlal's home. They misunderstand the Kahwa to be an alcoholic beverage and begin to revolt against the drinkers.

3282.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3282.description: Babita delivers Jethalal's letter to his home before he leaves for his shop. Taarak's boss gives him 30 minutes to find a birth certificate.

3283.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3283.description: The boss's wife calls the office to inform them that she has found the birth certificate. Taarak plans to use his best weapon to take his revenge.

3284.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3284.description: Taarak's boss asks him to read out his poem, but Taarak knows that reading his poem out, will get him in trouble.

3285.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3285.description: After getting into more trouble at work, Taarak tries to seek Jethalal's help. However, an angry Jethalal takes his time to forgive Taarak and give him some advice.

3286.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3286.description: Jethalal calls Iyer and asks him to help save Taarak's job. Iyer reluctantly agrees to lie to Taarak's boss about the poem.

3287.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3287.description: Taarak's boss calls Iyer and tells him that Iyer's boss is his childhood friend. Iyer calls Taarak to tell him about the trouble he has gotten himself into.

3288.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3288.description: Jethalal forces Taarak to recite his poem in front of Anjali and Babita. Jethalal helps Iyer to calm down so they can find a solution for their problems.

3289.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3289.description: Taarak and Iyer reach the restaurant and wait for their bosses to arrive. Taarak's boss feels that it is his responsibility to counsel his childhood friend to become a better senior.

3290.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3290.description: Taarak's boss claims that there is democracy in his office and everyone is free to express their opinions. But how will he react when Taarak tells him that his 'Boss Bashing' poem was intended towards him?

3291.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3291.description: Jethalal narrates the incident about Taarak's boss to Bapuji. Madhvi requests the Mahila Mandal to shop from the local market to support the small businesses that had suffered due to COVID-19.

3292.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3292.description: Taarak writes a poem for the occasion of Diwali and requests Jethalal to hear it. The members of the Gokuldham Society visit the local market for Diwali shopping.

3293.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3293.description: The police explain their reasons for raiding the roadside hawkers. Feeling bad about the situation, Mahila Mandal comes up with a solution that helps all the parties.

3294.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3294.description: The hawkers reach Gokuldham Society to set up their stalls. However, they need permission from Bhide, the society's secretary, before doing anything.

3295.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3295.description: Bhide, after consulting everyone, grants the hawkers permission to set up their stalls. Tapu Sena assures Bhide that they will take care of the security arrangements.

3296.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3296.description: The shopping fiesta begins at the Gokuldham Society. Tapu Sena catches a pickpocket, who tries to run away with a lot of valuable items.

3297.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3297.description: Sundar arrives at Jethalal's house and tells him that he has brought a surprise from Ahmedabad. When Goli tells his father about the kachori, he wishes that he could have some as well.

3298.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3298.description: Goli tries to deliver his mother's handmade kachori to Iyer's house, but faces multiple hurdles along the way.

3299.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3299.description: Goli distributes kachoris to everyone in Gokuldham Society. Jethalal talks to Bapuji about his shop's interior work. Meanwhile, the kids are playing cricket downstairs and Jethalal flaunts his cricket skills in front of Babita.

3300.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3300.description: Taarak steps in and saves Jethalal from getting embarrassed in front of Babita. Jethalal, worried that his business is affected by the renovation, seeks Taarak's help again.

3301.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3301.description: Taarak asks Jethalal to stay calm and ask his contractor for a deadline. Iyer trips on a banana peel and breaks his cell phone.

3302.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3302.description: When Bhide finds that Tapu has ordered footwear worth five thousand rupees, he scolds Jethalal for pampering Tapu. Jethalal reaches his shop to find that the contractor hasn't arrived for the meeting.

3303.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3303.description: Jethalal sends Bagha to a local mobile repair show for fixing Babita's phone. Bhide has to deal with three guys who are adamant about taking 2 lakh rupees from Jethalal.

3304.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3304.description: The goons, who believe that Jethalal owes them money, reach his office and demand money. Jethalal, still confused, tries to figure out who they are and how does he owe them money.

3305.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3305.description: Jethalal frantically looks for his contractor Santosh. He ends up calling multiple numbers but fails to get in touch with him. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer wait for Jethalal to come back with her phone.

3306.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3306.description: Iyer calls Bagha and asks him about Babita's phone. Jethalal calls the vasooli agents and tries to get the phone back.

3307.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3307.description: Jethalal calls the goon who has Babita's phone and begs him to give the phone back to him. However, the goon doesn't budge and asks for his money. What compromise does Jethalal need to do to get the phone back?

3308.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3308.description: Iyer and Babita arrive at Jethalal's godown and find that he has been lying about Babita's phone all along. Jethalal turns to Taarak to help him find a solution.

3309.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3309.description: Jethalal gets jumped on by other members of Gokuldham for being irresponsible with Babita's phone. Taarak helps Jethalal to set up a meeting with the vasooli agents.

3310.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3310.description: Sodhi gets ready to take on the vasooli agents with Babita's phone. Jethalal sets up a meeting with the agents in the hopes of returning Babita's phone.

3311.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3311.description: Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi are arrested by the police and taken to the station. They get happy to see Inspector Pandey on duty but, he refuses to treat their case in a partial manner.

3312.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3312.description: Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi get locked up in Inspector Pandey's station. They keep requesting Inspector Pandey to show them some leniency.

3313.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3313.description: Jethalal requests Inspector Pandey to drop him, Taarak and Sodhi at Gokuldham Society. Bapuji finds out the story of Jethalal's arrest through Bhide.

3314.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3314.description: Babita thanks Jethalal for repairing and returning her phone safely. Jethalal argues about exchanging the footwear that Tapu ordered online.

3315.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3315.description: Popatlal gets angry at Bhide for being carefree about the accidents at the Gokuldham Society. How will the members of Gokuldham solve this new issue?

3316.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3316.description: Madhvi informs Bhide that her brother, Vinayak, will be coming over with his family. Bhide gets distracted and burns Madhvi's saree by accident.

3317.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3317.description: Bhide is in a hurry to leave, but the people of Gokuldham keep coming in his way. Bhide has to hide as he runs into Madhvi and Sonu at the market.

3318.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3318.description: A tailor suggests to Bhide that the best option he has is to buy the same saree. Bhide asks Taarak to help him find the saree.

3319.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3319.description: Bhide tries to find the same saree at the shops in the mall. Meanwhile, Madhvi calls Bhide, asking him about her saree.

3320.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3320.description: Bhide buys a replica of Madhvi's Saree from a shop. He sneaks in with the saree and hides it in the cupboard.

3321.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3321.description: Bhide and his family finally welcome Madhvi's brother to their house. Everyone notices that Madhvi's saree is different. Will Bhide come clean?

3322.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3322.description: Sonu recites the poem she wrote for her Mama and Mami. Bhide confesses that it was him who burned Madhvi's saree.

3323.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3323.description: Big B calls Asit Kumarr Modi and invites every member of the Gokuldham Society to play KBC. Asit relays the message to Bhide so he can inform everyone to get ready.

3324.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3324.description: With Asit Kumarr Modi arriving in Gokuldham Society, what news is he bringing along with him, that has the interest of all the members?

3325.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3325.description: Asit Ji announces that Gokuldham Society members have been invited to participate in Kaun Banega Crorepati. The society members can't control their excitement at the thought of participating in such a huge show and meeting Big B personally.

3326.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3326.description: The members of the Gokuldham Society return home after their gameplay on the hot seat and congratulate each other. Everyone welcomes the people from Yuva Unstoppable Foundation.

3327.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3327.description: Shubh Mangal Marriage Bureau tells Popatlal that after his appearance on KBC, he has become the most eligible bachelor in the country. Abdul calls Popatlal to inform him that someone is coming over to see him.

3328.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3328.description: Popatlal takes it upon himself to disinfect his house so he can meet Gungun. He gets in trouble when another family stops him on his way to Bhide's house.

3329.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3329.description: Popatlal drops the second family at Dr Hathi's house and meets Gungun, who is waiting at Bhide's house. Popatlal has to juggle between the two families before coming to a decision.

3330.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3330.description: Popatlal uses a ladder to get up and down Bhide's balcony to meet both families. Who will Popatlal choose, Sneha or Gungun?

3331.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3331.description: It appears as Popatlal has made up his mind to marry Sneha, but when he declines Gungun's proposal, Gungun's father loses consciousness. How will this change Popatlal's selection criteria?

3332.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3332.description: Both families leave Gokuldham Society, revealing that they just wanted to invite the members of the Gokuldham Society to Sneha and Gungun's wedding. A furious Popatlal is calmed down by the Mahila Mandal with their optimism.

3333.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3333.description: Popatlal, already on the edge, sends a family home, who genuinely came with a marriage proposal. Fuming with anger, he calls his boss and asks him about the astrologer who works for their paper.

3334.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3334.description: Popatlal explains to Bhide, Madhvi and Komal the reason for his happiness. Popatlal welcomes Sanjana, a Vastu expert, to the Gokuldham Society.

3335.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3335.description: Popatlal, happy about getting rid of his cursed sherwani, is surprised by his pandit, who delivers his sherwani back to him. Popatlal appoints Tapu Sena to gift his sherwani to an unmarried guy.

3336.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3336.description: All the members of the Gokuldham Society get angry at Popatlal for throwing his sherwani on Bhide. When Bhide calls to confront him about his behaviour, Popatlal asks Bhide to get rid of the sherwani.

3337.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3337.description: Popatlal reveals that it was his sherwani, which angers other members of the society. Taarak throws a badminton challenge to Anjali hoping to eat the best street food.

3338.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3338.description: Jethalal brings a hot breakfast for his friends and invites them to his house. Anjali finds a hotel bill amongst Taarak's things and seeks Babita's help to find answers.

3339.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3339.description: After feeling betrayed, Anjali decides to spy on Taarak. She bribes Goli to click a picture of Taarak eating in a hotel during his lunch break. Will Goli, the spy, accomplish his mission?

3340.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3340.description: Anjali takes the help of Mahila Mandal with her husband's diet problem. Babita takes Anjali to a reputed dietician, who suggests a 'Khiladi Diet' for Taarak.

3341.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3341.description: After having a delicious meal cooked by Anjali, Taarak meets his friends at the soda shop. The next day Anjali surprises Taarak and Jethalal with a special halwa.

3342.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3342.description: Anjali reveals her surprise and gets into a fight with Taarak in Jethalal's presence. Goli feels responsible for the fight between the Mehtas and meets Taarak to apologise to him.

3343.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3343.description: Jethalal asks for more time when Taarak calls him seeking help to quench his appetite for delicious food. Taarak's boss forces him to exchange tiffins so he can get out of eating diet food.

3344.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3344.description: Taarak tries to seek everyone's help to find better food without Anjali finding out about it. Anjali gets worried when Taarak does not return home in time.

3345.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3345.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society put their heads together to find Taarak. Taarak arrives late in the night in a rickshaw from a cemetery. What was he doing at the cemetery?

3346.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3346.description: Taarak comes to his senses when he hears the mention of 'karela'. He narrates the story of the 'karela wali' he met on his way home.

3347.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3347.description: The Mahila Mandal joins forces to help Anjali take care of Taarak. An eerie vibe takes over Gokuldham as everyone starts having visions of a ghost in the society.

3348.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3348.description: Everyone leaves for their home after Taarak has a good homecooked dinner and takes his medicine. The ghost story told by Taarak gives birth to fear in everyone's mind. How will the members of Gokuldham Society overcome their fears?

3349.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3349.description: The Mahila Mandal, worried about Taarak, asks Anjali to give him his favourite delicacies till he gets better. Taarak celebrates with Tapu Sena after their plan succeeds.

3350.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3350.description: Tapu Sena and Taarak enjoy their moment of victory by having some delicious food. As Anjali prays to god to help her family, Taarak worries that soon his lies will be caught.

3351.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3351.description: Anjali calls Taarak's boss and asks him to give her husband the day off. The dietician arrives at Gokuldham Society to check on the Mehtas.

3352.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3352.description: Taarak sees a cart carrying 'karela' into the Gokuldham Society and loses his composure. Dr Hathi calls a psychiatrist to help with Taarak's condition. What is wrong with Taarak?

3353.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3353.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society meet to find a solution for Taarak's condition. After the psychiatrist fails to help, Babita suggests taking help from a Baba.

3354.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3354.description: Tapu Sena tries to convince Bhide and Bapuji to stop the Baba from coming to Gokuldham. The Mahila Mandal visits the Mehtas to support them by getting some food for Taarak.

3355.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3355.description: Bhide lies to his customers, neighbours and students to keep the news of Taarak's 'bhoot' coming out. Choodi Wala Baba makes his preparations to help exorcise the ghost inside Taarak.

3356.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3356.description: The 'Choodi Wale Baba' performs his rituals to exorcise the ghost inside Taarak. Taarak and Tapu Sena struggle to find a way out from the mess they have gotten themselves in.

3357.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3357.description: The Baba claims that Madhavi is now hosting the spirit of Suryamukhi. He later explains to everyone how he is going to exorcise the ghost inside Taarak.

3358.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3358.description: Taarak sends everyone in shock when he reveals that he has been acting all along. Bapuji accuses Jethalal of being an accomplice in Taarak's drama. Taarak apologises to everyone for fooling them over the last few days.

3359.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3359.description: The Choodi Wale Baba reveals that it was just an act that he performed as directed by Anjali. The members of the Gokuldham Society help Taarak and Anjali to solve their diet problem.

3360.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3360.description: To redeem Gokuldham's image, Popatlal tells everyone that he wants to publish the truth about Taarak. Anjali reminds her husband that he has to deal with his boss, whom he spooked earlier.

3361.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3361.description: Bagha helps Jethalal get rid of the stiffness in his body by helping him stretch. They decide to decorate the godown, to make it presentable for hosting an important client meeting.

3362.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3362.description: Anxious about his client meeting, Jethalal has trouble falling asleep. He takes his father's blessings and meets his Gokuldham friends before leaving for his godown.

3363.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3363.description: Bagha and Jethalal arrive at the godown early in the morning only to realise that they do not have the keys to the door. Jethalal reaches home and finds out that Bapuji isn't there. Will Jethalal reach his godown in time?

3364.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3364.description: Jethalal reaches his godown to find that Bapuji is waiting with the keys in the Gokuldham Society. Bhide agrees to help by offering to drive Bapuji to the godown.

3365.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3365.description: Bhide and Bapuji get in trouble when a lady gets hit by Sakharam. Jethalal starts getting anxious as he can't enter the godown, and the time for his meeting ticks closer.

3366.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3366.description: Bapuji fails to find Bagha in the meeting spot and goes looking around for him. Bagha finds Bhide, who gets fined again for breaking the traffic rules while searching for Bapuji.

3367.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3367.description: Jethalal and Bhide rush back to Gokuldham to check if Bapuji returned home. Jethalal comes back to the godown to find Bapuji and his client having a good time.

3368.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3368.description: Mr Goyal gets extremely happy to spend time with Bapuji and tells Jethalal that he will be given all the orders. The men of the Gokuldham Society meet at the soda shop and discuss who amongst them should leave the society.

3369.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3369.description: Bagha calls Jethalal to inform him that they failed to read their work emails today. However, Bagha fails to relay the message which makes Jethalal lose his mind.

3370.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3370.description: Babita informs Jethalal that her friend will visit his shop later. Jethalal promises his friends a party after he finalises a new deal that is coming his way.

3371.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3371.description: Bagha calls Jethalal to the godown early, so nothing goes wrong in their meeting. With time in their hands, Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi decide to have a lavish breakfast.

3372.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3372.description: The members of Gokuldham, worried about Jethalal, call to check on him. Jethalal's meeting with the Wow Resort's manager goes south when he puts forward an unreasonable demand.

3373.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3373.description: Wow Resort's manager reveals that he was testing the kind of businessman Jethalal is and finalises the deal. Jethalal takes all his friends on a conference call to give them the good news.

3374.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3374.description: Jethalal and Bagha prepare the godown to welcome his Gokuldham friends. Soon, everyone arrives at the godown to discuss when and where to organise Jethalal's success party.

3375.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3375.description: Popatlal agrees to host Jethalal's success party at his flat but puts forward a condition. Everyone tries to find a way to convince their wives to allow them for a boys' night out.

3376.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3376.description: Jethalal returns to the society early so he can take permission from Komal and Madhvi for the party. Will he manage to convince them to allow their husbands for a night out?

3377.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3377.description: Jethalal calls Bhide to tell him that Madhvi has permitted him to have a night out. However, everyone gets worried as Jethalal has to request Roshan and Babita, who are known to be very strict. Will mission permission be a success?

3378.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3378.description: Jethalal returns to his godown being the bearer of bad news that Anjali has denied Taarak permission to attend the party. Taarak decides to call his beloved wife to get her permission in a different way. Will Jethalal and the gang get to celebrate his success together?

3379.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3379.description: With everyone's wives permitting them to join the party, Jethalal orders an expensive bottle for them to enjoy. Now, the only thing that remains is Bapuji's permission.

3380.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3380.description: Jethalal lies to Bapuji and leaves for Popatlal's home to attend the party. However, Bapuji catches Jethalal in the society with the bottle of alcohol. Will the boys be able to party in peace?

3381.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3381.description: Jethalal manages to sneak into Popatlal's house so they can begin their party. The Mahila Mandal sends an important video message to their husbands, who decided to party separately.

3382.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3382.description: The men get excited and share poetry to get their party started. All their hopes go down the drain when Jethalal drops and breaks the bottle. Will they have the party that they worked so hard for?

3383.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3383.description: Champaklal confronts the male members of the society after hearing the commotion caused by Sodhi and Popatlal. With nowhere else to go for the party-sharty, Sodhi comes up with an idea, but will this plan work out?

3384.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3384.description: The men of Gokuldham Society flee their party set up on the pavement when they hear the siren of a police car. The dejected men return to join the Mahila Mandal at their party.

3385.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3385.description: All the male members of the Gokuldham Society remain disheartened because of their failed plans. Later, Champaklal is on the verge of finding out about Jethalal's party sharty.

3386.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3386.description: Popatlal and Bhide argue with each other over garbage issues in society. Bhide plays a prank on Popatlal which angers him and he decides to take his revenge.

3387.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3387.description: Popatlal apologises to Bhide in order to seek help regarding his KYC. Later, inspite of being asked to return home early by his mother, Goli takes several detours with Gogi.

3388.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3388.description: Gogi and Goli find a lost and homeless kitten in the park. With no other option in mind, they decide to take the kitten home for its safety. What will happen now?

3389.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3389.description: Tapu Sena struggles to find a house for Kitty. They contemplate taking it to their house but are worried about how their parents will react. Will they find a house for Kitty?

3390.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3390.description: Goli's parents do not allow keeping Kitty at their house. Tapu and Sonu go to Popatlal's house with hopes. Will he keep Kitty at his house?

3391.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3391.description: Tapu Sena is looking for Kitty, but she is nowhere to be found. Tapu comes up with a plan to keep Kitty in the society, which involves convincing Bhide. Will Bhide get convinced?

3392.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3392.description: Bhide and the other society members get annoyed at the fact that a cat was causing destruction to property in the colony and they look for the elusive cat. Meanwhile, the children of the society decide to let Kitty go before the adults get angry.

3393.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3393.description: Tapu scares Bhide, who entered the clubhouse while Goli, Gogi and Sonu try to sneak out a few items from their respective houses for Kitty. Will Tapu Sena succeed in hiding Kitty?

3394.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3394.description: Bhide questions Goli, Gogi and Sonu as they return to the clubhouse. Later, Goli tries to keep Abdul deviated, as he searches the clubhouse for the cat. Will Abdul find out about Pom Pom?

3395.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3395.description: With Abdul on their side, Tapu Sena celebrates Pom Pom staying at the clubhouse. Later, the family that arrives at Gokuldham Society, to meet Popatlal, refuses to step any further after Pom Pom crosses their path.

3396.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3396.description: A worried Abdul tells Taarak and Anjali that Pom Pom, the kitten, has scared away Popatlal's guests. Tapu Sena hides her at their clubhouse. What will happen when Popatlal finds out?

3397.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3397.description: In the light of recent events, Popatlal forces Bhide to resign from the post of secretary. Everyone tries to calm Bhide and Popatlal, who won't stop fighting.

3398.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3398.description: With Popatlal hell-bent on getting rid of the cat, Tapu Sena comes up with a plan to save her. Popatlal suggests that they use Bapuji as a cat detector to find Pom Pom.

3399.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3399.description: Everyone at Gokuldham society is worried about the situation caused by the cat. Goli sneaks out in the middle of the night to check on Pom Pom.

3400.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3400.description: Dr Hathi and Komal wake up to realise that Goli is missing from the house. Abdul prevents Bhide from entering the clubhouse where Pom Pom is kept hidden by Tapu Sena.

3401.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3401.description: Sonu calls Tapu to inform him that her father is on his way to get the box in which Pom Pom resides. Everyone believes Abdul's lie that Gokuldham is now cat-free. What will Tapu Sena do when their lies are caught?

3402.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3402.description: Popatlal shows his appreciation for Bhide's quick action to make the society cat-free. Abdul and Tapu Sena worry about their situation after lying to the members of Gokuldham.

3403.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3403.description: Tapu Sena frantically chases Pom Pom around Gokuldham Society. Pom Pom, who is in a playful mood, sneaks into one flat after another. Will it get caught?

3404.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3404.description: Pom Pom enters Sodhi's house and breaks his bottles, and eats Roshan's cupcakes. He gets furious and confronts Bhide and Abdul about the cat. Will Tapu Sena's lies get caught?

3405.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3405.description: Everyone gets shocked when Popatlal informs them that his guests will soon arrive. Tapu Sena finds out that Pom Pom has made its way to Popatlal's house through the terrace.

3406.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3406.description: With Popatlal out to find a bouquet for his guests, Pom Pom wreaks havoc in his house. Tapu Sena enlists Abdul's help to get into Popatlal's house to retrieve Pom Pom. Will they manage to hide Pom Pom before Popatlal returns?

3407.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3407.description: Popatlal asks Bhide to join him in welcoming his guests to the Gokuldham Society. Tapu Sena runs into multiple problems while looking for Pom Pom. Will Popatlal's meeting go smoothly?

3408.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3408.description: Popatlal's guests get furious when they spot Pom Pom and leave Gokuldham in anger. Popatlal feels betrayed and is out to get his revenge. Will Tapu Sena come forward with the truth?

3409.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3409.description: Tapu Sena tells everyone about how they adopted Pom Pom. Popatlal realises his anger is misdirected and expresses his gratitude to everyone for saving him from a superstitious family.

3410.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3410.description: The Gokuldham family band together to find Pom Pom so they can welcome her to the society. However, they find Pom Pom with a group of other cats and decide to let them be together.

3411.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3411.description: Sonu gets scared to ask her father for permission to visit Lonavala with Tapu Sena. The men of the Gouldham Society meet at Abdul's shop and talk about Tapu Sena's absence from the society.

3412.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3412.description: The men of the Gokuldham Society sit at the soda shop and discuss their lives. Bhide and Madhavi spot Bapuji talking to himself on his balcony.

3413.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3413.description: Bapuji's childhood friend calls him out of the blue and invites him for a night out. Popatlal invites Jethalal, who will be alone, to his house for dinner.

3414.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3414.description: Bagha declines Babita's call on Jethalal's phone as he was preoccupied with a client call. Popatlal and Babita put Jethalal in a spot where he has to decide at whose house will he have dinner. Who will Jethalal choose?

3415.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3415.description: Jethalal comes home early to return Babita's mixer grinder and see Bapuji off. Jethalal and Popatlal enjoy a lavish feast together.

3416.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3416.description: Everyone takes an evening walk to visit a kulfi store after their dinner. Sodhi returns from his party and is desperate to tell Jethalal what he saw.

3417.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3417.description: After Sodhi tells everyone what he saw, Jethalal refuses to believe him. Sodhi narrates everything that happened and tries to convince them.

3418.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3418.description: When no one believes his story, Sodhi convinces everyone to sniff Bapuji to find out the truth. After finding no trace of alcohol from Bapuji, the members of the society force Sodhi to apologise.

3419.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3419.description: Bapuji complains about a headache and acidity to Jethalal. All the men of Gokuldham Society gather at Jethalal's house to take care of Bapuji.

3420.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3420.description: Jethalal has to leave Bapuji alone as he has to visit Pune for a client meeting. Bapuji forces him to stay in Pune for the night. What could Bapuji be up to?

3421.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3421.description: To prove he is right, Sodhi and Popatlal decide to follow Bapuji. After witnessing Bapuji's actions, Sodhi and Popatlal refuse to believe their eyes.

3422.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3422.description: Sodhi and Popatlal follow Bapuji into a bar. They call everyone so that they can see the truth with their own eyes.

3423.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3423.description: Sodhi and Popatlal tell everyone what they saw at the bar. They hide in the garden and record Bapuji entering the society in a drunken state.

3424.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3424.description: The men of Gokuldham worry about how to break the news of Bapuji's night out to Jethalal. Jethalal returns from his meeting and suspects that all his friends are hiding something from him.

3425.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3425.description: Jethalal returns from his client meeting in Pune to discover that Bapuji is still unwell. Taarak gathers everyone at Popatlal's house so they can plan and break the news of Bapuji's nightly escapades to Jethalal.

3426.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3426.description: Jethalal gets shocked when he finds out about Bapuji's drinking habit. Everyone discusses how they can help Bapuji get rid of his addiction.

3427.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3427.description: Jethalal struggles to confront Bapuji about his drinking habit. He goes back to his friends, seeking help for the same.

3428.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3428.description: Sodhi locks Jethalal in a room and comes up with a secret plan to confront Bapuji. The Mahila Mandal gets shocked when they find out about Bapuji's activities.

3429.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3429.description: Bapuji introduces his childhood friends to the Purush Mandal and comes clean about his actions. All of Jethalal's friends try to keep Bapuji away from a drunk Jethalal.

3430.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3430.description: Bapuji clears all the confusion about his newfound habit. However, the issue of a drunk Jethalal still persists. Can Jethalal's friends get him out of this mess before Bapuji finds out?

3431.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3431.description: Dr Hathi gets medicine for Jethalal that will bring him back to his senses. Bapuji gets extremely angry at the Purush Mandal for handling the situation poorly. How will everyone manage to calm Bapuji?

3432.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3432.description: Bapuji clears everyone's misunderstanding about his nightly escapades. The Purush Mandal apologises to Bapuji for accusing him of drinking without confronting him.

3433.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3433.description: Sonu returns from her Lonavala trip bearing gifts for her parents. Jethalal tells about his eventful day to his friends while sipping soda at Abdul's shop.

3434.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3434.description: Jethalal apologises to Inspector Pandey for the misinformation he had, due to which he had to call the police. To bring about some change, Jethalal decides to prepare soda for his friends by himself.

3435.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3435.description: Everyone at Gokuldham is dealing with the problem of having too much old stuff at home. Bhola Bhai comes to the rescue to collect the 'Bhangaar' from everyone's homes.

3436.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3436.description: Bhide stops Madhavi from giving away his prized possession to the 'bhangar wala'. When Jethalal brings Bhide's old music system for repair, Bagha gets worried about the situation.

3437.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3437.description: Bagha tells Jethalal how he managed to repair Bhide's tape recorder. Bhide asks Abdul to gather everyone at the clubhouse so they can enjoy some old music together.

3438.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3438.description: When Bhide tries to turn on his music system, it does not work. Bagha uses all his skills to figure out the problem so everyone can sing and dance to old Bollywood music.

3439.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3439.description: The members of Gokuldham Society continue to enjoy old Bollywood songs at the clubhouse. Everyone appreciates the soulful music of that era.

3440.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3440.description: The members of Gokuldham Society continue to sing along and dance to their favourite old songs. They reminisce and talk about the famous singers and songwriters of the yesteryears.
