3441.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3441.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society thank Bhide for a memorable musical night. Everyone returns home in a happy and fun mood.

3442.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3442.description: Bapuji watches the news to find out that the price of lemons has shot up. Meanwhile, Bhide receives an order for lime pickles. How will Bhide manage to complete this order?

3443.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3443.description: Bhide reaches a dead end while trying to procure the money that his clients owe him. Meanwhile, everyone at Gokuldham society struggles to find lemons. Will Bhide and Madhvi manage to fulfil the order?

3444.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3444.description: Bhide, under immense stress, almost runs over Popatlal with his Sakharam. Later, a mysterious delivery van drops three sacks at Bhide's residence. What could it be?

3445.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3445.description: Jethalal advises Bhide to get rid of the lemons before he gets in trouble with the police for hoarding them. Madhvi realises that the delivery of the lemons was meant for them.

3446.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3446.description: Bhide and Madhvi decide to sell the remaining lemons at a lower price. They fail to find a suitable buyer for the large number of lemons they have left. Who will buy them?

3447.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3447.description: After Jethalal finds out that Bagha is planning to sell lemons, they quickly return them to Bhide before getting in trouble for hoarding. Bhide gets worried about what to do with the lemons. Will he find a solution?

3448.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3448.description: Bhide goes on a calling spree, trying to find a buyer for his lemons. However, most people either don't believe him or aren't interested in his offer. Will Bhide manage to get rid of the stock of lemons?

3449.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3449.description: As Bhide goes to meet the mysterious man who is interested in buying his entire stock of lemons, he gets stopped by the police. The police try to arrest him first but soon realise that the main culprit here is the 'Jamakhor' who called Bhide. Can they nab this public hoarder?

3450.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3450.description: After Guddu Khatila dodges the police, he provokes Sodhi and Bhide. Guddu's men try to catch Sodhi and Bhide to get revenge on them for calling the police. Will Inspector Pandey arrive in time to save them?

3451.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3451.description: The Purush Mandal enjoys a glass of lemon soda at Abdul's shop. Jethalal reminds Bhide about writing the thought of the day on the board.

3452.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3452.description: Bhide angers Madhvi with his antics. Popatlal arrives at Bhide's house and offers him to help cheer Madhvi up. However, Bhide refuses and decides to turn Madhvi's frown into a smile by himself.

3453.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3453.description: The Mahila Mandal shops for vegetables together at the cart in the morning. They get excited after hearing Bhide's plan to shop at the mall and try to convince their husbands to take them to the sale. Will the Purush Mandal agree?

3454.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3454.description: All the couples of Gokuldham Society get together and set out to shop at the mall. A postman shows up at the society looking for Bhide. Will Bhide arrive in time to collect his letter?

3455.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3455.description: Popatlal joins Babita and Iyer for breakfast. They find out that the marriage bureau had the wrong information about Popatlal. How will Popatlal handle the situation?

3456.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3456.description: Popatlal takes Bhide's help to rush to Jethalal's shop so he can get his phone repaired. Bagha helps with a replacement phone for Popatlal. Will Popatlal receive the call he has been waiting for?

3457.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3457.description: Popatlal gets tired of waiting for Pratiksha and asks the marriage bureau for her contact number. To kill time, Popatlal reads Pratiskha's bio with Tapu Sena.

3458.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3458.description: Popatlal gets an invitation from Pratiksha to meet her. He requests all his friends to get dressed in yellow and come along with him.

3459.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3459.description: Popatlal convinces everyone at Gokuldham to get dressed in a dress code. Everyone wears yellow and gets ready to meet Pratiksha and her family.

3460.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3460.description: Sodhi arranges a minibus for the Gokuldham members to travel together to Pratiksha's house. However, they face some difficulty in finding where she lives. Will they manage to find her?

3461.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3461.description: The Gokuldham members are greeted by Mr Puri's secretary. Everyone introduces themselves to Pratiksha's family.

3462.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3462.description: Babita suggests that Popatlal and Pratiksha should talk to each other in private. Jethalal gives his phone number to Mr Puri before the Gokuldam family takes their leave.

3463.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3463.description: Popatlal expresses his gratitude to everyone for accompanying him.  He has trouble falling asleep as he feels anxious about the Puri family's thoughts about him.

3464.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3464.description: Popatlal wakes Sodhi and Bhide as he is unable to sleep due to a dog barking. Sodhi arranges for a medicine that will help Popatlal to sleep.

3465.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3465.description: The colony members are excited to get Popatlal ready for his meeting with his to-be wife. Popatlal however, isn't opening his door nor is he answering his phone. Where could Popatlal be?

3466.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3466.description: Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house to wait for Mr Puri's phone call. However, Popatlal is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

3467.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3467.description: The Puri family calls Popatlal to tell him that they want Pratiksha to get married to him. However, they also reveal a shocking fact about Pratiksha's past. Will Popatlal look past it and accept the Puri family's proposal?

3468.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3468.description: All members of the Gokuldham Society get ready to meet the Puri family and give them the shagun. Sodhi arranges a bus for the Gokuldham family to travel together.

3469.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3469.description: The Gokuldham family makes a grand entry into the Puri family's mansion. After Pratiksha shows up, Popatlal asks her an important question. What answer will Popatlal receive?

3470.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3470.description: Popatlal reveals that he knows who Pratiksha is in love with. He later asks Pratiksha to give her final decision. Will Popatlal receive the answer he wants to hear?

3471.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3471.description: Popatlal gets in touch with Pratiksha's ex-husband and informs him about the wedding. What drama will unfold when Paresh lands up at the venue?

3472.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3472.description: With Popatlal and Bapuji's help, Pratiksha and Paresh reconcile their love. Babita and Anjali play a friendly game of badminton.

3473.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3473.description: Jethalal and Babita's badminton match begins. Jethalal reaches home late and finds Bapuji sleeping on the couch.

3474.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3474.description: Bhide receives a consignment of mangoes. He distributes it among his friends for everyone to enjoy.

3475.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3475.description: Jethalal finds out that the daily newspaper did not get delivered in the morning. Later, he gets a piece of annoying news about his shop. What could it be about?

3476.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3476.description: Jethalal shares his worries about his shop with Sodhi, Bhide and Popatlal. Later, when Jethalal meets his contractor, he receives a piece of good news. What could it be?

3477.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3477.description: Jethalal invites a famous astrologer to help him find the most auspicious time to re-open his shop. What suggestions will this astrologer give?

3478.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3478.description: Jethalal invites friends and family over for the re-opening of his shop. Will everything go smooth for Jethalal?

3479.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3479.description: Jethalal is excited about his shop's reopening and invites all his neighbours and friends. Meanwhile, Sundar promises to bring Daya back to the colony for the reopening.

3480.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3480.description: Sundar gets into a dilemma as he struggles to gather the courage and tell Jethalal that Daya won't be turning up for the inauguration. Meanwhile, a famous newspaper editor pays a visit to Gokuldham society.

3481.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3481.description: Jethalal invites all his friends and asks them to get to the venue on time. Meanwhile, Bagha creates a special list for Jethalal to personally call and invite. Will they accept his invitation?

3482.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3482.description: The members of Gokuldham try to think of a thoughtful gift for Jethalal on the occasion of his shop's reopening. What will they get him?

3483.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3483.description: Jethalal gives an invitation to all his friends for the reopening of his shop. Meanwhile, Sundar comes up with a plan to get Daya for the shop reopening. How will he manage that?

3484.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3484.description: Jethalal eagerly waits for his wife and can't contain his excitement. Can Sundar deliver his promise?

3485.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3485.description: Jethalal comes to know that Daya won't be coming to Gokuldham for the shop's reopening. How will Jethalal react to this heartbreaking news?

3486.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3486.description: The Gokuldham society members are elated and excited to be a part of the reopening of Gada Electronics. Will the event go as planned?

3487.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3487.description: Bhide tells Jethalal that he is unable to find Bapuji in the temple. Jethalal decides to report to Inspector Pandey that Bapuji has gone missing. Where could Bapuji have gone?

3488.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3488.description: Bapuji inaugurates the renovated Gada Electronics shop in the nick of time as everyone celebrates Jethalal's happiness.

3489.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3489.description: Jethalal apologises to Inspector Pandey for failing to inform him that Bapuji wasn't missing. Jethalal and Bagha get excited to begin working in their new shop.

3490.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3490.description: Sundar gives Jethalal a business proposition. How will Jethalal respond to the proposal?

3491.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3491.description: Goli accidentally breaks Jethalal's window while playing cricket. Will Jethalal get consumed in anger or forgive Tapu Sena?

3492.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3492.description: To cheer Tapu Sena after the accident in the morning, Jethalal surprises them with a thoughtful gift. They return the favour by treating Jethalal with his favourite savouries.

3493.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3493.description: Jethalal's friend asks him for financial help, which he agrees to provide. However, Jethalal finds out that he does not have that money with him. How will he help his friend?

3494.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3494.description: Bagha collects five lakh rupees cash from Mr Deepak and gets it to the shop safely. However, Bapuji informs Jethalal that they have to leave early for a birthday party.

3495.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3495.description: Bagha takes the help of Magan to secure the cash kept at the shop. However, Bagha's troubles get doubled as Jethalal gets stuck at a birthday party.

3496.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3496.description: Jaggu wakes Jethalal in the middle of the night to tell him that someone is trying to rob his shop. How will Jethalal save his shop?

3497.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3497.description: Inspector Pandey makes sure that he has all the information before taking any action. Will he manage to solve the case?

3498.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3498.description: The thief reveals that he was ordered by Nattu Kaka to help Jethalal. After Jethalal requests Inspector Pandey to let the thief go, Pandey Ji decides never to accept any case from the residents of Gokuldham Society.

3499.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3499.description: The new Nattu Kaka is the first to arrive at the shop and makes a grand entry. Jethalal and Bagha welcome him to their family with open arms.

3500.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3500.description: Jethalal treats all his friends to a soda party at Abdul's shop. Popatlal catches Bhide for not being able to come up with a thought for the day.

3501.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3501.description: Everyone discusses what should be an appropriate thought for the day. A mysterious boy enters the Gokuldham Society and claims to know Sodhi. Who could it be?

3502.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3502.description: Sodhi raises his concerns about Bittu's suspicious behaviour. Bittu opens up about the troubles he is facing at school and home. How will Sodhi deal with the situation?

3503.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3503.description: Bittu threatens to run away if he gets forced to continue studying. He later helps Sodhi at his garage. Has Bittu found his passion?

3504.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3504.description: Nattu Kaka comes up with a marketing plan to increase sales for Gada electronics. Meanwhile, Sodhi takes Tapu Sena and Bittu to a mall.

3505.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3505.description: Due to the rains, Bhide shifts the soda meeting to the clubhouse. Bhide convinces everyone to take responsibility for helping Bittu. Will they succeed?

3506.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3506.description: After Bittu runs away, Sodhi takes Goli's help to track and find him. Everyone sits with Bittu and tries to counsel him. Will he understand what the grown-ups have to say?

3507.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3507.description: The colony members are worried about Bittu running away due to his hatred towards studying. Will Bittu be found and will he finally realise the importance of education?

3508.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3508.description: Bittu finally realises his mistakes and agrees to concentrate on his studies. Meanwhile, his parents come and are shocked to see the difference in their son.

3509.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3509.description: The society members struggle to keep up with the rising cost of living in the city. Popatlal receives a call from the bank asking him to clear his locker and take his belongings before the branch shuts down.

3510.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3510.description: Popatlal lives a paranoid life because of not having a locker for his jewellery. Can the Gokuldham residents find him a locker?

3511.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3511.description: Popatlal spends sleepless nights in his house thinking about his jewellery's safety. He finally comes to the conclusion that he must keep the box in one of his neighbour's houses.

3512.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3512.description: Popatlal decides to keep the jewellery box at Bhide's house. However, Bhide later finds out that Popatlal is going out of town. Will Bhide be able to keep the jewellery safe?

3513.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3513.description: Bhide gets paranoid after getting Popatlal's jewellery and desperately looks for someone else to pass on the responsibility. Who will he find?

3514.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3514.description: Jethalal tries to pass on the responsibility of the jewellery by giving the box to Babita. Will Popatlal's jewellery get mishandled?

3515.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3515.description: Babita passes on the responsibility of the jewellery to Anjali, as she and Iyer have to go somewhere. Will Anjali keep the box or will the exchange of hands continue?

3516.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3516.description: Popatlal's jewellery ends up at Sodhi's house. However, due to an emergency, Sodhi has to rush to his garage. Will the box be safe at Sodhi's house?

3517.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3517.description: Popatlal returns after finishing his work and thanks Bhide for keeping his jewellery safely. How will he react when he finds out the truth?

3518.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3518.description: Everyone tries to get Popatlal's box back from the person they gave it to. Jethalal begins to get a bad feeling about the jewellery box. Will his fears come true?

3519.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3519.description: Sodhi and his wife realise that they have messed up and given away the box of jewellery to Abdul without informing him what's in it. Can the Sodhis recover the box?

3520.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3520.description: All the residents of Gokuldham society panic as they start blaming each other for the missing Jewellery box. Can they manage to find the box and return it to Popatlal?

3521.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3521.description: Bhide panics at the thought of Popatlal finding out that he has lost his jewellery box, but the society members reassure him that they all will take responsibility for the mistake. Will they find the jewellery or face Popatlal's wrath?

3522.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3522.description: Bhide and Jethalal make excuses in front of Popatlal to delay giving the box. Will Popatlal fall for their lies?

3523.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3523.description: The society members are shocked to see Popatlal with Sodhi's party sharty bag with the jewellery in it. How did Popatlal get his hands on it?

3524.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3524.description: After everyone finds the empty jewellery box, they call Bhide to ensure it contains jewellery. How will the members of Gokuldham find the jewellery?

3525.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3525.description: Jethalal and Sodhi take Tapu Sena's help to distract Popatlal. The members of Gokuldham meet Inspector Pandey and tell him about the theft.

3526.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3526.description: The members of Gokuldham Society give Inspector Pandey a list of suspects in the robbery. The police are quick to respond and round up the suspects. Will they find Popatlal's jewellery?

3527.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3527.description: Inspector Pandey's investigation reveals that the suspects are not guilty of the theft. He insists on checking every household of the Gokuldham members. What will he find?

3528.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3528.description: Jethalal gets arrested when Popatlal's jewellery is found at his house. Everyone apologises to Inspector Pandey and requests him to let Jethalal go.

3529.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3529.description: Tapu Sena is surprised to hear about the gold being recovered at Jethalal's home. Meanwhile, Jethalal arranges a locker for Popatlal.

3530.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3530.description: Bhide receives a piece of good news early in the morning. He decides to surprise his family and take Sodhi's help.

3531.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3531.description: Goli tells Tapu Sena about Bhide's plan to buy a car. When Sonu does not believe the news, they plan to put on a disguise to follow Sodhi and Bhide to find out the truth.

3532.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3532.description: Sodhi takes Bhide to a used car shop to look at all the cars that fall into his budget. Goli and Pinku follow them around to find the truth. Which car will Bhide choose?

3533.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3533.description: Sonu does not believe Goli when he tells her that Bhide has bought a car. Goli also lets Popatlal know about Bhide's surprise. How will Popatlal react?

3534.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3534.description: Everyone gathers at Popatlal's house to discuss Bhide's surprise. Jethalal returns home and lets Bapuji in on the news.

3535.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3535.description: Bhide can't wait to surprise his family with the new car, but how will his family react to this? Meanwhile, Tapu Sena plans on putting the 'Tiranga' in every house.

3536.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3536.description: The members of Gokuldham Society make preparations to welcome Bhide's new car. Bhide and Sodhi get shocked when they see the car enter the society. What could have gone wrong?

3537.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3537.description: Bhide shocks everyone by telling them that he was only helping a friend buy a car. Soon, Bhide reveals his real surprise for his wife and daughter. Later, the members of Gokuldham gather to celebrate 75 years of independence.

3538.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3538.description: Roshan goes out of town to meet her family but warns Sodhi not to do 'party-sharty' at home. Will Sodhi go behind her back and break the rules?

3539.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3539.description: The Gokuldham society members get together and celebrate Nowruz with Roshan. Meanwhile, Sodhi and his friends contemplate their 'party-sharty' plan.

3540.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3540.description: Sodhi plans a party with his friends in Roshan's absence. Will he get caught?

3541.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3541.description: Roshan finally gets to know about Sodhi's elaborate plan and how everyone was involved in it. Later, the entire colony prays for each other's well-being.

3542.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3542.description: The members of Gokuldham society make preparations to celebrate Janmashtami. Will everything go smooth?

3543.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3543.description: The members of the Gokuldham colony are excited to start the 'Dahi handi' proceedings. Will everything go smooth?

3544.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3544.description: Things get competitive in the Gokuldham colony as all the participants try to break the Handi. Who will win the competition?

3545.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3545.description: Bapuji is starving and asks Jethalal to order food for him, but Jethalal informs him that Komal would be sending them breakfast. However, when the breakfast arrives, Jethalal gets shocked to see the contents.

3546.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3546.description: Jethalal gets frustrated with Bagha and Nattu Kaka when they delay giving him some good news. What's waiting in line for Jethalal?

3547.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3547.description: Jethalal is excited about the opportunity of going to the United States of America. Will he be able to leave on such short notice?

3548.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3548.description: Jethalal shares his happiness with all the colony members. Meanwhile, Bhide is still upset about Popatlal's taunts

3549.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3549.description: Jethalal prepares for his journey to the United States of America. Will Jethalal's trip be successful?

3550.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3550.description: The members of Gokuldham colony visit Jethalal with various requests, before he leaves for America. How will Jethalal react to this?

3551.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3551.description: All the neighbours come to see off Jethalal before his departure for America. However, they are worried if Bapuji will be okay while living alone.

3552.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3552.description: The society members call for a meeting to work out a plan on how to take care of Bapuji during Jethalal's absence.

3553.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3553.description: As Jethalal leaves for the United States, Bapuji becomes lonely at home. Will he be okay during his time alone?

3554.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3554.description: All the neighbours come to support Bapuji as she spends his first night alone.

3555.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3555.description: Bapuji makes a plan to meet his childhood friend for breakfast, but knowing how the Gokuldham colony is, will he make it on time?

3556.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3556.description: Everyone in the colony goes out of their way to take care of Bapuji. Will everything go smooth?

3557.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3557.description: Bapuji doesn't open his door or answer his phone and sends the entire colony into panic mode. Is Bapuji alright?

3558.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3558.description: Bapuji gets fed up with his neighbours being over-enthusiastic about taking care of him. Will they be understanding and take a step back?

3559.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3559.description: The Gokuldham Colony members are excited about welcoming Bappa. Will everything go according to plan?

3560.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3560.description: Gokuldham colony welcomes Bappa with an open heart. How will they celebrate this auspicious occasion?

3561.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3561.description: The members of the Gokuldham colony celebrate Bappa's arrival but Anjali expresses her concerns about Taarak not being with her on this auspicious occasion.

3562.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3562.description: Anjali is upset about Taarak not being around during Ganpati but will his gift make up for it?

3563.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3563.description: The entire colony is surprised to see Taarak return for the Ganpati celebrations. Meanwhile, Sodhi, Popatlal and Hathi want to know Bhide's questions in advance.

3564.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3564.description: The entire colony prepares for the Rangarang Karyakram. Will everything go smooth during the function?

3565.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3565.description: Gokuldham residents begin the Rangarang Karyakram and invite a special guest to host the entire program. Who will the special guest be?

3566.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3566.description: Sugandha plays a fun quiz with the Gokuldham residents about the famous temples of India. Who will score the most points and win the game?

3567.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3567.description: The Rangarang Karyakram continues as Sugandha quizzes Babita, Madhavi and Bhide about the famous heritage sites in India. Will they be able to answer all the questions correctly?

3568.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3568.description: Sodhi, Popatlal, and Anjali are next in line to participate in Sugandha's quiz. Will they be able to answer all the questions correctly?

3569.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3569.description: Tapu Sena, Iyer, and Taarak take on the challenge of answering all the quiz questions correctly. Will they be successful?

3570.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3570.description: Abdul delivers a surprise performance for the Rangarang Karyakram. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha are next in line for the quiz.

3571.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3571.description: Anjali catches Taarak eating samosas with Tapu Sena. Meanwhile, Taarak gets the responsibility of holding Shradh for his late father. Will Taarak be able to perform this important ritual properly?

3572.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3572.description: Taarak and the society members prepare for his father's Shradh. Will everything go smooth?

3573.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3573.description: Taarak is worried as he can't find crows to eat his offerings. Gogi, Pinku, and the others offer their help to make the Shradh successful. Will things go in Taarak's favour this time?

3574.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3574.description: Taarak finally finds a few crows to eat the Shradh food, but Sodhi unknowingly scares them away. When Taarak is about to lose all hope, Abdul comes up with a unique solution. Will Abdul's idea work?

3575.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3575.description: Taarak and the others make their way to a park to look for crows. However, things take a turn for the worse when a thief steals Taarak's phone. What will he do now?

3576.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3576.description: Jethalal's family and friends are eagerly waiting for him to return from his USA trip. However, no one has spoken to him in the past two days. Will Jethalal return home safely?

3577.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3577.description: Jethalal returns to India without informing about his arrival to any of the society members. Will he return home safely?

3578.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3578.description: After returning from the USA, three thieves rob Jethalal and steal all of his belongings. What will he do now?

3579.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3579.description: Jethalal tries to file a complaint at the police station about the robbery. But Chalu Pandey refuses to take his complaint and locks him up instead. What will happen now?

3580.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3580.description: Chalu Pandey lets Jethalal, and the others go after listening to their explanation. Jethalal reaches Gokuldham and decides to surprise Bapuji.

3581.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3581.description: Jethalal brings a special shirt for Bapuji from his US trip. However, Jethalal is unaware that someone has mistakenly replaced the shirt with a frock. What will happen now?

3582.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3582.description: Jethalal calls Taarak at his office, which puts Taarak's job at risk. How will he handle this situation?

3583.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3583.description: Gokuldham residents are eagerly waiting for the Navratri celebrations to begin. Meanwhile, Jethalal finds it difficult to fit into his old Garba dress.

3584.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3584.description: Jethalal wants to perform the first aarti of Navratri to pray for Daya's return. However, Bhide says that he has to take permission from all society members first. Will the society members accept his request?

3585.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3585.description: Jethalal gets the opportunity to perform the first aarti of Navratri. However, he gets called to Lonavala for an important meeting. What will happen now?

3586.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3586.description: Everyone begins to worry, as Jethalal is getting late for the aarti. Will Jethalal be able to get back in time?

3587.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3587.description: Jethalal manages to reach on time and performs the first aarti of Navratri. Later, all the Gokuldham residents play Garba together.

3589.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3589.description: Bhide shares his mantra for savings with Tapu Sena. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha remind Jethalal about submitting his maintenance cheque.

3590.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3590.description: Bhide celebrates when Jethalal brings the maintenance cheque on time. However, a silly mistake by Jethalal quickly spoils the celebration.

3591.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3591.description: Bhide finds out that Tapu is about to return to Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Nattu Kaka about spoiling his maintenance cheque.

3592.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3592.description: Jethalal brings Bapuji to Dr Hathi's clinic to treat his stomach ache. Meanwhile, Gokuldham society members are worried about the moss build-up in the society compound.

3593.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3593.description: Dr Hathi slips and falls in the society compound because of the moss build-up. Will the society members be able to lift him up?

3594.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3594.description: Sodhi comes up with a unique solution to lift Dr Hathi up from the ground. Will his plan work?

3595.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3595.description: The members of Gokuldham society decide to repaint the colony but Bhide struggles to find a contractor who is ready to do the job before Diwali. Can a solution be found?

3596.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3596.description: The members of Gokuldham society interview multiple contractors and ask for their budget for repainting their colony. Will a suitable contractor be found on time?

3597.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3597.description: Tapu Sena helps Abdul test the new firecrackers at his shop. Meanwhile, the committee members gather at the clubhouse to finalize a contractor.

3598.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3598.description: Society members sit down for a meeting to select the best contractor out of the top four. Will they be able to make a sound decision?

3599.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3599.description: After interviewing all the contractors, the society members decide to shortlist one. Who will be the one to get the job?

3600.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3600.description: Gokuldham residents decide to give the contract for painting the society to Raju Chamke. Will things go according to plan?

3601.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3601.description: The painting job in Gokuldham begins in full zest. However, Bhide is anxious about things going wrong. Will all of his worries come true?

3602.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3602.description: Gokuldham residents are excited to celebrate Diwali in the newly painted society. But will the contractor be able to complete the work on time?

3603.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3603.description: The contractor gives Bhide the bad news and tells him that the painting job won't get finished on time. What will Bhide do now?

3604.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3604.description: Bhide is ready to face everyone's anger when the painting job gets delayed. However, he gets a surprise once he steps out of his house.

3605.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3605.description: After the painting job gets completed, all Gokuldham residents celebrate Diwali together. The next day, Huma Qureshi and Sonakshi Sinha arrive at Gokuldham to meet Dr Hathi.

3606.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3606.description: Bapuji treats Tapu Sena with pizzas to reward them for saving the Diwali celebrations. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to penalize Jethalal if he doesn't pay the maintenance cheque on time.

3607.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3607.description: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about giving the maintenance cheque. However, Bhide arrives at Jethalal's house and his lie comes out in front of everyone.

3608.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3608.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka request Jethalal to sign some cheques. Later, Babita shows up at Jethalal's shop with some of her friends.

3609.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3609.description: Jethalal apologises to Bhide for not submitting the maintenance cheque on time. However, Bhide is adamant that if Jethalal doesn't pay the penalty, he will resign from the secretary post.

3610.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3610.description: Bhide agrees to accompany Jethalal and Taarak to the medical store. But he is unaware that it was all a trick to give him the maintenance cheque. What will Bhide do when he finds out the truth?

3611.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3611.description: Madhavi tells Bhide that she accidentally washed the kurta that the cheque was in. What will happen when Jethalal finds out about this?

3612.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3612.description: Sodhi and his family celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti with all Gokuldham residents. Meanwhile, Goli is scared as he spills chutney on Sakharam. What will Bhide do when he finds out?

3613.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3613.description: Sodhi and his family continue to celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti and spread happiness among Gokuldham residents.

3614.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3614.description: Tapu Sena decides to take Bapuji out for dinner. Will their dinner plan be successful?

3615.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3615.description: Bapuji wants to go out for dinner with Tapu Sena, but Jethalal is worried about this plan. How will things pan out?

3616.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3616.description: Problems keep piling up one after another, which causes a delay in the dinner plans. Can Tapu Sena and the others reach the restaurant in time?

3617.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3617.description: Jethalal scolds Bagha when a customer complains about him. Later, an important client from abroad contacts Jethalal about a big contract.

3618.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3618.description: Jethalal decides to bring Taarak along with him for the meeting with the international client. However, Taarak refuses as he gets assigned an important task by his boss. What will Jethalal do now?

3619.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3619.description: Taarak decides to make an excuse to dodge office work and attend the meeting with Jethalal. Will this plan work?

3620.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3620.description: Taarak decides to lie to his boss and help Jethalal instead of going to the office. Will Jethalal get into trouble because of this?

3621.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3621.description: Taarak arrives at Jethalal's shop, and all of them await the international client's arrival. Will the business deal go as planned?

3622.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3622.description: Things get complicated for Taarak as his boss reaches Gada Electronics. Will his boss find out that Taarak lied to him about his injury?

3623.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3623.description: Taarak finds out that his boss is headed to his home to surprise him. Taarak rushes back before his boss finds out that he lied about his injury.

3624.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3624.description: Bhide and Abdul try to think of excuses to stop Taarak's boss from entering the society. Meanwhile, Taarak and Jethalal encounter a lot of problems while on their way home.

3625.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3625.description: Doctor Hathi stalls Taarak's boss and takes him to his home. Meanwhile, Taarak encounters even more problems while on his way to Gokuldham. Will Taarak's boss find out about his lie?

3626.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3626.description: Tapu Sena coaxes Taarak's boss to play cricket with them. Will they be able to buy Taarak enough time to return home?

3627.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3627.description: Despite all the efforts from Gokuldham residents, Taarak's boss finally finds his way inside Taarak's house. What will happen when he finds out the truth?

3628.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3628.description: Taarak tells everyone how he safely made it back home. Later, Bhide gets a shock as Sakharam goes missing from the society compound.

3629.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3629.description: Bhide takes Taarak's help to look for Sakharam. Bhide thinks that Jethalal has played a prank on him by taking Sakharam away. Will his hunch prove to be true?

3630.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3630.description: Jethalal's tension begins in the morning as Nattu Kaka and Bagha get late for work. However, the tension seemingly goes away as Jethalal receives an order for two hundred TVs.

3631.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3631.description: Jethalal has to go to Daman for an important meeting, and he gives Bhide the responsibility of taking care of Bapuji. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call from the marriage bureau about a potential match.

3632.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3632.description: Popatlal gets disheartened when things don't work out for him at the marriage bureau. Later, he eavesdrops on Bhide talking to someone about looking for a potential groom. Will Popatlal finally get a match?

3633.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3633.description: Popatlal overhears Bhide's conversation and finds out that his uncle is looking for a suitable groom for his daughter. Will this be the opportunity to get married Popatlal was waiting for?

3634.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3634.description: Popatlal takes help from Gogi and Goli to find Vidya's address and meet her in person. Will Popatlal's plan work?

3635.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3635.description: Popatlal, Gogi and Goli travel to Shiv Ganga village to meet Vidya and propose to her for marriage. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to apologise to Popatlal for his behaviour.

3636.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3636.description: Popatlal decides to meet Vidya at the school where she works as a teacher. Meanwhile, Gogi and Goli's parents begin to grow suspicious about their activities.

3637.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3637.description: Sudhakar is fuming with anger and decides to confront Bhide about Popatlal's actions. What will happen when Popatlal returns to Gokuldham?

3638.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3638.description: Bhide is furious with Popatlal for his actions and chases him all around the colony. What will happen when Bhide finally gets his hands on him?

3639.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3639.description: Popatlal sneaks into Iyer and Babita's house to escape Bhide's wrath. But how long will it be before Bhide catches him?

3640.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3640.description: Popatlal hides inside Taarak's house when Iyer refuses to help him. Meanwhile, Bhide looks everywhere around the society in search of Popatlal. What will happen when Popatlal finally catches up to him?

3641.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3641.description: Taarak tries to lure Bhide away so that Popatlal can escape from the society. Will Popatlal find a safe place to hide?

3642.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3642.description: Bhide starts doubting everyone and thinks that they are helping Popatlal hide. Will someone slip up and reveal the truth?

3643.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3643.description: Bhide is unable to find Popatlal and his friends tell him to leave the matter for now and confront him when he returns. What will happen next?

3644.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3644.description: Sudhakar Mama arrives in Gokuldham society along with other people from his village to confront Bhide and Popatlal. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

3645.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3645.description: Chalu Pandey agrees to find Popatlal on the condition that Bhide will not take the case back under any circumstance. What will Bhide do now?

3646.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3646.description: Gokuldham residents are shocked when they learn that Bhide has filed a police complaint against Popatlal. However, Popatlal is still nowhere to be found. What will happen now?

3647.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3647.description: Chalu Pandey reassures Bhide that they will find Popatlal in time. He thinks that Popatlal is hiding within the society compound and assigns a special agent to sniff him out.

3648.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3648.description: Everyone who helped Popatlal gets forced to reveal the truth in front of Bhide. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

3649.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3649.description: Chalu Pandey and his canine look for Popatlal all over the colony. Can 009 find Popatlal's distinct smell and trace him?

3650.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3650.description: Inspector Pandey catches Popatlal and asks the rest of the members to back off. Will his celebration of catching the first criminal in Gokuldham Society last long?

3651.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3651.description: Sudhakar Mama arrives at Gokuldham along with a group of people from his village. Will Bhide and the others hand over Popatlal to them?

3652.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3652.description: The tables seem to have turned as Sudhakar and Vidya thank Popatlal for opening their eyes. Will Popatlal's wish of getting married finally be fulfilled?

3653.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3653.description: Popatlal proves to be unlucky once again, as he finds out that Vidya loves someone else. Meanwhile, Chalu Pandey is adamant about arresting Bhide, as per their deal.

3654.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3654.description: Sonu prepares breakfast for the special guests that are coming to her house. Bhide and Madhavi are puzzled by the change in her behaviour. Who will the special guests be?

3655.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3655.description: Bhide tells Jethalal and Bapuji about the events that transpired between Popatlal and Sudhakar Mama. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka come up with an innovative offer for increasing sales before the New Year.

3656.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3656.description: Tapu Sena takes Bhide's help to plan a party for New Year's Eve. They decide to let everyone draw chits with a random colour that they would have to wear at the party.

3657.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3657.description: Gokuldham residents come together to celebrate the New Year together. However, Taarak is worried that something might go wrong. Will Taarak's fears come true?

3658.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3658.description: Bhide kicks off the new year by writing the thought of the day in Sanskrit. However, many Gokuldham residents are puzzled by the meaning behind the thought. Who will be able to decipher its true meaning?

3659.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3659.description: Jethalal tries to decipher the meaning behind the thought written in Sanskrit. Meanwhile, Bagha brings good news for Jethalal in the morning.

3660.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3660.description: Jethalal finds out that the profits of Gada Electronics have increased by fifty per cent over the past year. Meanwhile, Bagha rushes to meet Bawri, who has just returned from Kanpur.

3661.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3661.description: Bagha gets worried as Bawri gets late for their date. He goes to Bawri's house to check on her but finds that her house is locked.

3662.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3662.description: Bagha gets depressed when Bawri refuses to talk to him. Will Nattu Kaka and Jethalal be able to cheer up his mood?

3663.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3663.description: Jethalal is anxious as he receives a large order, but Bagha is in no condition to work. Meanwhile, Jethalal seeks Taarak's help to find a solution to this problem.

3664.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3664.description: Bagha runs away from home and is not picking up his phone. Meanwhile, Jethalal gets tensed about completing the order on time.

3665.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3665.description: Jethalal and the others find Bagha inside a bar, drinking away his sorrow. What will happen when Bagha drinks too much?

3666.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3666.description: Bagha creates a ruckus in the society, and no one is able to handle him. What will Gokuldham residents do now?

3667.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3667.description: Taarak and Anjali come up with a plan to get Bagha to step down from the balcony. Will their plan work?

3668.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3668.description: Bagha's drunk antics become a problem for the entire colony. Can a solution be found?

3669.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3669.description: Bagha finally takes a sigh of relief when the real Bawri comes in front of him. However, Jethalal is still worried about completing the order on time.

3670.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3670.description: Jethalal is worried that he has to deliver fifty TVs, but Bagha and Nattu Kaka are not picking up his calls. What will Jethalal do now?

3671.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3671.description: Jethalal loses his ring in the society compound. Will Bhide be able to help him find his ring?

3672.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3672.description: Madhavi tells Bhide that the neighbouring society has experienced some ghostly activities. Meanwhile, Bawri arrives at Gada Electronics to surprise Bagha.

3673.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3673.description: Nattu Kaka and Bagha ask Jethalal to increase their salary. Meanwhile, Taarak gets in trouble with his boss for trying to skip work.

3674.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3674.description: Jethalal gets worried when Taarak does not answer his calls. Later, Taarak calls Anjali to give her a piece of good news.

3675.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3675.description: Taarak calls Jethalal to his house to tell him some good news. What will the good news be?

3676.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3676.description: Taarak burns his yellow shirt while ironing it. He asks his fellow Gokuldham society members for their help.

3677.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3677.description: Taarak borrows Dr Hathi's yellow shirt, and Anjali helps him alter it. Will Taarak's problem finally get solved?

3678.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3678.description: Iyer lends his yellow shirt to Taarak, which fits him perfectly. Gokuldham residents wish him luck for the meeting. Will things go in Taarak's favour?

3679.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3679.description: Taarak gets into an accident in the morning, which spoils his yellow shirt. Everyone blames Jethalal for putting Taarak in that situation. What will happen now?

3680.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3680.description: Bapuji decides to go and talk to Taarak's boss. Later, when Taarak and Bapuji arrive at the office, everyone is shocked to see Taarak's green shirt.

3681.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3681.description: Taarak arrives at the office, and his boss sees him in a green shirt. Will Bapuji's plan work out?

3682.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3682.description: Taarak gives the presentation in front of the clients. However, the clients are not satisfied with his presentation. What will happen now?

3683.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3683.description: Taarak shares the good news with all the Gokuldham residents and tells them about Bapuji's brilliant idea. Meanwhile, Anjali prepares for the Europe trip.

3684.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3684.description: Taarak's boss decides to pay Taarak a surprise visit in the morning. What will Taarak do now?

3685.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3685.description: Taarak's boss arrives at Gokuldham, and Taarak receives him at the society gate. Meanwhile, Jethalal and Sodhi look for him in the park.

3686.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3686.description: Taarak's boss sees Champaklal and says he wants to meet Bade Guruji. Everyone tries to stop him, but he doesn't listen.

3687.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3687.description: Bapuji explains how he managed to hide from Taarak's boss. Later, Taarak unboxes the gift his boss gave him.

3688.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3688.description: Tapu Sena requests Bhide to buy new games for the society clubhouse. Will Bhide approve their request?

3689.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3689.description: Bhide is curious about Tapu Sena's surprise gift. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Bagha for talking to Bawri during working hours.

3690.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3690.description: Jethalal gets angry when Bawri shows up at the shop to meet Bagha. Later, Bagha scares Jethalal with a ghost story.

3691.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3691.description: Gokuldham residents find mystery boxes outside their homes in the middle of the night. Who could be the one behind this prank?

3692.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3692.description: Rest of the Gokuldham residents open their mystery boxes and find that they all have been pranked. However, Bhide has figured out who is behind this mischief. Will his hunch be correct?

3693.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3693.description: Bhide begins to think that Goli is the one behind the prank. Will Bhide prove to be right this time?

3694.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3694.description: The prankster writes a cryptic message on the society notice board. Gokuldham residents are scared and they think that a ghost is behind all of this. What will happen now?

3695.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3695.description: Bhide, Popatlal and the others look for the ghost on the terrace. Meanwhile, Gokuldham residents find a speaker in the middle of the society compound.

3696.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3696.description: Gokuldham residents are scared and confused as the lights go off in the clubhouse. Meanwhile, the prankster places a very strange condition in front of the society members.

3697.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3697.description: The prankster appears before the society member and he turns out to be none other than a member of Gokuldham. Who could this prankster be?

3698.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3698.description: Tapu surprises everyone by coming back. Champaklal and Abdul say they helped Tapu in surprising everyone. Later, Tapu apologizes to everyone for scaring them.

3699.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3699.description: Tapu brings special presents for all Gokuldham residents, and he decides to gift them in the middle of the night. Is Tapu planning another prank?

3700.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3700.description: Tapu makes everyone happy with his thoughtful gifts. In the morning, Sonu decides to prepare a special breakfast for Tapu.

3701.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3701.description: Tapu shows his disappointing exam results to Jethalal. Later, Tapu decides to talk to Jethalal about joining Gada Electronics.

3702.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3702.description: Tapu's college friend comes to Gokuldham to meet him. Jethalal and Bapuji think this girl could be Tapu's future life partner. Will their assumption prove to be correct?

3703.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3703.description: Sonu bursts Bhide's bubble and tells him that Missa is not Tapu's girlfriend. Meanwhile, Tapu celebrates his return by playing cricket with his friends in the society compound.

3704.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3704.description: Jethalal tells Baga and Nattu kaka that Tapu is back. Tapu and his friends tell Champaklal they want to dance with him.

3705.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3705.description: Babita wants to gift her cousin a TV which is high in demand. She asks Jethalal for his help in acquiring this TV. Will Jethalal accept her request?

3706.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3706.description: Jethalal vows to shave his head if he is unable to fulfil his promise to Babita. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka find a customer for the TV.

3707.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3707.description: Bawri calls Bagha to fix her scooter. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka is excited as he secured a profitable deal for the TV. What will Jethalal do when he finds out?

3708.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3708.description: Jethalal throws a tantrum when he finds out that the TV has been sold. How will Jethalal fulfil the promise he made to Babita now?

3709.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3709.description: Jethalal is unable to find the TV anywhere, and he feels hopeless. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer arrive at Jethalal's shop, hoping to buy the TV from him. What will happen now?

3710.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3710.description: Jethlalal is stressed about the promise he made to Iyer. Bawri comes to Jethalal's rescue. Will Jethalal keep the promise he made to Iyer?

3711.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3711.description: The kids of the colony are excited for Holi and begin their preparations for a memorable celebration. Will everything go according to plan?

3712.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3712.description: Tapu Sena apologizes to Bhide for pranking him. Meanwhile, preparations for the Holi celebration continue in Gokuldham.

3713.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3713.description: Tapu Sena tells everyone about their Holi plans. However, Gokuldham residents are worried that something might go wrong as usual. What troubles will be waiting for them?

3714.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3714.description: Members of the Tapu Sena cover Bhide with Holi colours and drench him with water. Later, Bhide finds out that Tapu mixed itching powder with the colour. What will happen now?

3715.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3715.description: Gokuldham residents are waiting for Dr Hathi to arrive and treat Bhide. Meanwhile, Inspector Chalu Pandey pays them a surprise visit.

3716.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3716.description: Inspector Pandey wants to arrest Tapu for throwing itching powder at Bhide. However, Dr Hathi arrives on time and decides to inspect the Holi colours. Will Dr Hathi prove Tapu's innocence?

3717.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3717.description: Babita and Iyer come to Jethalal's house with a problem, and Tapu gives them a solution. Later, Jethalal asks Tapu about his future plans.

3718.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3718.description: All the parents are worried that the kids are not focused on their life goals. Tapu comes up with an idea which will alleviate their tension and also ensure that the fun in their life never ends.

3719.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3719.description: Taarak talks to the kids about their career goals. Tapu promises that all of them will come up with a plan to make their families proud.

3720.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3720.description: Jethalal and the others ask for Bapuji's help to find out what Tapu Sena is up to. Meanwhile, the kids decide to present their secret project in front of everyone the next day.

3721.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3721.description: Everyone is wondering what could be Tapu Sena's secret project. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena invites all the residents of Gokuldham to the clubhouse, where they will present their idea.

3722.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3722.description: Bhide is worried and wants to find out what is Tapu Sena going to do at 8:30 pm and comes up with an idea. Will he be able to find out about their plan?

3723.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3723.description: Gokuldham residents arrive at the clubhouse for the special program. All of them are curious about the secret chief guest for their program. Who could it be?

3724.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3724.description: The secret investor turns out to be none other than Asit Kumarr Modi, who helped Tapu Sena put their entire project together. Only one question remains now, what is this secret project that the kids have been working so hard for?

3725.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3725.description: Gokuldham residents praise Tapu Sena for their innovative ideas and hard work. Later, Gokuldham residents celebrate Gudi Padwa together.

3726.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3726.description: Popatlal confronts Asit Kumarr Modi about not finding a suitable bride for him. Meanwhile, everyone enjoys the rhymes and mobile games created by Tapu Sena.

3727.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3727.description: Jethalal and Babita cannot find an auto that is ready to take them to their destination. He then faces a group of angry auto drivers. Will Jethalal reach his shop in time with the important meeting inching closer?

3728.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3728.description: Rustom from Ramsang company decides to put Gada Electronics on the blacklist for Jethalal's unprofessional behaviour. Jethalal sees Rustom running from Gada Electronics and assumes he is a thief. What will happen now?

3729.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3729.description: Jethalal is excited about the new scheme that Gada Electronics has been selected for and wishes to see Babita benefit from it. Tapu is keen on marketing this scheme in the best possible way. Later, Jethalal tells the society members about the scheme at Gada Electronics.

3730.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3730.description: Popatlal calls out schemes such as the one announced by Jethalal, to be fraudulent. All the society members look forward to making purchases to increase their probability of benefiting from the scheme.

3731.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3731.description: The society members are excited and looking forward to making purchases under the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Bagha and Natu Kaka have made all the necessary preparations for the big day of the sale. How will Jethalal react?

3732.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3732.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka ask Bawri to hide before Jethalal reaches the store. Tapu Sena presents their marketing plan for the scheme before Jethalal. Later, a crowd assembles outside Jethalal's shop but doesn't enter the premises. What is the matter?

3733.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3733.description: All the society members are impressed with the promotional video made by Tapu Sena, for the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Jethalal shares his worries with Taarak about the probability of things not running smoothly. What will happen?

3734.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3734.description: Jethalal gets anxious when he sees there are no customers at Gada electronics. Bagha gets caps for the employees of Gada electronics. Will people turn up at Gada Electronics?

3735.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3735.description: The society members assemble before setting out to make purchases under the scheme at Gada Electronics. Meanwhile, Jethalal's shop is packed with customers. Will the society members reach on time before the coupons run out?

3736.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3736.description: Sunita reaches Jethalal's shop to make a purchase. While Jethalal and his team continue attending to various customers, the society members, except Babita, arrive at the shop. Will Babita reach in time?

3737.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3737.description: Inspector Panday arrives at Jethalal's shop to shop under the scheme followed by Babita. All the society members make their purchases under the scheme and return to the society.

3738.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3738.description: Jethalal is happy about the day that it has gone well. The society members decide to sit together at the clubhouse to watch the results of the lucky draw. They fantasize about what they'd do if they won the car.

3739.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3739.description: Bhide interrupts Tapu Sena's enthusiasm for creating a ruckus in the compound. Later, the society members pray to their respective gods, asking god to make them win the car.

3740.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3740.description: All the society members gather together in the clubhouse for the lucky draw's announcement hoping to win a car under the Ramsang company's scheme. Who will win the car?

3741.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3741.description: All the society members gear up for the announcement of the last two coupon prizes. With Popatlal having won the honeymoon coupon, who will win the car?

3742.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3742.description: Jethalal, Bagha and Nattu Kaka recount the events that transpired during the lucky draw viewing at the clubhouse, for Champaklal. Later, an excited Babita decides to attend driving lessons.

3743.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3743.description: Babita gets a nightmare and calls Jethalal in the middle of the night to make sure that the coupon is safe with Jethalal. The following morning, Jethalal leaves for his shop with Babita, Bhide and Popatlal coupons.

3744.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3744.description: Taarak warns Jethalal, asking him to be careful with the coupons because of his streak of bad luck when it comes to handling others' responsibilities. Meanwhile, Babita registers for driving lessons and Jethalal tries to speed up the process of Babita receiving the car earlier than customary.

3745.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3745.description: Jethalal is ecstatic to inform Babita about her being able to receive the car on her preferred day. Later, Jethalal calls Taarak in agony, asking for help on a situation with the coupon. What is it regarding?

3746.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3746.description: Rustom from Ramsung congratulates Jethalal and gives him a certificate of appreciation. Jethalal tells Rustom he doesn't have the car coupon. How will Rustom react?

3747.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3747.description: Bagha uses Bawri's idea to prevent Rustom and Babita from learning the truth. Mahila Mandal is very excited because Babita is getting a car. How will everyone react when they get to know about Jethalal's lies?

3748.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3748.description: Bagha asks Dolly from Ramsung about Babita's car colour. Bagha suggests they should make a duplicate car coupon. Later, Taarak gives an idea to Jethalal on how to get the ink off the car coupon. Will this idea work?

3749.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3749.description: Rustom makes it clear to Jethalal that if he doesn't receive the car coupon before 6 pm, he won't give the car to Babita. Taarak has an idea that he believes could help Jethalal with his problem, but his boss won't let him out of his sight. How will Taarak help Jethalal now?

3750.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3750.description: Jethalal decides to tell the truth to Rustom about the car coupon. How will Rustom react to the truth?

3751.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3751.description: Taarak prepares Jethalal to tell the truth to Babita and Champaklal. Later, Babita along with Tapu Sena plans to surprise Iyer with the new car.

3752.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3752.description: Jethalal and Taarak arrive at Babita's house to tell her the truth about the car coupon. How will Babita react when she finds out what happened?

3753.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3753.description: Taarak gets upset when Anjali asks him to welcome Babita's new car with everyone. Popatlal calls Jethalal to Abdul's soda shop, but Jethalal avoids his call.

3754.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3754.description: Jethalal is not able to sleep because he is tense and decides to run away from home. Will he run away from the situation or face the situation and own his mistake?

3755.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3755.description: Taarak acts irritable and asks Jethalal to talk to Babita. Babita asks Tapu to get a cake for Jethalal. Later, Jethalal writes a letter to Babita. What will happen next?

3756.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3756.description: Jethalal asks Goli to give his letter to Babita. Babita loses the letter and calls Jethalal to ask about the letter. Will Jethalal tell her the truth?

3757.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3757.description: Taarak asks Jethalal to tell Iyer the entire truth. Everyone is eagerly waiting for Babita's car, and Tapu Sena prepares to surprise Iyer.

3758.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3758.description: Babita asks Jethalal to call Ramsung company and ask about the car. Jethalal tries to tell the truth to Babita in front of everyone when Bagha along with Rustom arrives in Gokuldham society. Will Babita finally learn the truth?

3759.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3759.description: The entire Gokuldham society cheers for Jethalal. Rustom asks Babita to send the car to his showroom for registration. Babita reads the letter Jethalal had written to her. What will be Babita's reaction?

3760.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3760.description: Nattu Kaka and Bagha tell everyone that whoever took out the ink from the coupon has asked them not to reveal his identity. Who is this mystery man?

3761.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3761.description: Babita thanks everyone for making her dream come true. Jethalal asks Taarak to write a letter to Rustom. Later, Gada Electronic employees get sad when they don't get a commission from Jethalal.

3762.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3762.description: Champaklal decides to give a surprise gift to Tapu. Later, Bhide stops Tapu Sena from playing cricket at night. What will Tapu Sena do now?

3763.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3763.description: Bhide scolds Tapu for calling Sonu inappropriately. Later, Bhide reads Tapu's messages on Sonu's phone and gets furious.

3764.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3764.description: Bhide follows Tapu and Sonu and spies on them. What will he find after following them?

3765.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3765.description: Bhide gets scared when he finds out his friend's daughter ran away with someone. Later, Bhide sees Tapu planning a surprise for Sonu and proposing to her. How will Bhide react now?

3766.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3766.description: Bhide tells Madhavi about Tapu and Sonu, but she doesn't believe him. Bhide calls Jethalal and says he has a piece of very shocking news for him. How will Jethalal react to Bhide's news?

3767.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3767.description: Everyone tries to find out what happened between Bhide and Jethalal. Later, Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house and waits for Bhide to come. What will Bhide do now?

3768.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3768.description: Tapu gives a surprise to everyone and a return gift to Champaklal. Later, everyone asks Bhide what he wanted to talk to Jethalal about.

3769.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3769.description: Champaklal decides to give everyone a dinner treat. Jethalal is curious about what Bhide wanted to tell him and asks for Taarak's help. Will Bhide tell Jethalal the truth?

3770.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3770.description: Anjali and Taarak talk about Popatlal's marriage. Later, the kids tell Champaklal about their new game.

3771.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3771.description: Madhavi gets extremely upset because she thinks Bhide doesn't like her food. Later, Gokuldham men meet at Abdul's soda shop, and Taarak's deep words impress everyone.

3772.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3772.description: Popatlal gets angry when Jethalal says girls refuse to get married to him. Later, someone plays the violin in the Gokuldham society, and everybody dances. Who is this talented person?

3773.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3773.description: Popatlal finds out about Vinu Kaka and feels positive about his marriage. Later, Popatlal meets Vinu Kaka and asks him about his marriage. Will Popatlal get any good news?

3774.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3774.description: Popatlal says he needs some time to think about changing his name. Bhide gets worried when Viku Kaka sees Sonu's hand and says she will get married to someone who lives nearby. Later, Popatlal goes to Jethalal and asks for his advice.

3775.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3775.description: Bagha makes chits to solve Popatlal's problem. Popatlal decides to let Mahila Mandal make the final decision about his name. Will Mahila Mandal solve Popatlal's problem?

3776.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3776.description: Everyone tries to find a new name for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal invites everyone to his party to celebrate his name-keeping ceremony.

3777.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3777.description: Everyone arrives at Popatlal's name ceremony party except Jethalal and Champaklal. Later, Popatlal gives a speech to everyone.

3778.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3778.description: Everyone from Gokuldham society votes for names that would suit Popatlal the most. Whose name will Popatlal choose?

3779.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3779.description: Jethalal suggests a few names from the letter P for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal finally finds the perfect name for himself but Iyer says it's not the right name for him. What will happen now?

3780.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3780.description: Tapu Sena decides to give a gift to Popatlal. Popatlal's relative's ghost is angry because she doesn't want him to change his name. What will he do now?

3781.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3781.description: A girl compliments Pyaarelal for his name and will marry someone with the same name. Pyaarelal's editor is upset with him because he changed his name. Later, Pyaarelal gets into confusion with the police because of his name.

3782.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3782.description: Pyaarelal starts doubting his decision to change the name but Anjali informs him about a proposal that came for him. Later, Pyaarelal asks Taarak to take an off from the office and be with him, but his boss is in a bad mood. What will Taarak do now?

3783.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3783.description: Taarak convinces his boss to give him leave from the office for half a day. Pyaarelal asks Anjali about Sapna. Later, Pyaarelal sets up a meeting with two different girls for marriage on the same day. What will happen now?

3784.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3784.description: Everyone gets ready to meet Sapna and Kalpana. Pyaarelal gets happy when he meets Sapna. Will this meeting change Pyaarelal's life?

3785.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3785.description: Sapna's father asks questions to Pyaarelal. Sapna and Pyaarelal talk in private to get to know each other better. Will Sapna say yes to Pyaarelal?

3786.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3786.description: Pyaarelal and Sapna talk it out in person and seem to like each other. However, Pyaarelal is concerned about meeting Kalpana first before giving his decision. Who will he pick?

3787.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3787.description: Pyaarelal and Kalpana talk in private. Later, Sapna and Kalpana both agree to marry Pyaarelal. What will happen now?

3788.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3788.description: Pyaarelal gets into trouble when he says yes to both Kalpana and Sapna for marriage. How will he get out of this problem?

3789.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3789.description: Champaklal asks Pyaarelal to refuse to marry either Sapna or Kalpana. Later, Pyaarelal tells Tapu Sena about his problem. Will Tapu Sena find a solution to his problem?

3790.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3790.description: Pyaarelal decides to meet Sapna and Kalpana once again. Later, Sapna's family treats Pyaarelal like their son-in-law which makes the situation even more difficult for him.

3791.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3791.description: Pyaarelal tells Sapna he has to leave to attend to a work emergency but instead goes to meet Kalpana. Will Sapna find out about this?

3792.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3792.description: Pyaarelal goes out with Sapna to get to know her better but soon leaves to meet Kalpana. Will Pyaarelal be able to choose one girl between Kalpana and Sapna?

3793.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3793.description: Kalpana and Sapna are head over heels in love with Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal is worried because he fixes a date with Kalpana and Sapna at the same time and same place. What will happen now?

3794.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3794.description: Kalpana gets a tatto for Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal goes to Sapna while he is on a date with Kalpana. Police find Pyaarelal's behaviour suspicious and keep an eye on him.

3795.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3795.description: Pyaarelal tells his dream to everyone. Kalpana's father fixes a meeting with Pyaarelal to give him Shagun, and Sapna's family also decides to come with Shagun to Pyaarelal's house.

3796.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3796.description: Gokuldham society members prepare for Pyaarelal and Kalpana's Shagun ceremony. Later, Kalpana comes with her family to Pyaarelal's house.

3797.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3797.description: Kalpana and her family find out the truth about Pyaarelal's name and Kalpana decides to break up with him. Later, Jethalal and Taarak give good news to Pyaarelal. What is it?

3798.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3798.description: Pyaarelal calls and invites Bagha, Nattu kaka and Bawri for his Shagun ceremony with Sapna. Later, everyone welcomes Sapna and her family to Gokuldham society.

3799.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3799.description: A man named Swapnil loves Sapna, and Pyaarelal brings him to his Shagun ceremony and helps them get together with each other. Later, Pyaarelal decides to change his name back to Popatlal.

3800.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3800.description: Tapu Sena visit Popatlal and helps cheer up his mood. Later, Tapu informs Jethalal that he is going outstation on a trip with all of his friends.

3801.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3801.description: Jethalal runs away to save himself from Anjali's diet breakfast. Anjali reminds Taarak of their anniversary when they first met and asks him to take an off from the office. Will Taarak be able to convince his boss to take a leave for a day?

3802.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3802.description: Taarak is worried because he doesn't know how to take leave from his office and decides to ask Jethalal for advice. Taarak shares his problem with Bagha. Will Bagha be able to help Taarak with his problem?

3803.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3803.description: Taarak tries to find out his boss's mood and asks Bagha to call him. Later, Bagha reminds Taarak of the promise he made.

3804.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3804.description: Jethalal finds out that his dream company wants to meet him tomorrow for a meeting. Jethalal asks Taarak to take a leave from his office and attend the meeting with him. How will Taarak manage to help Jethalal and also spend time with Anjali on their anniversary?

3805.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3805.description: Taarak suggests Jethalal to take Bagha and Nattu Kaka for his dealership meeting. Later, Taarak asks Jethalal to stay quiet during the whole meeting and let Bagha and Nattu Kaka speak. Will Jethalal get this dealership?

3806.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3806.description: Jethalal tells Taarak that Mike Gatting has become his company's manager. Bagha impresses Jethalal with his presentation and English. Will he be able to get the dealership for Gada Electronics?

3807.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
