3807.description: When the guests from the company arrive, they get a little confused seeing Jethalal with a 'Mon Vrat'. The dealership employees walk out as they only want to speak to Jethalal. Will Jethalal get the dealership?

3808.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3808.description: Champaklal unknowingly exposes Jethalal and Taarak lying in front of the dealership employees. Later, Jethalal books a table for Anjali and Taarak at his friend's restaurant.

3809.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3809.description: Jethalal joyfully distributes sweets to all the members of society to commemorate the successful acquisition of a new dealership.

3810.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3810.description: All the society members get ready for the monsoons as they run their chores. Meanwhile, Taarak gets called into his boss' cabin. Will he be in trouble?

3811.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3811.description: Tarak's boss asks him to share his lawyer's number which makes him nervous. He confirms with Bagha and asks him to pretend to be a lawyer. Will he get caught?

3812.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3812.description: Tapu Sena accidentally hurts Bhide. Later, Sunita sells vegetables to Mahila Mandal at a higher rate. What will Mahila Mandal do now?

3813.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3813.description: Bhide asks Tapu Sena to stop playing video games. Later, everyone asks Jethalal when is Daya coming back and he starts missing her.

3814.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3814.description: Jethalal gets a call from the police station to inform him that they have arrested Sundar. How will Jethalal help him now?

3815.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3815.description: Jethalal gets a call from the police station. Sodhi gives a lawyer's number to Jethalal. Later, Jethalal and his friends have an encounter with a ghost on their way to the police station.

3816.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3816.description: Sundar tells Jethalal that he won a challenge because of him and Jethalal asks for his commission. Sundar tricks Jethalal into making tea for him and his friends.

3817.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3817.description: Inspector Panday is furious with Jethalal for calling him to the police station in the middle of the night for no reason. Later, Sundar and his friends try to scare Inspector Panday by dressing up as ghosts.

3818.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3818.description: Champaklal apologizes to Inspector Panday on behalf of Jethalal. Sundar tells Jethalal that he has a surprise for him. Later, Sundar wakes up Champaklal and Tapu in the middle of the night.

3819.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3819.description: Sundar tells his problem to Champaklal and asks him to come to Ahmedabad with him. Later, Sundar plans a surprise for Jethalal. What is the surprise?

3820.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3820.description: Anjali forces Taarak to drink healthy juice. Jethalal wants to know what surprise Sundar is planning for him. Later, everyone gathers at the clubhouse to find out about Sundar's surprise.

3821.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3821.description: Sundar asks Jethalal to do the inauguration of his stall. Everyone enjoys food from Sundar's stall. Later, Sunday tells everyone that he has one more surprise for Jethalal.

3822.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3822.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka try to convince Jethalal to take up Sundar's offer to join his food business. Jethalal fears that he might have to pay for the lights and decorations. Later, Tapu tells Sundar about the games Tapu Sena has made.

3823.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3823.description: Sundar leaves for Ahmedabad but Jethalal tries to stop him. Taarak asks Jethalal to get re-married. Later, Taarak tricks Sundar and forces him to return to Gokuldham society.

3824.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3824.description: Taarak tells Sundar that Jethalal is thinking about getting married again. Later, Champaklal finds out about Jethalal's intentions and gets angry at him. What will happen now?

3825.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3825.description: Sundar says he knew that everyone was acting when they said Jethalal is getting married again. Later, Sundar decides to tell Jethalal when Daya is returning to Gokuldham society.

3826.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3826.description: All the Gokuldham men are very happy to sit and have soda together. Iyer gets angry with Jethalal for pulling his leg. Later, Iyer says he has good news for everyone. What is it?

3827.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3827.description: Bhide's morning quote triggers Popatlal. Later, Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Iyer's good news is not what he was thinking about. What will happen now?

3828.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3828.description: Taarak and Jethalal ask Goli to go to Iyer's house and find out about his good news. Will Iyer tell the good news to Goli?

3829.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3829.description: Jethalal is afraid of losing while everyone waits for Iyer to come and give the good news. Later, Champaklal learns about Jethalal and Iyer's bet. Who will win this bet?

3830.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3830.description: Jethalal congratulates Babita on her new car. Everyone in Gokuldham society wishes they also had a car. Later, Iyer and Babita meet Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Bawri to give them sweets.

3831.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3831.description: A big storm hits Mumbai, and Anjali asks Taarak not to go to the office. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka reach the shop and wait for Jethalal to come.

3832.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3832.description: Everyone gets a day off from work because of the heavy rains. Bhide plans to spend a romantic day with Madhavi but one of his students shows up. How will Bhide's day go?

3833.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3833.description: Iyer plans to watch a movie with Babita at home while Tapu Sena is getting bored and decide to make everyone laugh and entertain them. What will Tapu Sena do now?

3834.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3834.description: Tapu calls the rest of the Gokuldham members outside in his unique style to have fun with them and celebrate the 'Haso Hasao Divas'.

3835.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3835.description: Taarak's boss scolds him for playing outside instead of working. Inspector Panday also celebrates 'Haso Hasao Divas' with Gokuldham members. Later, Lord Krishna gives his blessings to the Gokuldham society.

3836.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3836.description: Gokuldham Society celebrates 15 years of 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah' by reminiscing beautiful memories of the show.

3837.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3837.description: Goli and Tapu have a pool competition which Goli tries to win by cheating. Tapu Sena decides to teach Champaklal how to play pool. Later, Mahila Mandal plans a trip to enjoy the lovely weather.

3838.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3838.description: Anjali tells Mahila Mandal that Taarak gave a polythene full of fresh tomatoes to the garbage man. Later, Sunita explains why she has increased the price of all the vegetables.

3839.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3839.description: Madhavi tells Bhide that she forgot to make Mr Nayar's order of tomato pickles. Champkalal explains to Bhide the importance of respecting customers in business. Later, Bhide and Popatlal get into an accident.

3840.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3840.description: Bhide struggles to find 40 kilos of tomatoes in one place. Bhide goes to Gada Electronics and sees a lot of tomatoes there. What will Bhide do now?

3841.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3841.description: Bhide calls his uncle in Nashik who has a farm and asks him if he can give him tomatoes. Later, Taarak tells Bhide that a tempo full of tomatoes was looted on its way to Mumbai from Nashik. What will happen now?

3842.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3842.description: Baliya is Bhide's last hope for getting his hands on tomatoes in time. Taarak explains why the price of tomatoes has increased drastically. Meanwhile, the Bhide family passes their time by playing a game of cards and watching a movie together.

3843.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3843.description: Bhide and Madhavi get very happy when they see tomatoes. They are not able to bring all the tomatoes to their flat so Bhide decides to stay down with the tomatoes. Later, the tomatoes get stolen.

3844.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3844.description: Bhide thinks Tapu Sena is messing with him by hiding the tomatoes while Iyer blames Jethalal. Gokuldham society members try to figure out who could've stolen the tomatoes while Bhide calls Inspector Panday for help.

3845.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3845.description: Inspector Panday thinks someone from Gokuldham society has stolen Bhide's tomatoes. Later, Inspector Panday sends his men to catch the rickshaw driver whom Abdul saw running away from the society.

3846.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3846.description: Nobody is ready to believe that Popatlal is a thief, but Inspector Panday decides to arrest him. Later, Popatlal tells everyone what actually happened. Will Inspector Panday believe him?

3847.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3847.description: Madhavi starts making tomato pickles for her customer while the gas cylinder at Bhide's house gets over. What will happen now?

3848.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3848.description: Retrieving data. Wait a few seconds and try to cut or copy again.

3849.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3849.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal there has been a robbery in their village and ask for their salary in advance. Later, Tapu Sena makes plans for going for an outing instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone.

3850.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3850.description: Bhide teaches his tuition kids about Independence Day. Later, Tapu Sena asks Bhide if they can go on a picnic to Khandala instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone. Bhide asks Champaklal to teach the kids a lesson.

3851.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3851.description: Bhide thanks Champaklal for guiding him in the right direction while Taarak writes a poem for Independence Day. Later, everyone gathers to celebrate Independence Day.

3852.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3852.description: Taarak, Bhide and Jethalal decide to go to the office together while Jethalal gets a chance to ride with Babita in her car.

3853.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3853.description: Dr Hathi's patient, Chintamani, tells Dr Hathi that there is something wrong with him. Mahila Mandal meets for a kitty party while Goli gets ready to go to a medical camp.

3854.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3854.description: All men from Gokuldham society gather to drink soda and talk about the kinds of customers they have to deal with.

3855.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3855.description: Bhide writes a good message on the society board. Champaklal catches a cold while Tapu tells Jethalal about maps on the phone.

3856.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3856.description: Popatlal gets ready to go to somebody's wedding, but Bhide drops green chutney on Popatlal's new clothes. Tapu and Sony try to get the stain off his clothes. Will they be successful?

3857.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3857.description: Chintamani gets all his health tests done and shows his reports to Dr Hathi. Tapu takes Champaklal to Dr Hathi because he is not well. Will Champakal feel better after consulting Dr Hathi?

3858.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3858.description: Dr Hathi tells his friends that he is fed up with Chintamani. Dr Hathi gets to know that Chitamani has fainted and is admitted to a hospital. Later, a man named Danger bhai comes to Gokuldham and looks for Dr Hathi.

3863.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3863.description: Inspector Panday and his team arrive on time and save Champaklal from Danger Bhai's injection. Later, Danger Bhai asks Inspector Panday to arrest Dr Hathi also for giving wrong medicine to his brother. What will happen now?

3864.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3864.description: Abdul tells everyone how he hid Dr Hathi from Danger Bhai and called Inspector Panday to save Dr Hathi. Later, Dr Hathi tells Inspector Panday what actually happened with Danger Bhai's brother, Chintamani. Will Danger Bhai forgive Dr Hathi?

3865.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3865.description: Chintamani's kids tell everyone that Chintamani is okay and get to know that Dr Hathi had nothing to do with Chintamani fainting. Later, all Gokuldham members talk to Chintamani and give him hope.

3866.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3866.description: Jethalal comes back to Gokuldham society and Bhide tells him what happened in the society when he was not there. Later, Chintamani comes to the Gokuldham society with another health problem. What will Dr Hathi do now?

3867.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3867.description: Sonu makes Bhide's tension go away and asks him to write a shlok from Bhagwat Geeta on the society board. Bhide decides to test Tapu Sena. Later, Bhide and Tapu get into a fight.

3868.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3868.description: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight when Bhide tells Jethalal that Tapu insulted him. Tapu apologises to Bhide for talking back to him and tells him that Tapu Sena won't do Dahi Handi this year. What will happen now?

3869.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3869.description: A monk comes to Gokuldham society's temple and gives Tapu Sena an Iccha Purti Matki and says whoever breaks it on Janmashtami his wishes will come true. Who will get to break this matki?

3870.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3870.description: Madhavi tells Mahila Mandal about the Iccha Purti matki while Popatlal gets angry because no one told him about the society's emergency meeting. Later, everyone gets excited about Iccha Purti matki.

3871.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3871.description: Champaklal tells Jethalal about Iccha Purti matki. Later, everyone gathers for the emergency meeting and waits for Bhide. What is taking Bhide so long?

3872.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3872.description: Gokuldham Society members unanimously agree to let Popatlal break the Iccha Purti matki on Janmashtami and wish for a happily married life. However, Popatlal decides to do something else with the matki. What is he planning?

3873.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3873.description: Gokuldham society celebrates Janmashthami. Later, each family can put down only one name from their family for Iccha Purti matki. Who will get this golden chance?

3874.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3874.description: Everyone is excited to know who will break the Iccha Purti matki. Later, a couple comes to Gokuldham society and tells everyone that their son has only a few days left to live.

3875.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3875.description: Everyone asks Chintan to break the Iccha Purti matki. Tapu Sena helps him break the matki but he keeps falling down. Will he be able to break the matki?

3876.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3876.description: Chintan reveals that he didn't pray for his good health while breaking the matki. Later, all the Gokuldham men sit and chat at the clubhouse, but Jethalal is missing. Where is he?

3877.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3877.description: Gokuldham men talk about business. Jethalal tells Champakal that Tapu is still young to join the business. Later, Jethalal doesn't agree with Bhide's message on the society board. What does the message say?

3878.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3878.description: Tapu tells Champaklal that he wants to take him to Palitana. On arriving at his shop, Jethalal is happy to see it full of customers but short-staffed. Later, Bagha makes a mistake while accepting a payment. How will Jethalal react?

3879.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3879.description: Bagha tells Bawri that Gada Electronis lost ten thousand rupees because of his mistake and Bawri decides to help them. Later, Nattu Kaka finds out something suspicious in the office account. What is it?

3880.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3880.description: Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Dhanraj Seth has not given other people's money either. Later, Taarak gives advice to Jethalal to keep a manager in his shop to divide the workload. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha react to this?

3881.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3881.description: Jethalal's friends urge him to keep a manager for the shop. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka says that he will leave his job at Gada Electronics if Jethalal hires a new manager. What will happen now?

3882.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3882.description: Jethalal is looking for a manager for his shop while Nattu Kaka's behaviour changes towards Jethalal. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal they will leave their jobs if he keeps a manager. What will happen now?

3883.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3883.description: Jethalal imagines what it would be like if he hired Bawri as a manager. Later, Jethalal asks Bawri to give a test so he can decide if she's fit to become a manager or not. Will Bawri pass the test?

3884.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3884.description: Bagha eagerly waits for Bawri to return with the payment. Later, Bawri tells everyone that she didn't get the payment from Dhanraj Seth. What will happen now?

3885.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3885.description: Bawri tells Jethalal she doesn't want to work at Gada Electronics and that she can do freelancing whenever Gada Electronics needs her. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka apologise to Jethalal for their behaviour.

3886.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3886.description: Jethalal tells Bagha and Nattu Kaka that he doesn't like the mega bumper sale written outside Gada Electronics. Later, Tapu Sena takes Gokuldham's speaker to Gada Electronics to get it repaired.

3887.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3887.description: Bhide scolds Tapu Sena for buying a new speaker without knowing that it's a gift from Jethalal. Later, Tapu Sena helps set up the mandap for Ganesh Chaturthi.

3888.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3888.description: All Gokuldham members share their tea with Taarak. Later, they celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi in full swing.

3889.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3889.description: Bhide wants Sonu to tell him about her Ganesh Chaturthi performance while everyone is excited about Sonu's surprise performance. What is Sonu's surprise?

3890.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3890.description: Sonu impresses everyone with her magnificent performance. Later, Danger Bhai and Chintamani visit Gokuldham society and give gifts to everyone.

3891.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3891.description: Sodhi, Abdul and Tapu Sena decide to stay near the pandal to protect the jewels while a family hides from them to go inside the mandap. Are they here to steal or do they have some other motive?

3892.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3892.description: Bhide has a very scary dream that all the precious jewels get stolen. Tapu Sena, Sodhi and Abdul find Bhakti's parents near the mandap. What were they doing?

3893.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3893.description: Bhakti doesn't sleep at all in the night. Gokuldham members look for Bhakti's father's ring in the morning. Later, Tapu discloses that Anjali and Babita are going to do aarti nritya.

3894.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3894.description: Bhakti's parents try to find an excuse to go to Gokuldham society. Anjali and Babita are excited about their performance. What will happen next?

3895.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3895.description: Dr Hathi checks Bhakti while Bhakti's parents are worried about Gokuldham members finding out the truth. Later, Gokuldham members ask Bhakti's parents why they don't want to leave Gokuldham society. Will they tell the truth?

3896.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3896.description: Gokuldham residents are unable to decide whether they should let Bhakti stay in the society or not. However, Bhakti is not willing to leave without playing Garba with Ganpati Bappa. Will her wish come true?

3897.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3897.description: Bawri asks Komal if she can sing Stuti Bhajan with her in the evening. Bhakti refuses to eat or drink anything. Later, Gokuldham members meet to find a solution for Bhakti.

3898.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3898.description: Gokuldham members find a way to make Bhakti's wishes come true. Later, Gokuldham members gather and wait for Bhakti to arrive. What will happen now?

3899.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3899.description: Bawri sings beautifully. Bhakti asks Gokuldham members to leave because she thinks Ganesh ji wants to dance only with her. Later, Goli dresses up as Ganesh ji.

3900.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3900.description: Bhakti gets very happy and gets emotional when she sees her god with her own eyes. Later, Bhakti calls Gokuldham members to meet her god. Is this Goli in God's clothes or someone else?

3901.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3901.description: Goli celebrates with Bhakti and dances with her. Goli gets stuck in traffic and gets confused when he finds out someone has replaced him during the celebration. What will happen now?

3902.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3902.description: Gokuldham members feel blessed by god and they all thank Bhakti for it. Later, everyone gets the same dream about a god. What is the dream?

3903.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3903.description: Jethalal bumps into Champaklal and Champaklal gets angry. Popatlal meets Babita's friend and tries to impress her. Will she be impressed by Popatlal?

3904.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3904.description: Jethalal orders tea and accidentally spills it on his client, Vicky, who gets angry and insults Jethalal. Later, Jethalal finds out that Vicky is Babita's friend's husband. What will happen now?

3905.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3905.description: Jethalal and Vicky start fighting in front of Babita and Nisha. Babita tries to resolve the issue between Jethalal and Vicky. Will she succeed in doing so?

3906.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3906.description: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak and tells him about his big deal and how everything went smoothly. Later, Nattu Kaka tells Jethalal that there's some issue with Vicky's cheque that he gave Jethalal. What will Jethalal do now?

3907.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3907.description: Jethalal thinks there's a ghost in his house. Tapu shows his glow in the dark dandiya sticks to Jethalal but Jethalal feels these sticks can be risky. Later, Jethalal scolds Bagha and Bawri when he overhears their conversation.

3908.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3908.description: Bhide protects his clothes from getting ruined as he's meeting Amit for a new order. Later, Popatlal asks everyone to open a box, but no one is able to open it. What is in the box?

3909.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3909.description: Gokuldham men open Popatlal's box and end up spilling everything that was inside the box. Bhide tells Tapu Sena they don't have a budget to celebrate Navratri this year. What will happen now?

3910.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3910.description: Jethalal arrives at the meeting spot before everyone else and decides to hide and hear what Bhide says behind his back. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal to prove that he is the first one to arrive for the meeting.

3911.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3911.description: Bhide gets angry when Popatlal asks him what he does with the society's budget. Tapu Sena comes up with a solution to Navratri on zero budget. Later, Bhide wants to know about Tapu Sena's surprise.

3912.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3912.description: Tapu Sena welcomes all the Gokuldham members in their own unique style to Gokuldham's Navratri function. Everyone is waiting for the artists to come and perform at the function. Will they reach the society on time?

3913.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3913.description: Taarak and Jethalal are worried about whether Jethalal will get his money from Babita's friend on time or not. Later, Anjali gets angry when she finds unhealthy food in Taarak's bag. What will happen now?

3914.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3914.description: Babita's friend Vicky tears the cheque in front of Jethalal. Meanwhile, a phone call from Jethalal gets Taarak into trouble with his boss.

3915.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3915.description: Jethalal is confused about what to gift Babita. Later, Jethalal gets a bouquet for Babita but Iyer is allergic to flowers. What will Jethalal gift Babita?

3916.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3916.description: Jethalal is in distress as he struggles to find the right gift  and consults all his neighbours. Will he find the right gift?

3917.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3917.description: Anjali gets upset with Taarak for not giving her gifts while Jethalal dreams about Babita's gift. Later, Jethalal asks Sundar about Daya.

3918.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3918.description: Sundar tells Jethalal that he's getting a piece of land on the moon at a very small price and asks Jethalal to give him the money for the same. What will Jethalal do now?

3919.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3919.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell customers about their festive special offers. Later, Jethalal gets a call from NASA. What is this call about?

3920.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3920.description: Bagha urges Jethalal to buy land on the moon as a good investment opportunity. Will this be a wise decision for Jethalal?

3921.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3921.description: Chand Bhai convinces Jethalal to buy three plots on the moon. How will Babita and Gokuldham members react when they find out about this?

3922.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3922.description: Jethalal tells Babita he has a big surprise for her and asks everyone to come to the clubhouse in the evening. How will everyone react when they find out about Jethalal's surprise?

3923.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3923.description: Jethalal tells Babita about his surprise in a very special way. How will everyone react to this?

3924.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3924.description: Jethalal realises he had slept and he dreamt about buying land on the moon. Jethalal goes to the Moon Residential Program office. Will he buy land on the moon now?

3925.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3925.description: Jethalal asks Popatlal not to tell anyone that he wanted to buy land on the moon. Jethalal is upset because he couldn't fulfil Babita's wish. What will he do now?

3926.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3926.description: Jethalal finally brings a surprise gift for Babita with Taarak's help. Will Babita like the gift?

3927.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3927.description: Sodhi plays a prank on Bhide and steals society's notice board. Gokuldham members want Daya to come back and make their Diwali even more special. When is Daya coming back?

3928.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3928.description: Bhide gets angry at Tapu for throwing water at him. Bhide goes to stop Tapu Sena from wasting water but falls down. Later, Taarak surprises Anjali with a present.

3929.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3929.description: Mahila Mandal goes to Jethalal's house to find out when is Daya coming back while Champaklal's friend pulls Champaklal's leg. Will they find out the exact date when Daya is coming back?

3930.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3930.description: Jethalal meets a customer who's in a similar problem as him as his wife is also not coming home. Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Jethalal try to contact Sundar to ask about Daya. Will they get in touch with him?

3931.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3931.description: Jethalal talks to Daya's acquaintance and asks him to go to Daya's house and make him talk to her. Later, Jethalal and Bagha try to call Sundar from an unknown number. Will he pick up the call now?

3932.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3932.description: Jethalal is worried that Sundar may not keep his promise. He makes plans to travel to Ahmedabad himself, along with Taarak, to bring Daya back.

3933.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3933.description: Tapu books tickets for Jethalal and Taarak for Ahmedabad to bring Daya back home. Later, police arrive at the Gokuldham Society to arrest Jethalal. How will Jethalal go to Ahmedabad now?

3934.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3934.description: Police come to arrest Jethalal while he talks in his sleep. Later, everyone wants to know what crime Jethalal has committed.

3935.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3935.description: Inspector Panday is not telling anyone why he's arresting Jethalal and Gokuldham members protest against it. What will happen now?

3936.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3936.description: Mahila Mandal prays for Jethalal while Jethalal finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka in jail. Why are they in jail?

3937.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3937.description: Inspector Panday informs Jethalal that he has been accused of threatening ACP Prithvi's wife, Jagruti, from Ahmedabad. Jethalal denies these allegations. What will happen next?

3938.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3938.description: Gokuldham Society members arrive at the police station to convince Inspector Panday to let Jethalal go. Will Inspector Panday listen to them?

3939.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3939.description: Jethalal explains to ACP Prithvi that his messages were intended for Sundar, not Jagruti, and apologizes for any misunderstanding. Surprisingly, ACP Prithvi and his wife are revealed to be Daya's family friends. Will they withdraw their complaint against Jethalal?

3940.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3940.description: Gokuldham men tell Mahila Mnadal what happened at the police station while Jethalal finally gets to talk to Sundar. What will Sundar say now?

3941.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3941.description: Everyone is excited when they hear Daya is coming back. Jethalal, Champaklal, and Tapu joyfully engage in garba to celebrate her homecoming. However, amidst the happiness, Taarak is anxious, fearing that something untoward might occur during Diwali.

3942.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3942.description: Taarak is worried if Sundar will fulfil his promise. Later, everyone celebrates Diwali in Gokuldham society. When is Daya coming?

3943.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3943.description: Tapu Sena challenges Goli to snatch sukdi from Champaklal's hand. Tapu contacts Sundar to inquire about his location. Is Daya really coming with him?

3944.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3944.description: Jethalal and other Gokuldham members gather to welcome Daya. However, they are shocked to find that Daya is not with Sundar. What will happen now?

3945.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3945.description: All the colony members are upset that Sundar didn't get Daya Bhabhi with him. How will the colony members react to this?

3946.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3946.description: Jethalal and all the colony members are sad when they don't see Daya with Sundar. However, Sundar passes on the message that Daya sent for Jethalal and lights a diya on her behalf.

3947.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3947.description: It's a happy vibe in the Gokuldham society as everyone is in a good mood post-Diwali. What new adventures will they be up to?

3948.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3948.description: Bhide gets angry at Tapu Sena for playing badminton near Sakhram. Later, Roshan receives a piece of good news.

3949.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3949.description: Jethalal gets yelled at by his father for delaying a payment. Meanwhile, Sodhi tells everyone that tomorrow is his marriage anniversary.

3950.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3950.description: Sodhi and his friends are excited about his anniversary. Meanwhile, the men of the colony try to figure out what gift to give Sodhi and his wife.

3951.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3951.description: Sodhi gets convinced by his friends to party. The male members of the society decide to confront Sodhi as to why they weren't invited for the same. Will Sodhi forget to wish Roshan at twelve while busy partying?

3952.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3952.description: All the men of Gokuldham society help Sodhi clean up after he parties with his friends. Soon, Abdul calls to tell them that Roshan has just entered the society. Will Sodhi get caught?

3953.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3953.description: While Roshan enters her house, Sodhi and his friends hide on the balcony and make their way to Bhide's balcony. How long will Sodhi hide from Roshan?

3954.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3954.description: The male members of the society come up with an elaborate plan to hide Sodhi at Popatlal's house. Will Sodhi succeed in lying to Roshan?

3955.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3955.description: While Sodhi lies to Roshan over the phone about being on his way back, his friends who left earlier return to party with him. Meanwhile, Roshan finds the keys to Sodhi's car.

3956.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3956.description: All the men are worried about Sodhi's truth coming out in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Roshan arrives at Bhide's house to ask about Sodhi. Will she find out the truth?

3957.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3957.description: Bhide tries to assure Roshan that Sodhi is not at fault, while Sodhi lies to her. Later, Roshan visits Popatlal's house to catch Sodhi red-handed. What will happen now?

3958.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3958.description: Roshan visits Iyer's house, inquiring about Sodhi's whereabouts. Later, she checks Taarak's house but can't find him there either. Where could Sodhi be?

3959.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3959.description: Gokuldham men apologize to Champaklal for their deception regarding Sodhi. Meanwhile, Jethalal is discovered missing from his bedroom, leading everyone to speculate that he and Sodhi might be hiding together.

3960.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3960.description: Jethalal declares his ignorance about Sodhi's whereabouts to everyone. Despite exhaustive efforts, Sodhi remains untraceable, leading to Roshan's decision to depart from Gokuldham society and stay with her parents.

3961.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3961.description: Sodhi offers a sincere apology to Roshan, mending their differences. Afterwards, the men of Gokuldham question Bhide about his actions, wondering why he went behind their backs.

3962.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3962.description: Sodhi and Roshan distribute Kada Prasad among all their friends and invite them to their anniversary party. Will things go smoothly for them this time?

3963.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3963.description: Everyone celebrates at a party held in honour of Roshan and Sodhi, making a grand entrance. Later, Champaklal decides to go on a trip with his friends.

3964.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3964.description: Tapu tells Tapu Sena what they should organize for the society's party and requests Bhide to invite everyone to the clubhouse, but Bhide refuses. What unfolds next in this situation?

3965.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3965.description: Gokuldham members gather in the playhouse for a meeting, yet they remain curious about its purpose. Later, Tapu unveils his plan. What exactly is Tapu's strategy?

3966.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3966.description: A debate ensues over the ideal fine for an unpopular gift, prompting everyone to brainstorm diverse and thoughtful gift ideas later on. Whose gift will be the worst?

3967.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3967.description: Tapu Sena visits each house, inviting everyone to draw a chit from a bowl, determining the recipient of their gift.

3968.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3968.description: Gokuldham residents contemplate their gift ideas for the Secret Santa. Will they be able to make the right decision before the party?

3969.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3969.description: Nattu Kaka and Bagha dress up as Santa and go to everyone's house in Gokuldham society and collect their gifts. Later, everyone gathers for the party.

3970.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3970.description: Bawri suggests a creative way for everyone to express their feelings about the gifts. The person with the least-liked gift will be subject to a fine.

3971.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3971.description: Gokuldham members continue picking up gifts. Are they liking their gifts or not?

3972.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3972.description: Anjali isn't fond of her gift, but Taarak encourages her to accept it graciously. Meanwhile, Bhide is delighted to discover that Madhavi is the one behind the thoughtful gift for Sonu. Who will pay the fine now?

3973.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3973.description: Anjali and Taarak are happy with Tapu Sena's idea and discuss all the events from last year. Later, Babita wishes Jethalal a happy new year.

3974.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3974.description: Bhide asks Jethalal to give the maintenance cheque on time. Meanwhile, Champaklal returns to Gokuldham society and meets Tapu Sena.

3975.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3975.description: Bagha crafts a sales-boosting poem for Gada Electronics. Simultaneously, Bawri pitches a new scheme to Jethalal, Bagha, and Nattu Kaka. Bhide urges Madhavi to organize their home, leading her to decide to declutter by discarding unnecessary items.

3976.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3976.description: Bhide insists on keeping his old belongings, explaining their sentimental value to Madhavi. Will Madhavi let him keep his old things?

3977.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3977.description: Abdul tells Bhide about garbage being dumped in the society office, in front of Madhavi. Later, Madhavi discovers the truth, realizing both Bhide and Sodhi deceived her.

3978.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3978.description: Popatlal and Madhavi covertly sell Bhide's old items, intending to keep it a secret from him. Bhide confides in Goli about the situation, and Goli offers him wise counsel.

3979.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3979.description: Bhide seeks Taarak's assistance to persuade Popatlal about the importance of his old belongings. Popatlal tries to buy Bhide's box, but the shopkeeper refuses to sell it. Later, Madhavi shares her diary with her friends.

3980.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3980.description: Madhavi loses her old walkman, which makes her understand the attachment Bhide had to his old belongings. Madhavi and Sonu decide to go to the shop and bring Bhide's belongings back.

3981.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3981.description: Bhide pretends to be upset about his old things, but Madhavi returns them, realizing their sentimental value. Meanwhile, Sukhi tells Sodhi that his car is lucky.

3982.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3982.description: Bhide is urged to throw a party as Sonu triumphs over Tapu in badminton. Sodhi celebrates with soda, sharing stories about his lucky car. However, Sodhi's joy is short-lived as his friend informs him that the car has broken down. Now, what will Sodhi do?

3983.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3983.description: Gokuldham men search for Sodhi's friend, Sukhi. They push the car and Sodhi tries to start it but it doesn't work. Later, Gokuldham ladies worry for them.

3984.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3984.description: Sodhi plans to repair his car. Jethalal suggests getting a new car, but Sodhi chooses to repair the existing one. Later, Sodhi gets ready to drop Roshan at her relative's place and Tapu Sena at the mall. Will his car work fine now?

3985.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3985.description: Lost in the mall, Popatlal searches for Tapu Sena. He encounters an unmarried girl, and Tapu Sena seizes the opportunity to help Popatlal make a good impression on her.

3986.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3986.description: Popatlal and Anokhi decide to go on a long drive together. Tapu Sena congratulates Popatlal, and they celebrate at the mall. Later, Sodhi offers to lend Popatlal his car for the long drive. Will everything go according to Popatlal's plan?

3987.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3987.description: Popatlal prays for his relationship at the temple, while Jethalal, craving jalebi and fafda, considers inviting Taarak and Babita. Jethalal invites Taarak for breakfast, and Taarak waits for Anjali to leave to visit Jethalal's house discreetly.

3988.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3988.description: Popatlal prepares to meet Anokhi, and Sodhi enhances his car for a romantic evening for Popatlal and Anokhi. Champaklal informs Jethalal about attending a bhajan kirtan with Tapu Sena. Later, Popatlal takes Anokhi on a drive.

3989.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3989.description: "Popatlal's meeting with Anokhi triggers memories for Anjali and Taarak. Anokhi suggests they get to know each other better before making commitments. Later, Popatlal's car stops, and he asks Anokhi for help pushing it."

3990.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3990.description: Popatlal angrily confronts Sodhi, blaming his car for ruining his date. He insults Sodhi and reveals he left the car in the jungle, angering Sodhi, but Popatlal refuses to disclose the exact location. What will Sodhi do now?

3991.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3991.description: Popatlal wants his umbrella back, but Sodhi insists on knowing his car's location first. Popatlal tearfully shares the story of Anokhi leaving him due to Sodhi's car but refuses to disclose its whereabouts. Taarak suggests Anokhi may not have been the right match for him.

3992.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3992.description: Gokuldham men discover Sodhi's car missing, report it at the police station, and unintentionally disrupt Chalu Pandey's outing plans.

3993.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3993.description: Inspector Pandey discloses Popatlal's involvement in the car theft, and Gokuldham residents vow not to interfere. Together, they join the inspector to search for Sodhi's car.

3994.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3994.description: Inspector Pandey wants to solve the case on his own. Gokuldham women debate informing Roshan about Sodhi's stolen car. Later, as Pandey gets crucial information about the car which makes him suspect that Gokuldham residents are making a fool out of him.

3995.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3995.description: Inspector Pandey plans to arrest all Gokuldham men, bringing them to the society compound. Later, Inspector Pandey receives a call about two people filing a complaint about Sodhi's missing car, stirring confusion.

3996.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3996.description: Roshan surprises Sodhi with a new car, confessing the old one was never stolen. Inspector Pandey complains about Gokuldham residents causing trouble again.

3997.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3997.description: Taarak convinces Anjali to make a sweet treat. Tapu Sena asks Gogi for a treat as his father got a new car. Sodhi excitedly shares the news of his new car number in Gokuldham society.

3998.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3998.description: Sodhi shares sweets with everyone in Gokuldham to celebrate getting the permanent number for his new car. Later, Sodhi and Tapu Sena decide to have a party together.

3999.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
3999.description: Sodhi celebrates his new car by taking all kids on a joy ride. However, he soon finds out that his car is not where he parked it. Where could it be?

4000.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4000.description: Sodhi learns there's an issue with his car's number plate while the community joyfully marks the milestone of 4000 episodes of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah.

4001.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4001.description: The Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah family marks their 4000th episode with jubilant singing, dancing, and a festive cake cutting.

4002.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4002.description: Gokuldham residents savour kulfi in celebration of finding Sodhi's lost car. Madhavi has a surprise for Bhide. However, Bhide misconstrues Madhavi and Sonu's actions, believing they are scouting for potential suitors for Sonu's marriage.

4003.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4003.description: Gokuldham men enjoy a soda session, but Popatlal feels left out. They discuss online shopping risks. Later, Bhide expresses interest in buying a gold chain for Sonu.

4004.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4004.description: Madhavi is worried that Bhide will find out about her surprise from the passbook. Meanwhile, Bhide runs into Popatlal on his way to the bank, and both of them get into an argument.

4005.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4005.description: Bhide learns about Madhavi's 80,000 rupees and the truth about Sonu's gold chain. Scammers target Madhavi's account, and Mahesh offers to return Bhide's money, but he hesitates due to concerns about leaving Sonu and Madhavi alone.

4006.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4006.description: Madhavi and Anjali eagerly await Madhavi's parcel, but Madhavi is taken aback by the size of it. Despite having paid online, the delivery person requests payment upon arrival. Is this a potential scam?

4007.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4007.description: Madhavi and Sonu discover the delivery boy's scam. The bank manager advises Madhavi to involve the police and seek the Cyber Crime Unit's help, while Tapu Sena steps in to assist Sonu.

4008.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4008.description: Inspector Pandey asks Abdul to recall any distinctive details about the fraudulent delivery boy. Although Inspector Pandey gets busy with other crucial tasks which upsets Madhavi. Subsequently, Madhavi fabricates a story to Bhide, asserting that she purchased the chain as a gift for Sonu.

4009.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4009.description: Madhavi doesn't want to tell Bhide about the scam and Tapu Sena buys a fake gold chain. Later, Bhide asks Tapu Sena why there's no jeweller's name on the box.

4010.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4010.description: Sonu and Madhavi decide to hide the scam from Bhide for the next two days. Tapu Sena approaches Popatlal, and he agrees to help them find the delivery boy who scammed Madhavi.

4011.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4011.description: Tapu Sena and Popatlal plan to hide the gold chain truth from Bhide. Bhide claims he went to the temple for a new chain to spare Sonu's feelings. Later, they come up with a plan to catch the scammer.

4012.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4012.description: Bhide discovers the soda shop empty, and Tapu Sena updates the Gokuldham men about Madhavi's scam. Later, Jethalal and Iyer plan to act as police officers to gather evidence against the scammer at the CCTV shop.

4013.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4013.description: Bhide detects a secretive gathering unfolding without his knowledge, but Goli adeptly diffuses the situation with a clever explanation. The Mahila Mandal expresses interest in seeing Sonu's gold chain, leaving Madhavi anxious about potential doubts regarding its authenticity.

4014.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4014.description: Jethalal suspects Iyer's plan to leave town and advises Bhide to gift something special to Madhavi. With Champaklal sensing a secret, the group eagerly awaits Jethalal's departure for his shop.

4015.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4015.description: Bawri comes to shop for a speaker at Gada Electronics. The Gokuldham men and Tapu Sena gather at Jethalal's shop, with Jethalal and Iyer donning police disguises. Later, everyone warns them to steer clear of CCTV cameras.

4016.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4016.description: Some customers at Gada Electronics mistake Jethalal and Iyer for real policemen. The shopkeeper agrees to show them the recording and both of them find out more information about the scammer.

4017.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4017.description: The CCTV shop owner informs Inspector Panday about two individuals posing as police officers who had previously viewed the footage. Inspector Panday suspects their involvement in the scam. Jethalal and Iyer share the CCTV footage with everyone, revealing a small clue related to the scammer.

4018.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4018.description: The tattoo artist informs Jethalal and Iyer that the scammer has his tattoo design. With the scammer's phone number and name in hand, the Gokuldham members devise a plan to catch him and decide to seek the tattoo artist's help.

4019.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4019.description: The tattoo artist lures the scammer, Babban, to his studio, claiming the tattoo design has won a prize. Inspector Panday learns about Jethalal and Iyer's fake police officer act at the CCTV shop. Now, everyone awaits the scammer's arrival at the tattoo studio.

4020.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4020.description: Babban is caught at the tattoo studio, and the Gokuldham members plan to take him to Madhav for identification. Meanwhile, Bhide is left in the dark, and Inspector Panday learns about the Gokuldham members' strategy.

4021.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4021.description: Inspector Panday is furious seeing Jethalal and Iyer in police uniforms, planning their arrest along with the scammer. Later, Madhavi apologizes to Bhide. Will he forgive her?

4022.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4022.description: Gokuldham residents prepare to celebrate Popatlal's birthday together. Popatlal takes a leave from work to celebrate his birthday. Will things go according to his wishes?

4023.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4023.description: Popatlal daydreams of a birthday celebration filled with well-wishes for his swift marriage but he is determined not to be pitied so he resolves to steer clear of meeting anyone on his special day.

4024.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4024.description: Despite the Tapu Sena's sincere attempt to wish him, Popatlal plays elusive, turning off his phone and celebrating in solitary splendour. Later, Popatlal overhears everyone talking about his marriage.

4025.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4025.description: Bhide wishes Popatlal on the society board but can't reach him. They ask Abdul about Popatlal's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Sodhi and Bhide plan a party, unknowingly overheard by Champaklal.

4026.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4026.description: Taarak contacts Popatlal's boss but discovers he is not there either. Gokuldham residents believe Popatlal is engaged in a vital sting operation. Later, Popatlal receives an urgent office assignment, now faced with the task of leaving discreetly for the mission.

4027.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4027.description: Abdul gives Popatlal a disguise to go incognito outside Gokuldham. When he encounters Mahila Mandal, Abdul concocts a tale to conceal Popatlal's identity.

4028.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4028.description: Gokuldham residents and Popatlal's colleagues kidnap Popatlal and take him to his surprise party. Popatlal tells everyone why he didn't want to celebrate his birthday with them.

4029.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4029.description: Abdul grapples with a customer's needs, and Popatlal voices his concern to Bhide about his management of the society. Later, Popatlal proposes a cost-saving idea to address the society's expenses.

4030.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4030.description: Popatlal and Bhide trap the delivery boy in the society office. Seeking help, Bhide contacts Sodhi. Later, the delivery boy tells Popatal that his relative works at a marriage bureau.

4031.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4031.description: Anjali denies placing any online orders. The delivery boy joins Sodhi, Popatlal, and Bhide in a quest to find out who made the order. Whose parcel is it?

4032.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4032.description: Popatlal advises everyone to open the package and see what's inside, but the delivery boy won't give it to anyone unless they give him the delivery OTP first.

4033.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4033.description: Bhide asks Inspector Panday's boss to give him his OTP, but Panday's boss thinks Bhide is trying to scam him. What will happen now?

4034.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4034.description: Gokuldham Society members find out that the parcel belongs to Jethalal. Bhide insists that Jethalal performs two hundred situps for his wrong judgment. What will Jethalal do now?

4035.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4035.description: Taarak chooses to write an article about Indian festivals while having a great half-holiday. Later, Tapu Sena questions Bhide about the arrangements for the Holi festival.

4036.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4036.description: Mahila Mandal discusses their memories of Holi, while Tapu Sena purchases colours for the festival. Later, Tapu Sena receives a warning from two girls that some boys are throwing colours at everyone. What will Tapu Sena do?

4037.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4037.description: Tapu Sena watches as a group of boys taunt and throw colour at a girl. They teach them a lesson. Later, Sonu requests that Tapu Sena keep this incident from Bhide.

4038.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4038.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka give Jethalal plans to expand Gada Electronics' customer base. Later, when everyone gathers at the Gokuldham Society to celebrate Holi, a group of boys plan to take revenge from Tapu Sena.

4039.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4039.description: The Gokuldham residents recite poems during the Holi celebration, adding to the joy and laughter of the occasion.

4040.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4040.description: Guddu wants to take revenge against Tapu and plans on causing trouble at the Holi celebration at Gokuldham. What will he do?

4041.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4041.description: During the Holi celebrations at Gokuldham Society, Sonu is targeted by a group of boys who decide to put colour on her. Who will rescue her?

4042.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4042.description: Jethalal asks Tapu to apologize to Champaklal. Popatlal argues with an auto driver. Later, Bagha and Bawri request Jethalal to meet Bawri's parents.

4043.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4043.description: Champaklal and friends plan a gathering, while Jethalal and his friends scheme to play an April Fool's prank on the Gokuldham society members.

4044.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4044.description: Anjali tricks Taarak with green juice, while Taarak pulls a prank on Goli. Later, the Gokuldham men plan their April Fool's Day prank and party venue.

4045.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4045.description: The men concoct fake excuses to leave and head to the clubhouse for an April Fool's prank, but Bhide finds himself unexpectedly stuck at home, unable to join them.

4046.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4046.description: All the men try to sneak into the clubhouse, but the clubhouse is locked. Jethalal comes up with a plan to get Bhide out of his house. Will his plan work?

4047.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4047.description: Abdul informs Popatlal that the Gokuldham men are partying without him due to his single status. Popatlal then reveals the truth to the ladies about their husbands' clandestine party.

4048.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4048.description: Popatlal and Mahila Mandal attempt to locate the Gokuldham men's party. Popatlal consults Abdul for information. Later, Purush Mandli's plans are disrupted by Champaklal's unexpected return.

4049.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4049.description: The Purush Mandali plans an April Fool's prank on the Mahila Mandal and Popatlal. Despite their efforts, Popatlal remains suspicious. Later, the Mahila Mandal tests a drink to determine if it's alcohol or juice.

4050.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4050.description: Mahila Mandal and Champaklal pretend to be drunk to prank Purush Mandli, fooling Popatlal. Later, Purush Mandli gathers for soda and a discussion on global warming.

4051.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4051.description: Bagha informs Jethalal about an upcoming company visit for a new product launch. Jethalal wakes up Champaklal and Tapu, disrupting their sleep due to Tapu's AC preference conflicting with Champaklal's comfort.

4052.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4052.description: Babita calls Iyer and complains about a fault in their AC. Jethalal offers to fix the AC when Iyer is unable to find a mechanic. Will he be able to fix the AC?

4053.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4053.description: Jethalal, unable to repair Babita's air conditioner, tries calling Bagha for help, but Bawri intercepts the call and prevents him from speaking to Bagha.

4054.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4054.description: Jethalal suggests Iyer and Babita to buy a new AC from his shop but Iyer is unsure about this. Will Iyer buy a new AC?

4055.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4055.description: Jethalal is very happy that he helped Babita with her AC problem. Iyer plans a prank on Jethalal. Later, Madhavi prepares Bhide's favourite dish but Gokuldham kids eat it.

4056.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4056.description: Sonu decides to treat Tapu. Tapu pleasantly surprises Jethalal with his favourite breakfast. Later, Jethalal ends up ditching Taarak to accompany Babita instead.

4057.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4057.description: Tapu goes to Sonu's house for a homemade mango milkshake. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha play the Bhide scooter game, earning a scolding from Jethalal. Later, Arjun from the Supervision company meets with Jethalal for business.

4058.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4058.description: Jethalal's business meeting goes wrong due to Bawri and Bagha's antics. Bawri tries to apologise to Jethalal, but he is not willing to accept. What will happen now?

4059.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4059.description: Bawri offers an apology gift to Jethalal, but he refuses to accept it. Bagha warns Bawri not to come to Gada Electronics, but she vows to find a way to visit regardless of Jethalal's objections.

4060.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4060.description: Jethalal tells Taarak that if Bawri shows up at Gada Electronics today, he'll have to fire Bagha. Later, Bawri visits the store in disguise. Will Jethalal recognize her?

4061.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4061.description: Bagha learns that Bawri has disguised herself and come to Gada Electronics. They talk in the warehouse. Will Jethalal catch them there?

4062.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4062.description: Bagha tells Bawri they can't meet secretly without Jethalal knowing. Taarak updates Anjali about Jethalal's concerns with Bawri and Bagha. Later, everyone assembles at Gokuldham society for the pooja.

4063.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4063.description: Bawri sneaks into the shop in a disguise to meet Bagha, trying to keep their love story hidden from Jethalal. Can their romance survive the challenge of staying hidden from Jethalal's sharp eyes?

4064.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4064.description: Jethalal suspects that Bawri comes to the shop every day as a customer, and he plans to catch her red-handed. What will he do?

4065.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4065.description: Bagha prays that Bawri doesn't come to Gada Electronics but Jethalal is all set to welcome her. Will Bawri take the risk and enter Gada Electronics?

4066.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4066.description: Inspector Panday arrests Jethalal for misbehavior with a woman. Bagha tells Bawri it's because of her. Later, Taarak fakes illness at work to help Jethalal.

4067.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4067.description: Jethalal tells Bawri she caused him to go to jail. Bawri asks for permission to visit Bagha at Gada Electronics during quiet times. Later, Iyer threatens to reveal Jethalal's jail incident to Champaklal.

4068.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4068.description: Bhide and Madhavi get interrupted by Roshan during a sweet moment. Later, the wives discuss their husbands' food choices while buying vegetables and plan to go shopping together with their husbands.

4069.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4069.description: As the ladies get ready for a shopping trip with their husbands, Taarak faces difficulty getting time off work. He asks the other husbands to skip shopping to avoid upsetting Anjali. Will they agree to help him out?

4070.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4070.description: Taarak arrives at the mall for the shopping trip. Later, Taarak's boss calls him to ask about the poem. What will Taarak do now?

4071.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4071.description: All the couples go shopping together. Sodhi jokes with Taarak about Taarak's boss being at the mall, not realizing that Taarak's boss is actually there. What happens when Taarak's boss sees him?

4072.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4072.description: Taarak's boss follows the Gokuldham men to ask about Taarak's whereabouts at the mall. The secretary suggests they may have seen someone else resembling Taarak. Later, Taarak's boss plans to send his secretary and a doctor to Taarak's house.

4073.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4073.description: Dr. Hathi tells Dr. Chaddha that Taarak has a headache from not eating Anjali's diet food. Taarak's boss shares that his wife loved the poem he wrote. Later, the Gokuldham men swap tales about their wives' shopping experiences.

4074.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4074.description: Jethalal and Bhide argue over a flowerpot. Champaklal asks Jethalal about his political views. Later, Iyer gives Jethalal and Taarak a ride, but they get stuck in traffic.

4075.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4075.description: Jethalal strategizes to maintain his friendship with Chana Kumar without upsetting Kurmura Kumar. He discusses with Chana Kumar the complexities of openly supporting him. Meanwhile, Sunita confides her stress to the Mahila Mandal.

4076.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4076.description: Kurmura Kumar comes to Gokuldham for his election campaign. Popatlal tries to convince everyone to vote for Kurmura Kumar. Later, Sonu goes out of the house to make a delivery.

4077.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4077.description: Sodhi dreams that Bhide becomes extremely rich. Champaklal asks Tapu Sena to help the birds. Later, Bhide gets upset with Tapu Sena.

4078.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4078.description: The members of Gokuldham society fight the summer heat together and get a brilliant idea to put water vessels all around for the animals and birds around.

4079.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4079.description: Goli suggests taking a rickshaw, but everyone prefers to walk to Gokuldham society. Along the way, they come across workers labouring in the sun without water. Moved by this sight, they decide to assist the workers. How will they lend a helping hand?

4080.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4080.description: Tapu Sena asks Roshan to make buttermilk for the workers, sparking Bhide's curiosity. Later, they set up a stall nearby and offer the buttermilk to the workers.

4081.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4081.description: Roshan informs the Mahila Mandal about Tapu Sena's charitable efforts and offers assistance. A buttermilk vendor charges Popatlal for 30 glasses of buttermilk. Later, Taarak praises Tapu Sena's good deeds to Jethalal.

4082.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4082.description: Chana Kumar arrives at Gada Electronics and gives Jethalal more packets of Sing Chana to distribute. Later, the police reprimands Tapu Sena for setting up their stall without permission.

4083.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4083.description: The Tapu Sena receives praise for their good work and they pledge to continue their good work throughout the summer. Gokuldham members agree to share expenses for their buttermilk mission. Later, Purush Mandli brainstorm ways to contribute to the Tapu Sena's efforts.

4084.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4084.description: Kurmura Kumar plans to take credit for Tapu Sena's work. Jethalal encounters issues with Chana Kumar. Later, others get inspired by Tapu Sena's good deeds.

4085.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4085.description: Kurmura Kumar puts his party's banner at Tapu Sena's buttermilk stall, which worries Bhide as it may upset Chana Kumar and cause trouble. Removing the banner could also upset Kurmura Kumar. What will they decide to do next?

4086.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4086.description: A reporter credits Kurmura Kumar for Tapu Sena's buttermilk stall. Chana Kumar blames Jethalal for supporting Kurmura Kumar and asks him to remove Kurmura Kumar's banner from the stall.

4087.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4087.description: Chana Kumar asks Jethalal to convince the Gokuldham members to stop offering free buttermilk. Expecting Kurmura Kumar to oppose removing his banners, Chana is surprised by his unexpected reaction.

4088.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4088.description: Gokuldham residents are split about removing the banner from the stall after Kurmura Kumar's threat. Later, Chana Kumar gives the residents a suggestion to deal with the problem.

4089.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4089.description: Kurmura Kumar's man asks other Gokuldham members to not help Jethalal and Taarak with the lemonade stall. Gokuldham residents are torn between Chana Kumar and Kurmura Kumar. Later, Jethalal and Taarak struggle to set up their lemonade stall.

4090.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4090.description: Jethalal and Taarak call Bhide for help to find lemons. They struggle to find a rickshaw while Gokuldham members wait. Later, Jethalal sets up his lemonade stall.

4091.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4091.description: Sodhi gets angry at Chana Kumar and Kurmura Kumar. Iyer drops the lemons while Tapu Sena feels bad about not helping Jethalal. Later, Kurmura Kumar's aide scolds the Gokuldham members for assisting Iyer when lemon juice gets in his eyes.

4092.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4092.description: Kurmura Kumar urges Gokuldham not to close the buttermilk stall. Taarak's boss uncovers his lemonade sales lie. Tensions escalate as Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar's groups clash over the drinks, sparking a fight.

4093.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4093.description: Inspector Pandey intervenes to resolve the issue between the two parties but his investigation uncovers evidence against Jethalal, leading to his arrest. Will the residents of Gokuldham stop his arrest?

4094.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4094.description: Sunita refuses to sell her vegetables in Gokuldham, as she is loyal to Chana Kumar. Meanwhile, a huge crowd gathers outside Gada Electronics, looking for freebies.

4095.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4095.description: Gokuldham members face problems due to Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar. They decide to shut down the lemonade and buttermilk stall, but Champaklal opposes this.

4096.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4096.description: Tapu Sena reviews the plan with everyone to avoid mistakes. Later, Bawri wishes them luck for "Mission Paar Paar," arousing the suspicion of Kurmura Kumar's and Chana Kumar's men.

4097.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4097.description: Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar work at the buttermilk and lemonade counters for publicity. Later, food officials shut down Chana Kumar's lemonade counter due to polluted water.

4098.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4098.description: Two men drink buttermilk from the stall and faint. Rita reporter accuses Kurmura Kumar of using bad curd to make buttermilk. What will Kurmura Kumar do now?

4099.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4099.description: Taarak urgently calls everyone over, announcing Anjali made juice for them. They all try to avoid tasting it. Later, Abdul gets scolded by Jethalal and Champaklal in front of his friend.

4100.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4100.description: Abdul is busy running errands for the Gokuldham society members. Abdul's friend says that everyone is taking him for granted. Will Abdul listen to his advice?

4101.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4101.description: Abdul's friend tries to talk to him, but Abdul is always busy. Popatlal drops a cake and angrily blames Bhide for the society's poor maintenance.

4102.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4102.description: Bhide scolds for not getting the pavement repaired. Later, Abdul's friend tells him that he's going abroad and tells him that Gokuldham members don't value him.

4103.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4103.description: Abdul waits for birthday wishes, telling his friend the Purush Mandli will congratulate him at the office. Will they remember?

4104.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4104.description: Abdul feels sad when no one wishes him a happy birthday. Will they finally greet him or will he lose faith in his friends?

4105.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4105.description: Abdul's friend tries to manipulate him, saying the colony uses him and nobody cares. Will Abdul fall prey to doubt and mistrust?

4106.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4106.description: Abdul asks to borrow Bhide's iron. Meanwhile, Bagha is unable to do his job properly as Bawri keeps calling him.

4107.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4107.description: Bawri asks Bagha to take a day off to celebrate their special day - the anniversary of the day they first met. But will Jethalal grant him a day off?

4108.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4108.description: Bagha tells Bawri he can't get a holiday because Jethalal's 18 lakh rupees are stuck with PK Daruwala. Bawri suggests an idea to help Jethalal recover the money.

4109.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4109.description: Bagha is upset that Jethalal didn't give him a holiday. Mr. Daruwala, in Khandala, apologizes for the payment delay. Will Jethalal get his payment today?

4110.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4110.description: Bagha and Bawri go to collect Jethalal's cheque, leaving him anxious. They arrive at Mr. Daruwala's resort. Will they get the cheque?

4111.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4111.description: Bagha and Bawri choose to celebrate their anniversary instead of heading back to Mumbai. Unfortunately, Bawri mistakenly misplaces Jethalal's cheque. What's their next move?

4112.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4112.description: Bawri suggests to Bagha that they should return to Mumbai and confess to Jethalal. They pray for guidance. What will happen next?

4113.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4113.description: Bagha worries about Jethalal seeing Bawri at his shop, but she goes along anyway. Later, Jethalal finds out his son bought a phone from his shop.

4114.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4114.description: Tapu Sena's talents are recognized with an invite to a gaming and animation conference in Pune. While everyone's bursting with pride, will everyone be allowed to go to Pune?

4115.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4115.description: Tapu Sena heads to Pune for their conference, with parents and elders wishing them luck and safe travels. Popatlal wants to teach Bhide a lesson for leaving his scooter keys behind.

4116.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4116.description: Popatlal plans to teach Bhide a lesson for his absent-mindedness. He hides Sakharam, Bhide's beloved scooter, in a hidden corner of the colony.

4117.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4117.description: Gokuldham colony members are having fun at Abdul's shop when Popatlal arrives in a fancy car, looking worried and talking to a suspicious guy. Who could that mysterious man be?

4118.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4118.description: Inspector Pandey is trying to take Champaklal to the hospital but the society members react otherwise. Later, the police are looking for Popatlal but he is nowhere to be found. Where is Popatlal?

4119.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4119.description: Inspector Pandey is on the lookout for Popatlal and searches for him everywhere. Will he be found?

4120.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4120.description: Inspector Pandey and all the members of Gokuldham colony are on the lookout for Popatlal but he is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

4121.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4121.description: Inspector Pandey is searching for Popatlal in society while Popatlal is hiding in Bhide's house creating trouble for Bhide. What has Popatlal done and will Inspector Pandey find him?

4122.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4122.description: After a frantic search, Popatlal is finally discovered locked in his closet. When asked about his disappearance, he opens up about the overwhelming stress and tension that had been building up inside him.

4123.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4123.description: Everyone is relieved to see Popatlal so happy and relaxed. And to add to the excitement, a potential wedding opportunity is on the horizon! Will Popatlal finally tie the knot and start a new chapter in his life?

4124.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4124.description: Popatlal grows increasingly impatient as he awaits a phone call from Inspector Pandey to find out if his horoscope matches the girl's. How will Popatlal handle the suspense?

4125.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4125.description: Gokuldham colony waits for the bride's family to arrive. Will everything go well for Popatlal?

4126.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4126.description: Popatlal's wait may finally be over as he meets the girl and her family, accompanied by Inspector Pandey and his wife. Will this meeting seal the deal and lead to a long-awaited wedding?

4127.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4127.description: Inspector Pandey thoroughly questions Popatlal on several matters before revealing the bride's decision.

4128.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4128.description: Popatlal's heart races as he prepares for his make-or-break meeting with his dream girl. He's determined to win her heart.

4129.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4129.description: Popatlal finally clears the air with his potential bride, laying all his cards on the table. But will his honesty pay off?

4130.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4130.description: The members of the Gokuldham Society are concerned for Popatlal since Madhubala has left him in limbo about her decision to marry him. How will they support him during this uncertain time?

4131.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4131.description: Madhubala and her family meet with Popatlal and his friends to reveal their final decision on their potential union.

4132.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4132.description: The entire colony is buzzing with excitement for Popatlal's engagement.

4133.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4133.description: Popatlal is both thrilled and anxious about his engagement ceremony. Will he be able to keep his nerves in check and make it through the big day without a hitch?

4134.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4134.description: It's Popatlal's engagement ceremony and everyone is excited. He hopes everything goes as planned. But will it all go smoothly, or will something unexpected happen?

4135.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4135.description: Popatlal's engagement ceremony is coming up and everyone is eager to welcome his beautiful bride into the family. But will the big day go off without a hitch?

4136.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4136.description: Popatlal goes missing on his engagement day, and Inspector Pandey holds the Gokuldham members responsible. Where is Popatlal, and will he show up for his engagement?

4137.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4137.description: Dr. Hathi drops a bombshell on Popatlal, revealing that he and Madhubala are both carriers of the rare genetic disorder, Thalassemia minor. The doctor warns that their marriage could lead to serious health complications.

4138.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4138.description: Tapu Sena returns from Pune, eager to celebrate their award with the entire colony. However, they're concerned that Popatlal might still be upset about his cancelled wedding and wonder how to approach him.

4139.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4139.description: The women of Gokuldham gather for a kitty party, eager to share laughter and conversation.

4140.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4140.description: All the women in Gokuldham society decide to surprise their husbands with a fresh haircut. How will the husbands react to this unexpected change in their looks?

4141.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4141.description: Bhide receives a surprise from his wife and daughter as they unveil their new hair color. Later, Popatlal summons all the men of the colony to his house for an urgent matter.

4142.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4142.description: Jethalal believes he is dreaming when Champaklal tells him to go back to sleep instead of waking up. How will Jethalal react when he realizes this might not be just a dream?

4143.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4143.description: Dr. Hathi and his wife organize a grand special breakfast for the Gokuldham residents. They visit each house to ensure nobody eats before the surprise meal.

4144.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4144.description: Everyone eagerly anticipates the special Banarasi Breakfast organized by Dr. Hathi on Sunday. Will everything unfold smoothly as planned for this exciting event?

4145.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4145.description: Bhide searches for Popatlal, convinced that Popatlal is playing a prank by hiding Sakharam.

4146.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4146.description: Bhide searches for Sakharam and discovers that Goli has gone to get breakfast on Sakharam. Later, they find Sakharam crashed with no sign of Goli.
