4147.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4147.description: The colony members express concern about Goli and Sakharam's whereabouts to Inspector Pandey.

4148.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4148.description: The colony members delight in the delicious breakfast organized by Dr. Hathi and celebrate Goli and Sakharam's return.

4149.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4149.description: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 16 years of bringing laughter and joy to millions of viewers every day.

4150.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4150.description: Bhide makes a daring challenge to the children - if he wins, they can no longer play in the compound, but if he loses, they will never be interrupted again.

4151.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4151.description: The colony members line up, each taking turns to shoot their penalty kicks, hoping to score the winning goal.

4152.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4152.description: Roshan demands that Sodhi take her out for a movie, shopping, and restaurant since it's been days since they went out. Meanwhile, Bhide is concerned that everyone will not pay the maintenance fee on time.

4153.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4153.description: Jethalal is getting ready for a work trip to Hyderabad and leaves the shop duties to his helpers. But, he tells Baagha to make sure Bawri stays away from the shop.

4154.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4154.description: Jethalal is anxious about oversleeping and missing his morning flight. He reaches out to his neighbours for help and companionship. Will anyone come to his aid?

4155.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4155.description: Jethalal thanks Iyer and Babita for their kindness and their decision to drive him to the airport for his flight. However, things take a sharp turn when he finds himself stranded with a punctured tire on a lonely street.

4156.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4156.description: Jethalal is upset because he missed his flight and fears that Bapuji will scold him. What will he do now?

4157.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4157.description: Jethalal returns to his shop after his flight is cancelled, surprising Nattu Kaka and Baagha.

4158.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4158.description: Jethalal, Bapuji, Iyer, and Babita find out that the restaurant is full. They call other options, but they're all booked too. Can they find a place to eat?

4159.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4159.description: Bhide sets the quote of the day highlighting the importance of water. The question remains: will the colony members truly grasp the severity of the situation?

4160.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4160.description: Bhide and his family head out in a cab, while Popatlal is waiting for the plumber. He receives a call asking him to get to the office as soon as possible. How will Popatlal handle the situation?

4161.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4161.description: A plumber arrives at the colony, looking for Bhide, because he has forgotten his phone inside Bhide's house. However, the colony children refuse to let the plumber break the lock and instead, ask him to wait.

4162.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4162.description: The plumber's frustration reaches a boiling point as the keys to the lock remain nowhere to be found in Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Taarak's boss faces a similar predicament, losing his keys as well.

4163.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4163.description: The situation in Gokuldha becomes chaotic as the plumber loses his temper and threatens to break Bhide's lock. However, Abdul suggests breaking the lock. Can the key maker resolve the issue?"

4164.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4164.description: Bholaram is distraught that his entire day has been ruined by searching for the keys. Meanwhile, his wife Sushma arrives in Gokuldham colony. Will the colony members be able to make amends and turn his day around?

4165.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4165.description: Bhide is thrilled about his Sunday plan to enjoy Kothimbir Vadi with his family. However, a series of unexpected events throws a wrench in his plans.

4166.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4166.description: Goli is eager to get some amchur powder, but Abdul's shop remains closed. Later, Tapu Sena informs the members of the society that Abdul hasn't shown up yet. Where could Abdul be?

4167.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4167.description: Popatlal is furious when the water stops mid-shower. He storms down and blames Bhide for the inconvenience.

4168.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4168.description: The residents of Gokuldham colony are worried because Abdul is nowhere to be found. They search for him at his house and all the places he usually visits, but there is no sign of him.

4169.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4169.description: The colony members find out that Abdul owes some people money, and they have come to collect it. Maybe that's why he has been hiding for a few days.

4170.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4170.description: Everyone is expecting Inspector Pandey to find Abdul and bring him back. However, Pandey Ji is coming back empty-handed and Abdul is nowhere to be found.

4171.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4171.description: Abdul's return brings relief to the colony, but he keeps his financial struggles to himself. Despite his cheerful reunion, Abdul is secretly desperate and decides to sell his shop, abandoning his life in the colony.

4172.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4172.description: Dr. Hathi mentions to all the men that Abdul has seemed different ever since he returned. What could be troubling Abdul?

4173.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4173.description: Abdul, desperate for money and on the verge of selling his shop, offers a 50% discount to colony members without disclosing the true reason behind his sale.

4174.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4174.description: Jethalal checks in on Nattu Kaka and Baagha to ensure the shop is running smoothly in his absence. Meanwhile, Abdul is frantically trying to sell off all the goods to raise the money he desperately needs.

4175.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4175.description: Tapu Sena is intrigued by Abdul's mysterious behaviour and decides to get to the bottom of it. They confront him, demanding to know the real reason behind his sudden decision to sell everything at a whopping 50% discount.

4176.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4176.description: The Tapu Sena installs a listening device to monitor Abdul's activities, but they feel uneasy about their decision.

4177.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4177.description: The news that Abdul is attempting to sell his shop sends shockwaves through the colony, leaving all its members stunned and concerned.

4178.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4178.description: Abdul opens up about his troubles to the members of the Gokuldham Society, who immediately offer to lend him money, but he graciously declines their help. How will Abdul manage to clear his debts on his own?

4179.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4179.description: The colony is reeling in disbelief as Abdul prepares to sell his shop and bid farewell. The thought of this being his last festival among them is unbearable. Will Abdul reconsider his decision?

4180.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4180.description: Tapu Sena is confident that they will emerge victorious in the Dahi Handi celebrations and successfully break the Matki. However, the colony members are worried about their chances.

4181.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4181.description: Tapu Sena is thrilled to participate in the Dahi Handi competition but faces disappointment when they're unable to register.

4182.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4182.description: Tapu Sena is eager to participate in the competition, but their rivals mock them due to their lack of practice and experience. Can Tapu Sena prove their doubters wrong?

4183.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4183.description: The spotlight shines bright on Tapu Sena as they prepare to take on the ultimate challenge of cracking the Matki. With the entire family and neighbourhood on edge, can they pull it off?

4184.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4184.description: Abdul discloses the real reason behind selling his shop to the Gokuldham residents. Will they stand by him in this decision?

4185.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4185.description: Tapu Sena helps Abdul save his shop by winning the Dahi Handi competition and securing the necessary funds. Meanwhile, Jethalal struggles to manage the shop on his own due to the absence of Nattu Kaka and Bagha.

4186.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4186.description: The women of Gokuldham want to take charge of the Ganpati decorations and propose their idea to the colony members.

4187.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4187.description: The women of Gokuldham are thrilled to welcome Bappa and have taken charge of all the decorations. However, they want to keep their decoration idea a secret from everyone.

4188.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4188.description: The men in the colony are eager to know the theme the women have chosen for the Ganpati celebrations, but their wives are tight-lipped about it.

4189.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4189.description: All the men try different ways to uncover the secrets and learn the theme of the decoration. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena's rivals are envious that Gokuldham's decoration video went viral and decide to sabotage their next Ganpati celebration.

4190.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4190.description: During the Ganapati celebration at Gokuldham Society, Olympic medalist Aman Sehrawat makes a special appearance, accompanied by Asit Modi.

4191.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4191.description: Gokuldham colony is abuzz with festive spirit as people throng to visit Bappa and admire the beautiful decorations created by the colony's women. Olympic medalist Aman Sehrawat's special visit adds to the excitement,

4192.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4192.description: The actors from Kahan Shuru Kahan Khatam visit Gokuldham, inviting residents to watch their film. Later, the community opens the 'Daan Peti'. What will they find inside?

4193.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4193.description: Shock and excitement erupt in the colony as members discover a staggering donation cheque tucked away in the 'Daan Peti'.

4194.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4194.description: The colony members are shocked, excited, and perplexed about what to do with the enormous donation. They wonder if it's genuine or fake, who the donor is, and whether they should investigate further.

4195.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4195.description: All the colony members gather to meet the bank manager and discuss what to do with the cheque. What will the manager say?

4196.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4196.description: Bhide, Iyer, and Jethalal are thrilled after receiving a cheque worth twenty-one lakhs for Ganpati celebrations, unaware that it's all part of a setup. What unexpected events will unfold next?

4197.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4197.description: With the donated money in hand, the colony launches a search for worthy students who need financial support to pursue their educational dreams. Will their efforts lead them to the right children?

4198.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4198.description: Gokuldham Society extends an invitation to all prospective candidates to attend the selection process for their scholarship program.

4199.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4199.description: The rivals of Tapu Sena are over the moon after convincingly tricking the Gokuldham colony members into thinking they've received a massive donation. The members are already celebrating and have announced scholarships for the kids. But will they catch on before things get out of hand?

4200.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4200.description: The colony members are shocked and disappointed when they learn that the cheque for the scholarships has been voided and payment has been stopped. What will they do now?

4201.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4201.description: The colony members are left stunned and shocked, unsure of how to proceed, after Vicky refuses to make the payment and bluntly tells them that he has changed his mind.

4202.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4202.description: Abdul informs the society members that Rita Reporter is arriving in the colony with her cameramen. With Vicky still withholding the funds, Bhide and the other members are left wondering how they will manage to handle the situation.

4203.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4203.description: The colony members are torn about how to address the scholarship situation, and they're considering being transparent about what really happened. Will they muster the courage to come clean?

4204.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4204.description: The colony members are overjoyed when Tapu Sena reveals that the funds have been secured. But how did they miraculously come up with the money?

4205.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4205.description: The entire colony comes together to prepare traditional food and make elaborate arrangements for the Sarva Pitru Amavasya ritual, a sacred ceremony to honour and pay respect to beloved ancestors.

4206.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4206.description: Jethalal struggles to sell his electronics as online markets and malls, with their enticing discounts, continue to dominate the market. Will he be able to find a solution to overcome these challenges?

4207.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4207.description: Jethalal meets with Nattu Kaka and Bagha to discuss new ideas for increasing sales at Gada Electronics. Will they come up with a plan?"

4208.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4208.description: Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha eagerly await the arrival of a special celebrity at Gada Electronics. Who is the celebrity?

4209.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4209.description: Gokuldham colony is abuzz with Navratri excitement. As the community comes together to perfect their Garba steps, but will the celebrations unfold smoothly, or will unexpected twists and turns add a dash of drama to the festivities?

4210.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4210.description: The colony members are excited about Navratri celebrations and decide to start planning the decorations. But with Bhide falling sick suddenly, who will take up the charge?

4211.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4211.description: Tapu Sena contacts the mandap decorator, but he refuses the job. Undeterred, they reach out to another decorator. Will they succeed in managing the wedding arrangements without Bhide's guidance?

4212.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4212.description: The Mahila Mandal visits Danav's home and offers support to his wife. Later, they confront Danav directly. What will be the result of their bold stand?

4213.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4213.description: Decorations for the event in Gokuldham are underway. Meanwhile, the Mahila Mandal calls for an urgent meeting involving all society members. What could be the pressing issue behind this sudden gathering?

4214.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4214.description: Bhide attempts to contact other decorators, but they all refuse due to the society's conflict with Danav. Later, Popatlal introduces a new decorator named Raka Tabla. Will he step in to assist the members with the Navratri decorations?

4215.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4215.description: The ladies of Gokuldham go to the police station to file a complaint against Danav, who beats his wife at home. Will Inspector Pandey be able to help with this situation?

4216.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4216.description: Danav dares the Gokuldham colony members to finish the decorations, saying he'll only help if they apologize. How will the colony members handle this situation?

4217.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4217.description: Everyone in Gokuldham is thrilled about the Navratri celebrations, but Danav is determined to take revenge and ruin their festivities. Will he succeed in his plans?

4218.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4218.description: Danav's wife rushes in to inform the colony members that Danav is in danger. What has happened to him, and will the colony members decide to help?

4219.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4219.description: The colony members are excited to get back to their festivities and dance Garba. Will the celebrations continue without any trouble until Raavan Dahan?

4220.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4220.description: Anjali invites Jethalal and Champaklal over for a strawberry milkshake. Later, Taarak's boss inquires about his Bade Guruji, putting Taarak in a tricky situation.

4221.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4221.description: Taarak is excited to learn that his boss will be on leave for two days, prompting him to plan some quality time with Anjali. Will his plans go smoothly?

4222.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4222.description: Taarak is pleased to have time off from work due to his boss's absence. However, the other employees are now demanding the same. Will Taarak grant their request?

4223.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4223.description: Taarak is anxious, fearing his boss's reaction if it's revealed that the whole office was on break. Could this cost him his job?

4224.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4224.description: Taarak's boss insists that he organise a meeting with Bade Guruji. Will he manage to make it happen?

4225.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4225.description: Taarak worries about how to get Bapuji to play the role of Bade Guruji for his boss. Can he convince him to go along with it?

4226.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4226.description: Champaklal is irritated with Jethalal for agreeing to Taarak's request and decides not to take on the role of Bade Guruji. How will Taarak handle this setback?

4227.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4227.description: Taarak worries whether Bapuji will make it in time to pose as Bade Guruji for Varun. Will everything go smoothly with their pretend meeting?

4228.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4228.description: Taarak and his friends are stumped on how to arrange a meeting between Varun, his boss, and Bade Guruji, especially since Varun is already acquainted with Bapuji. Can they find a fake Bade Guruji in time to pull off the charade?

4229.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4229.description: Taarak finally manages to dress up Popatlal as Bade Guruji, preparing him to meet Varun, the boss's son. Will Taarak's elaborate plan succeed, or will they get caught?

4230.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4230.description: Varun and his father seek Bade Guruji's blessings in separate encounters. Will they uncover Taarak's elaborate scheme?

4231.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4231.description: With enthusiasm high, the colony members make grand arrangements for Diwali. But will the festivities go smoothly?

4232.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4232.description: Champaklal invites the Mahila Mandal to his home and gifts them sarees for Diwali. Meanwhile, the men of Gokuldham gather at Abdul's shop. Later, Bhide makes an announcement about distributing free firecrackers to all society members.

4233.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4233.description: Tapu Sena suggests a collective purchase of firecrackers for everyone in the colony. But will the colony members be on board with this plan?

4234.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4234.description: Jethalal acquires a super firecracker and can't wait to show it off to the colony members. Will this firecracker live up to the hype, or will it fizzle out?

4235.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4235.description: Jethalal's convinced that Allrounder Patakha is going to flop, and he's worried about losing everything. Is he overthinking it, or is there something to his fear?

4236.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4236.description: The Gokuldham members are thrilled about the Allrounder Patakha and hold a lucky draw to decide who will get to light it. But will it go off with a bang, or turn out to be a dud?

4237.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4237.description: The excitement of Diwali fades, leaving the colony members feeling empty. As they try to fill the void, they begin to look for new adventures and challenges to take on.

4238.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4238.description: Champaklal encourages Jethalal to work out at home. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka devise a plan to attract more customers to the shop.

4239.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4239.description: Feeling restless in Gokuldham, Tapu Sena decides it's time for an exciting getaway. Bapuji, noticing their eagerness, hints at the perfect destination where they're sure to have a blast but keeps the location a secret.

4240.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4240.description: Bapuji surprises Tapu Sena with a secret trip, building their excitement to a peak. But how will they react when they discover the destination is an old age home?

4241.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4241.description: While Tapu Sena and Bapuji bond with the senior citizens at the old age home, Jethalal and his friends grow increasingly worried. Will they be able to find out where they've gone?

4242.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4242.description: The milkmen's strike leaves the colony struggling to get their basic daily supplies. How will the residents manage without milk?

4243.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4243.description: Gokuldham Colony faces a crisis as the milk supply runs dry, leaving everyone without their beloved morning chai. Later, Bhide struggles to decide whether to repair his fridge or replace it.

4244.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4244.description: Jethalal gets frustrated with Bagha because Bawri keeps visiting the shop repeatedly. Later, Bagha heads to Bhide's house to repair his fridge.

4245.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4245.description: Bhide unknowingly strikes a deal to sell his fridge to a scrap dealer for a shockingly low price. Just in time, Jethalal steps in to stop the sale and tries to help Bhide secure a much better offer. Will Jethalal's intervention save the day?

4246.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4246.description: After successfully delivering the fridge to the businessman, Jethalal is presented with an enticing offer to acquire more old fridges of the same brand for a generous reward.

4247.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4247.description: Jethalal faces difficulty finding old fridges in scrap shops and comes up with an exchange offer to acquire Cooling King brand fridges.

4248.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4248.description: Jethalal's social media campaign quickly gains traction, attracting a lot of attention. His tempting offer seems too good to be true and other businessmen start to wonder what the catch is.

4249.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4249.description: Jethalal successfully acquires all the fridges and is overjoyed. Later, a businessman arrives at Gada Electronics to finalize the deal. How will this transaction unfold?

4250.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4250.description: Jethalal finds himself in a dilemma with old fridges cluttering his shop just as a new shipment of fridges is about to arrive. How will he handle the situation?

4251.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4251.description: Baagha struggles with the mosquito problem as he and Nattu Kaka look after the fridges overnight, waiting for them to be transferred.

4252.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4252.description: Jethalal is concerned about the fridges lying around in the colony with no sign of anyone coming to collect them. What explanation will the businessman give when Jethalal calls him?

4253.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4253.description: Jethalal goes to the police station to file a complaint against the businessman who scammed him. Will Inspector Pandey be able to help him?

4254.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4254.description: Jethalal and his neighbours are increasingly worried as they struggle to trace Dunkiwala, the businessman who deceived Jethalal. Will they find a way to catch him?

4255.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4255.description: Jethalal and his friends arrange a meeting with Dunkiwala, hoping to catch him red-handed. Will their plan succeed?

4256.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4256.description: Upon discovering that Babu Bakkal is actually Dunkiwala, Jethalal flees from his men, taking the money with him. Will he get caught?

4257.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4257.description: Sodhi is overjoyed about his friend's visit from Punjab for his birthday. Will Roshan give him the green light for a celebration?

4258.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4258.description: Roshan refuses to allow Sodhi to throw a party for his friends visiting from out of town and suggests a paratha party instead.

4259.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4259.description: Roshan hesitates to give Sodhi permission for his party, but his friends promise he will behave. Will she agree?

4260.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4260.description: Sodhi brings Bhide and Popatlal along for Harmeet's birthday to ensure he doesn't drink. But will the two manage to resist temptation themselves?

4261.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4261.description: Harmeet tries to trick Sodhi into drinking, but Popatlal and Bhide make sure to keep him in check. Will Harmeet succeed in getting Sodhi tipsy during his birthday celebrations?

4262.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4262.description: Popatlal and Bhide manage a drunken Sodhi, while Roshan anxiously waits at home. Will Sodhi be allowed into the house?

4263.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4263.description: Bhide and Popatlal turn to Jethalal for help in managing a drunken Sodhi. Just as Jethalal is about to leave home, Champaklal catches him. Will this land Jethalal in trouble?

4264.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4264.description: The men of Gokuldham rally together to help Bhide and Popatlal manage a drunken Sodhi. They turn to Taarak, hoping he can come up with a plan to get Sodhi safely back to Gokuldham. What solution will Taarak devise?

4265.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4265.description: Anjali learns the truth about how the men of the colony lied to Roshan Bhabhi to save Sodhi after his party-sharty. Will she expose their lies?

4266.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4266.description: Anjali's plan succeeds, and Sodhi finally admits to his wife about his party-sharty and how the men of the colony made up an excuse to protect him. How will she respond?

4267.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4267.description: Jethalal grows increasingly worried about his son's future now that he's grown up. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena seeks Bhide's permission to let Sonu attend a late-night party.

4268.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4268.description: Bhide and the others grow anxious about their children's future and upcoming marriage proposals. Later, Bhide becomes particularly concerned when he finds Sonu's phone switched off.

4269.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4269.description: Bhide is on edge, worried that Sonu and Tapu Sena haven't returned from the party. He decides to take matters into his own hands and heads out to check on them.

4270.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4270.description: Bhide's concern for Sonu grows as he struggles with his distrust of Tapu and his desire to find her a suitable match quickly. How will he handle the pressure of having a growing daughter?

4271.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4271.description: Bhide is concerned about Sonu's friendship with Tapu, fearing it might blossom into love. How will he come to terms with the fact that his daughter is now grown up and capable of making her own decisions?

4272.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4272.description: Worried about Sonu and Tapu's growing friendship, Bhide decides to speed up his search for a groom for Sonu. Meanwhile, Bapuji starts looking for a bride for Tapu.

4273.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4273.description: Bhide calls in an acquaintance to help arrange Sonu's marriage. How will she react when she finds out?

4274.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4274.description: Jethalal and Champaklal attempt to persuade Tappu to consider marriage, but he firmly refuses. Meanwhile, Sonu faces similar pressure from her parents. How will the duo manage to decline their elders' expectations?

4275.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4275.description: As their families begin the search for suitable life partners, Sonu and Tapu find themselves in a state of panic. Desperate to avoid arranged marriages, will they be able to come up with a plan?

4276.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4276.description: Tapu is growing increasingly anxious as the pressure to get married mounts, but he's running out of creative excuses to dodge the issue. Will he find a clever way to wriggle out of it?

4277.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4277.description: Tapu and Sonu come up with a plan to hire an actor to help them avoid getting married. But will their plan work?

4278.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4278.description: Tapu and Sonu convince the actor to help them in this situation. Will their plan work out?

4279.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4279.description: Chotelal, disguised as an astrologer, advises Bhide to stop worrying about Sonu's marriage now, in an attempt to help Sonu escape the situation. Will Bhide be convinced?

4280.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4280.description: Popatlal keeps the Gokuldham men in suspense about his plans. Meanwhile, a father and son visit Gada Electronics to purchase a phone.

4281.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4281.description: Everyone is eager about Popatlal's huge announcement that will either shake or break their world.

4282.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4282.description: As restlessness grows, Popatlal gears up to reveal his much-awaited announcement in the clubhouse.

4283.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4283.description: Popatlal uses artificial intelligence to predict everyone's future and reads them out one by one. What surprises and revelations await them?

4284.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4284.description: While Popatlal eagerly shares everyone's future, he hesitates when it comes to Bapuji. What could he be hiding?

4285.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4285.description: In Gokuldham, everyone gets ready to welcome the New Year with elaborate celebrations and great enthusiasm.

4286.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4286.description: The Gokuldham members ring in the New Year with great enthusiasm and excitement. Meanwhile, each of them secretly prepares unique balloon surprises for the celebration.

4287.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4287.description: Everyone in Gokuldham Colony celebrates and welcomes the New Year with great excitement and festive spirit.

4288.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4288.description: Bapuji gets the opportunity to release the balloon to kick-start the New Year, but things take an unexpected turn when he ends up floating away with the balloons. Will the others manage to bring him down in time?

4289.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4289.description: Bapuji drifts across the city, carried by balloons, as the colony members race to catch up and figure out how to bring him back down. Will they manage to rescue him?

4290.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4290.description: The colony members panic as they struggle to figure out how to bring Bapuji down. With Inspector Pandey stepping in, can they find a way?

4291.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4291.description: As Bapuji floats further away, the colony members lose sight of him. How will they manage to find him and get him down safely?

4292.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4292.description: Sunder's mother senses that Champaklal might leave the country, while the Gokuldham members work to figure out the situation. Meanwhile, Inspector Pandey receives orders to locate Champaklal urgently.

4293.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4293.description: As Bapuji floats towards Pakistan, fishermen spot him and mistakenly think he's a Pakistani spy, alerting the authorities. Will they uncover the truth?

4294.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4294.description: Bapuji is apprehended by the Pakistani army, who mistake him for an Indian spy. What actions will they take against him?

4295.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4295.description: Bapuji gets captured by Pakistani soldiers and interrogated. What will Bapuji say to escape this situation?

4296.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4296.description: After being caught by Pakistani soldiers, Bapuji convinces them he's one of their spies. Will they see through his bluff or believe his story?

4297.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4297.description: Bapuji finds himself in a tight spot as the Pakistani soldiers see through his bluff. Can he devise a plan to save himself and the fishermen?

4298.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4298.description: Champaklal contacts Jethalal via video call to let him know he is safe in Kutch. Will he make it back to Gokuldham without any trouble?

4299.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4299.description: As Champaklal returns to Gokuldham, he shares the unbelievable tale of how he was swept away and captured by Pakistani soldiers. How will the residents react to his extraordinary adventure?

4300.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4300.description: The Gokuldham members find themselves both anxious and excited about the AI predictions. Will they come true, or are they just a hoax?

4301.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4301.description: Jethalal dreams that his business is booming, but Bapuji wakes him up. Will his dream turn into reality the next day?

4302.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4302.description: Jethalal discovers that his storehouse is out of electronics stock. What's preventing him from restocking his appliances?

4303.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4303.description: Jethalal is in a state of panic as the company denies him the essential stock for his electronics store. What could be the reason behind this sudden boycott?

4304.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4304.description: Jethalal's business is on the line as Ramsang cuts off his stock supply. Will he be able to find a solution?

4305.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4305.description: Jethalal is in for a shock when he discovers that a complaint has been lodged against him, leading to his stock being blocked. A surprise inspection of his store is now scheduled, which will seal his fate.

4306.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4306.description: Jethalal faces a crisis when he gets locked out of his shop on the day of a surprise inspection. Will he find a solution?

4307.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4307.description: Jethalal hatches an elaborate plan to welcome Venu Kutti. He borrows Sodhi's car, to keep him distracted. Will his scheme unfold as planned?

4308.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4308.description: Bagha disguises himself as a driver to pick up Mr. Venukutti, while Nattu Kaka poses as him to fool the real driver. Will their plan succeed?

4309.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4309.description: Bagha does everything he can to keep Mr. Venukutti occupied while Jethalal rushes to open the shop's shutters. Can he buy enough time?

4310.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4310.description: Jethalal waits at the entrance of his shop along with Bawri and the locksmith while Bagha is on his way with Mr Venkutti. How will he enter the shop?

4311.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4311.description: Venukutti gives Bagha the slip and makes his way to Jethalal's shop. Will Jethalal manage to open the shutter before it's too late?

4312.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4312.description: Mr. Venukutti bombards Jethalal with questions and complaints. Can Jethalal handle the tough interrogation?

4313.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4313.description: Bapuji is eager to go on a trip with his friends, but Jethalal is hesitant to let him go alone. Will he find a way to join in?

4314.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4314.description: Champaklal discovers that Jethalal is faking his illness. Later, his friends arrive to take him along. Can Jethalal stop him?

4315.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4315.description: Tapu and Sonu fight it out over one point in a badminton match. Later, Jethalal gets an invitation for lunch from Babita and Taarak. Whose house will he go to?

4316.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4316.description: Taarak suggests a way for Jethalal to enjoy meals at both his home and Babita's house. Will Jethalal be able to pull it off?

4317.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4317.description: Jethalal, already full from pretending to eat at Babita's house, is caught off guard when Anjali arrives. How will he manage the situation?

4318.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4318.description: Tapu informs Bhide that he has something special to share with Sonu on this special day, leaving Bhide anxious. What could it be?

4319.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4319.description: To improve his chances of getting married, Popatlal starts feeding pigeons by placing grains on Bhide's Sakharam. Will Bhide tolerate this?

4320.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4320.description: Popatlal is given the task of interviewing Bluetooth Baba. How will the conversation unfold?

4321.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4321.description: Popatlal panics as he struggles to find a rickshaw. Will Bluetooth Baba's prediction come true?

4322.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4322.description: Fear spreads through the colony as residents believe a ghost is lurking among them. Is there truth to their fears or just a misunderstanding?

4323.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4323.description: Champaklal is startled by a shadow he believes to be a ghost, while Sodhi, Popatlal, and Bhide try to reassure him. Is it really a ghost?

4324.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4324.description: The society members grow anxious after Popatlal insists he saw someone inside Mr. Verma's house. Who could it be?

4325.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4325.description: Bhide approaches Bhootnath to explain the society's rules. Meanwhile, Taarak questions Jethalal about Tapu's marriage.

4326.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4326.description: During his morning walk, Champaklal's friends propose a potential match for Tapu. Later, Raja Mastnana calls Tapu. What trouble awaits him?

4327.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4327.description: Joshi Kaka visits Bhide with a marriage proposal for Sonu. How will Bhide respond?

4328.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4328.description: Bhide discovers that Tapu and Sonu tricked him and Champaklal with Raja Mastana's help. Later, he takes Raja Mastana's number from Abdul. How will Tapu and Sonu handle the situation?

4329.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4329.description: Bhide and Madhavi dress up to meet Raja Mastana. What surprises await Tapu and Sonu?

4330.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4330.description: Bhide invites Raja Mastana to Gokuldham in front of Sonu and Tapu. Later, he hints to Champaklal about a surprise in store. What could Bhide be planning?

4331.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4331.description: Raja Mastana arrives at Gokuldham Society as part of Bhide's plan, leaving Tapu and Sonu stunned. He makes a prediction about their marriage. How will Tapu and Sonu escape this situation?

4332.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4332.description: Bhide and Madhavi are disappointed with Sonu and scold her. Distressed, she calls Tapu for help. How will they resolve the situation?

4333.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4333.description: Joshi Kaka presents Sonu with potential matches, but she turns them all down. Meanwhile, Kanji Kaka does the same for Tapu. How will Tapu and Sonu handle this situation?

4334.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4334.description: As Madhavi and Sonu head to the parlour, the Mahila Mandal catches them. Later, Bhide informs Champaklal that the ladkewale are coming to see Sonu.

4335.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4335.description: Sonu feels emotional about leaving the society after her marriage. Later, she and Tapu meet and express their sadness together.

4336.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4336.description: Sonu has a troubling dream that the groom's family has approved of her. Panicked, she calls Tapu for help. How will Tapu and Sonu handle this situation?

4337.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4337.description: Tapu suggests that Sonu elope and marry. He seeks Tapu Sena's help. Will their plan work?

4338.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4338.description: Tapu and his Sena come together to carry out their plan, but obstacles arise. Later, as Sonu attempts to leave the house, she finds Bhide blocking her path. How will she handle the situation?

4339.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4339.description: Bhide discovers that Sonu has lied to him. Meanwhile, Tapu comforts Sonu as she feels guilty for deceiving her father. Later, Bhide informs Jethalal about Tapu and Sonu's sudden disappearance. What will happen next?

4340.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4340.description: The residents of Gokuldham search for Tapu Sena at Nehru Ground but find no sign of them. Meanwhile, Tapu and Sonu purchase varmala garlands.

4341.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4341.description: The Gokuldham members search for Tapu and Sonu, while Tapu comforts Sonu, assuring her about their decision. But what are they really planning?

4342.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4342.description: Bhide files a complaint against Tapu at the police station. Meanwhile, Tapu and Sonu invite the society members to come home. Have they really gotten married?

4343.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4343.description: As Jethalal and Bhide enter the society with Inspector Pandey, they are stopped by the Mahila Mandal. Later, Tapu and Sonu finally reveal the truth to everyone.

4344.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4344.description: Tapu and Sonu confess that they are not married and reveal the whole truth behind their decision to run away from the society.

4345.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4345.description: Tapu and Sonu reveal the truth, but Inspector Pandey remains suspicious. Their story is confirmed when Dia and Raj's parents arrive at Jethalal's house.

4346.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4346.description: Gokuldham Society celebrates Holika Dahan with great enthusiasm, followed by joyful Holi festivities.

4347.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4347.description: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak, but Taarak refuses to eat them because of Anjali. Later, Bhide plays a prank on Popatlal.

4348.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4348.description: Popatlal causes a commotion in the society over earth sacks dumped in the compound. Later, Bhide calls Bhoothnath to scold him for the mess.

4349.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4349.description: The Mahila Mandal goes for their daily vegetable shopping. Later, they visit Verma Ji's newly renovated flat, but their visit takes an unexpected turn when a sudden siren startles everyone awake.

4350.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4350.description: The Gokuldham members grow frustrated with the alarm at Verma Ji's house and find a way to turn it off. Later, the Mahila Mandal admits to attempting to enter the house without permission.

4351.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4351.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka are delighted to see customers arriving early at Gada Electronics. Later, Jethalal receives a call from Hussain in Hyderabad regarding his order.

4352.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4352.description: Jethalal is eager for his meeting with Hussain, but a series of delays keep him from leaving for the office. Will he make it on time?

4353.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4353.description: Hussain assures Bagha that he will arrive on time, while Jethalal faces multiple delays on his way to the shop. Later, he meets a man named Mahesh who offers him a lift. Will he make it on time?

4354.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4354.description: Jethalal finds himself in trouble when his co-passenger suddenly flees, leaving him stuck in the car. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka anxiously await his arrival. Will he reach on time?

4355.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4355.description: Jethalal finally manages to convince the driver to drop him at his shop, but he's running out of time. Will he miss out on the business deal?

4356.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4356.description: Jethalal worries that he might lose the deal due to his delay. However, the person responsible for all the commotion arrives at Gada Electronics. Will he admit his mistake?

4357.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4357.description: The Gokuldham men enjoy a question-and-answer game over soda. Later, Bhide is startled when he feels that Sakharam has started talking.

4359.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4359.description: The police arrive at Gokuldham Society after Popatlal discovers a mysterious gunny sack outside Bhide's house. What secrets lie hidden inside?

4360.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4360.description: Excitement spreads through the colony as Bhide distributes jackfruit to everyone, a gift from his uncle's farm. However, the women find themselves puzzled over how to cook it.

4361.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4361.description: The Bhides take the initiative to prepare a variety of jackfruit dishes for Gudi Padwa, adding to the festive spirit as all of Gokuldham Colony comes together to celebrate the auspicious day.

4362.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4362.description: As the new year begins, the residents of Gokuldham Colony are in high spirits, ready to embrace new beginnings. What surprises and adventures await them in the coming year?

4363.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4363.description: Jethalal is thrilled as his sales surpass last year's numbers, prompting Natu Kaka and Bagha to request a salary increment. However, his joy turns to worry when he returns home and finds Bapuji missing.

4364.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4364.description: Champaklal scolds Jethalal for delaying the door repair. Later, at the soda shop, Taarak shares a sher with everyone. Later, Jethalal finds Champaklal crying, but what's the reason behind his tears?

4365.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4365.description: Bapuji plays a heartfelt tune on his harmonica in memory of his old friend and gets ready to go meet him. But just as he's about to leave, he realises the main door is locked from the outside. Will he be able to get out?

4366.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4366.description: With the door locked from outside, Jethalal, Tapu, and Bapuji try everything to get out of the house. But nothing seems to work. Will they manage to escape?

4367.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4367.description: Jethalal and his family are still locked inside, and despite everyone's efforts, no one can figure out a way to get them out. Will they be rescued in time?

4368.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4368.description: After being trapped inside the house, Bapuji finally gets out and rushes to meet his childhood friend before he leaves for treatment in America. Will he reach in time?

4369.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4369.description: Bapuji is on his way to meet his old friend Mannu before he leaves for America, but a blocked road forces them to take a longer route. Will he still be able to make it on time?

4370.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4370.description: Goli, Gogi, and Pinku try to protect Iyer's car, while Tapu returns with Champaklal after introducing him to his friend. Meanwhile, Jethalal learns that Champaklal has met his friend and is on his way back.

4371.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4371.description: Jethalal remains trapped inside his apartment, struggling to find a way out. The mystery deepens as he wonders who could have locked the door in the first place.

4372.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4372.description: With stars in his eyes and his heart set on his dream bike, Gogi turns to his father, Sodhi, hoping he'll make his wish come true. Will this dream ride become a reality?

4373.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4373.description: Cricket fever takes over the neighbourhood as Tapu Sena gets ready to enjoy the big match. Gogi and Tapu make things more exciting with a pizza bet on their favourite teams. Who will win the bragging rights?

4374.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4374.description: Tapu Sena heads to their favourite pizza place for a fun evening, but Goli surprises them with news about their childhood friend Rocky. What surprise does Rocky have in store for him?

4375.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4375.description: Gogi gets tempted when Rocky introduces him to fantasy cricket with promises of quick money. With his dream bike in sight, will Gogi give in?

4376.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4376.description: Gogi visits the bank to open a new account when Popatlal unexpectedly finds his Aadhar card there. Sensing something suspicious, Popatlal immediately calls Sodhi. Will Gogi get caught?

4377.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4377.description: Gogi is thrilled after earning money through a fantasy cricket app. But will this excitement turn into an obsession?

4378.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4378.description: Gogi is over the moon after winning big on the fantasy cricket app and finally getting his dream bike. But with success coming so easily, will he be able to stop himself before it turns into an obsession?

4379.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4379.description: As the cricket season nears its end, Gogi feels the pressure to go big and cash in on one last opportunity. But with no money in hand, can he find a way to fund his dream?

4380.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4380.description: Gogi is caught between excitement and anxiety after putting in all his money on the fantasy app. With everything riding on this one game, will he walk away with his dream or face a tough reality?

4381.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4381.description: Gogi needs more money to supplement his income and make up for his losses on the fantasy app. However, Tapu gives him a phone instead of cash. How will Tapu deal with this situation in his web of lies?

4382.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4382.description: Gogi finds a way to talk to Sonu and asks her for money. Later, he approaches Pinku with the same request. Will Gogi manage to recover his money?

4383.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4383.description: Desperate to win big, Gogi lies to Popatlal and borrows ten thousand rupees. With mounting debts and tangled lies, will Gogi be able to escape the trouble he has created for himself?

4384.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4384.description: Gogi is stressed as he can't make the profit he needs to pay back his loans. With pressure building from all sides, will he find a way out?

4385.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4385.description: After suffering a major loss on the fantasy app, Gogi finds himself drowning in debt. Will he come clean or dig himself deeper into trouble?

4386.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4386.description: Gogi goes missing, leaving his family and neighbours shocked as they realise he borrowed money from all of them using different excuses. Will they track him down and confront him?

4387.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4387.description: Tapu Sena, Popatlal, and Sodhi search high and low for Gogi, who has vanished along with the money. Their hunt leads them to Rocky's parents. Where is Gogi?

4388.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4388.description: Rita Reporter arrives at the society to broadcast the news, hoping it reaches Gogi. Hearing this, Sodhi vows not to eat or drink until Gogi returns. Will their efforts lead to Gogi's return?

4389.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4389.description: Everyone is worried because Gogi is nowhere to be found, and Tapu Sena is going wild trying to locate him. Will they find him safe and sound?

4390.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4390.description: Gogi gathers his friends and family to confess everything about why he took money from them. Will they understand his reasons or be too hurt to forgive him?

4391.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4391.description: As Bhide prepares for a day out with his wife, Popatlal unexpectedly calls for a meeting and accuses him of something serious. What has triggered Popatlal's anger this time?

4392.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4392.description: With the entire colony watching, Popatlal urges Bhide to open a sealed box he claims contains proof of wrongdoing. Will Bhide be able to defend himself?

4393.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4393.description: Babita confronts Jethalal after getting an electric shock from a faulty appliance she bought from him. As more complaints start pouring in, Jethalal is left scrambling to understand what's causing the issue.

4394.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4394.description: The Gokuldham residents panic after an electric shock incident and rush to turn off the main switch, only to realize the keys are missing. With no other option, they call Bhide for help.

4395.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4395.description: The entire colony gathers to play table tennis while waiting for Bhide to return with the keys. Will he have them so the electricity can finally be restored?

4396.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4396.description: Abdul comes out and informs everyone that he doesn't have the keys and that the electrician has them. This angers the colony members, who blame Bhide for the mishap. Will Bhide be able to find a solution?

4397.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4397.description: The colony members are relieved to have electricity restored after a stressful period. However, Bhide and Popatlal remain worried, as Bhootnath has not responded or provided any update on the renovation.

4398.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4398.description: Sonu prepares a special dinner for Bhide and invites all her friends to join. Later, Bhide learns that a new family will soon be moving into Gokuldham Colony. Who could they be?

4399.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4399.description: All the colony members are excited about the new family moving in, but there's also a hint of concern about whether they'll get along. Who will their new neighbours be?

4400.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4400.description: The society eagerly prepares to welcome a new member. However, later, Bhoothnath arrives with shocking news that changes everything.

4401.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4401.description: Bapuji and Tapu urge Jethalal to bring Daya back from Gujarat. Meanwhile, Baawri surprises everyone by bringing customers to the shop and serving breakfast to Baagha. Will the customers make big purchases?

4402.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4402.description: Jethalal breathes a sigh of relief when he learns there is no complaint against him. Instead, the association is planning a trip to the Himalayas. How will Jethalal react to this unexpected news?

4403.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4403.description: As Jethalal begins planning for his Himalayan trip, several colony members show interest in joining him. Meanwhile, he starts preparing Bapuji to manage the shop in his absence. Will everything fall into place?

4404.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4404.description: Investment fever grips Gokuldham Society as everyone looks for smart ways to grow their money. Later, Taarak is added to an exclusive investment group claiming to have top analysts. Will he be tempted to join in?

4405.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4405.description: Taarak is thrilled by the promising investment group, especially after spotting some well-known names. But in the excitement, he loses track of time and gets late for work. Will he make it on time and share the opportunity with his boss?

4406.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4406.description: Taarak advises his boss to invest, making an investment himself as well. Later, Jethalal turns to Taarak for guidance on the same opportunity. But is it all too good to be true or just a scam in disguise?

4407.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4407.description: After hearing Taarak, everyone in Gokuldham Colony invests in the app. But will this investment bring them gains or is it all just a scam?

4408.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4408.description: Everyone in the colony is excited about their new investment, but Bapuji advises Jethalal to wait until the profits actually reach his account. What will Jethalal discover when he finally tries to withdraw the money?

4409.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4409.description: The colony members get excited about earning big and gear up for a major investment meeting at night. With high hopes and big dreams, will everything go as planned or will there be a twist?

4410.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4410.description: Excitement runs high in the colony as everyone invests heavily after a successful meeting, dreaming of massive returns within a year. But is this golden opportunity too good to be true?

4411.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4411.description: The colony is buzzing with excitement as the moment arrives to check the returns on their big investment. Everyone is sure they've struck gold, but will the outcome match their expectations?

4412.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4412.description: After spotting an error on the website and in the group, panic spreads among the society members - and even Taarak's boss grows anxious. With no other option, they turn to Inspector Pandey for help.

4413.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4413.description: Panic sets in across the colony as the residents realise they've fallen victim to a massive fraud. All their investments are gone. How will they cope with this shock and find a way forward?

4414.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4414.description: The colony is gripped with panic after discovering their entire investment has vanished. With the cyber crime unit offering no certainty of justice, can they find a way to recover their lost money?

4415.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4415.description: As panic takes over the society, the police deliver surprising news that the matter has been resolved. How will the members react to this?

4416.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4416.description: Popatlal surprises everyone as he reveals how he cracked the cyber fraud case with his sharp thinking and courage.

4417.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4417.description: With the scammers' location finally known, Popatlal gears up in disguise to take them down. Will he be able to break open the fraud ring?

4418.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4418.description: Popatlal emerges as a hero after exposing the scam and assuring everyone their money will be returned. Later, the society members apologize to Taarak.

4419.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4419.description: While the colony celebrates Popatlal receiving a prestigious government award, Taarak's boss finds himself in trouble when a guest complains about paranormal activity in his bungalow.

4420.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4420.description: Taarak asks his boss for a leave, but the boss says he needs time to decide. With strange happenings in his haunted house, will the boss grant the leave?

4421.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4421.description: Taarak is invited to his boss's home for more than just a visit. A strange mystery has taken over the house, and his boss needs help. With his guest in fear, will Taarak step into this eerie situation?

4422.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4422.description: Taarak is asked by his boss to stay at the bungalow for three days without coming back early. While Taarak doesn't know the real reason, his boss hopes to uncover a ghostly mystery. But the colony members want to come too. Will the boss allow it?

4423.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4423.description: The colony is thrilled about a three-day picnic at Taarak's boss' bungalow. But will it be all fun and games, or will something spooky turn the trip upside down?

4424.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4424.description: Tapu Sena looks forward to the picnic as the rest of Gokuldham packs their bags. Will this getaway bring new memories for everyone?

4425.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4425.description: With bags packed and spirits high, the colony sets off for their bungalow picnic. But what twists will their road trip take?

4426.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4426.description: All the colony members finally arrive at the bungalow, excited for three days of fun and relaxation. But will their getaway turn spooky, just as Taarak's boss had suspected?

4427.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4427.description: The colony members settle into the bungalow and begin their picnic as they start to relax. But just as they get comfortable, will something spooky disrupt their fun?

4428.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4428.description: While everyone is busy having fun at the bungalow, Popatlal strays into the jungle and runs into a mysterious woman named Chakori. Who is she and why is she there?

4429.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4429.description: As the colony members enjoy their time at the bungalow, Chakori waits patiently for night to fall. Will she end up spooking everyone once darkness sets in?

4430.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4430.description: Bhide is terrified after spotting Chakori on the terrace. Later, while everyone relaxes by the pool, he sees a shadow again. Will anyone believe what he saw?

4431.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4431.description: Popatlal is drawn to Chakori and keeps going back to the well, brushing off everyone's concerns. Will his stubbornness cost him dearly?

4432.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4432.description: As everyone enjoys games on their last day at the bungalow, they warn Popatlal to stay away from the well. But will he ignore them once again and go to meet Chakori one last time?

4433.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4433.description: It's the final night at the bungalow and the men are all set to party. But with Chakori lurking nearby and Popatlal hoping for a last meeting, will the night turn from fun to fear?

4434.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4434.description: As the men wrap up their party session and head to bed, Bhide unexpectedly comes face to face with Chakori. Alone and startled, what will the mysterious spirit do to him?

4435.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4435.description: Bhide spends a spooky night with Chakori, but when he shares his experience, no one believes him and blames it on the effects of the party. Will Chakori make another move?

4436.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4436.description: On the final day of the trip, Popatlal eagerly plans to propose to Chakori. But will he get to meet her, or will there be a twist in his path?

4437.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4437.description: Popatlal has completely fallen for Chakori and is eager to express his feelings to her. But how will his friends react when they finally come face to face with Chakori and learn about his love?

4438.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4438.description: Popatlal is deeply in love with Chakori and feels hurt when Bhide calls her a "Bhootni," causing Chakori to leave in anger. Will Bhide be able to explain his spooky encounter and make the others believe him?

4439.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4439.description: Popatlal is desperate to ask Chakori for forgiveness and make amends. Meanwhile, Bhide tries to explain his spooky night with Chakori to everyone. Will they believe his side of the story?

4440.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4440.description: When the caretaker finally confirms that Chakori is a ghost, Popatlal is left stunned and heartbroken. Will he be able to accept this chilling reality?

4441.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4441.description: The colony members decide to leave after learning about the ghost and the spooky events. But will they actually manage to escape?

4442.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4442.description: The bus meant to pick up the Gokuldham residents doesn't arrive as Chakori had it stopped. Anjali takes charge and calls Taarak's boss. Will they find a way out of the bungalow?

4443.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4443.description: As the colony members get stuck inside the bungalow, Chakori begins to spook them with her antics. How will they handle this eerie night?

4444.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4444.description: The Gokuldham members face Chakori, who terrifies them with a strong warning to leave. Will they be able to make it out safely?

4445.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4445.description: Popatlal lands in deep trouble when Chakori forces him to marry her. How will he escape this situation?

4446.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4446.description: Chakori traps Popatlal and forces him into marriage, leaving the colony members worried. Will they save him before it's too late?

4447.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4447.description: Chakori finally admits she is not a ghost, leaving everyone stunned. What shocking secret will she reveal next?

4448.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4448.description: Taarak's boss apologises to the Gokuldham members for all the trouble. Later, Popatlal exposes the real mastermind behind Chakori's secret.

4449.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4449.description: Jethalal returns from his Himalayan trip and plans to surprise the Gokuldham residents who are having fun at the bungalow.

4450.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4450.description: The colony feels lively as repairs finish, and everyone eagerly waits for a new family to move in. But will this new beginning bring joy or unexpected challenges for them?

4451.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4451.description: Jethalal gets irritated when Bawri comes to the shop as a customer looking to buy a toaster. Will Jethalal sell her the toaster?

4452.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4452.description: Jethalal finds himself in a financial crunch as delayed payments prevent him from restocking electronics. Can he arrange the funds in time?

4453.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4453.description: Jethalal is stunned after learning he transferred 25 lakhs to the wrong person. Can he recover the amount before it's too late?

4454.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4454.description: Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha split the contacts among themselves and decide to follow up on the pending payments. Will Jethalal be able to find a solution to recover the dues and pay it ahead?

4455.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4455.description: Jethalal receives a warning that he'll be blacklisted if his dues aren't cleared soon. With mounting pressure, can he find a way out in time?

4456.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4456.description: Champaklal senses Jethalal's worries and confronts him about it. Later, the entire Gokuldham Colony comes together to support him. Will Jethalal be able to pay off Toni Company now?

4457.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4457.description: With blacklisting looming, Bawri becomes Jethalal's unlikely saviour by helping him arrange the much-needed funds. How will Jethalal react to this?

4458.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4458.description: Jethalal is desperate to get back the money he mistakenly transferred, but the man who owes him keeps dodging him. Will Jethalal manage to retrieve it?

4459.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4459.description: Frustrated after repeated failures to recover his money, Jethalal finally consults a lawyer. Will the legal route give him the breakthrough he needs?

4460.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4460.description: Jethalal fears his case could drag on for years, while Taarak is stressed by his boss's constant calls. Will Jethalal find a way to recover his money?

4461.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4461.description: It's celebration time in Gokuldham as Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah completes 17 delightful years. Amidst the joy, Jethalal finds himself cornered when Bapuji begins probing about the money. Will he dodge the question or confess?

4462.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4462.description: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about recovering the money, but later tells the truth to his friends. Will they come up with a plan to help him get it back?

4463.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4463.description: Jethalal and his friends take matters into their own hands and show up disguised as goons to recover the lost money. Will they succeed?

4464.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4464.description: In a desperate attempt to recover his money, Jethalal and his friends disguise themselves as local goons and confront Nekchand at his house. Will their dramatic plan finally pay off?

4465.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4465.description: Jethalal and his friends' risky act of dressing up as goons takes a wild turn when Inspector Pandey unexpectedly lands up at Nekchand's house. Can they wriggle their way out of this mess?

4466.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4466.description: Nekchand firmly tells his wife that he has no intention of returning Jethalal's money. Meanwhile, Champaklal and Tapu decide to confront Nekchand together. Will they be able to make him change his mind?

4467.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4467.description: Tapu and Bapuji return disappointed after failing to get the money back from Nekchand. But Tapu isn't ready to give up just yet. Will his new idea finally turn things around?

4468.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4468.description: To get back at Nekchand, Babita and Iyer pretend to be real estate agents offering a golden deal. Will Nekchand fall for the bait or outsmart them once again?

4469.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4469.description: Babita and Iyer's plan works, and Nekchand shows interest in the property. However, he wants to visit it immediately. Will Babita and Iyer manage to arrange it in time?

4470.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4470.description: Popatlal panics when his wig, crucial to his Pyarelal disguise, goes missing just before meeting Nekchand. Will he be able to manage without getting caught?

4471.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4471.description: After much convincing and clever acting, Nekchand finally agrees to pay the token. Will the plan go through as expected?

4472.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4472.description: The Gokuldham residents prepare all the documents to present to Nekchand. But when he arrives, will he hand over the token money or will a new problem arise?

4473.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4473.description: Nekchand's greed backfires as the Gokuldham residents manage to extract the money from him. What will his reaction be?

4474.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4474.description: Bapuji's sudden decision to return the money to Nekchand leaves the entire society in shock. The members cannot understand why he would make such a choice. Will they question him?

4475.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4475.description: Excitement fills the colony as Verma Ji tells Bhide about a new family moving in. Will the neighbours welcome them warmly or face unexpected surprises?

4476.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4476.description: Bhootnath takes away the flat keys and says the new family cannot enter until his bills are paid. Will he change his mind and return the keys?

4477.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4477.description: Bhide and the colony members are excited to welcome the new family and have prepared for their arrival. But as the wait gets longer, everyone wonders when they will finally reach the colony.

4478.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4478.description: Bhide has to step out for work but fears that the new family might arrive in his absence. Just then, an unknown tempo enters Gokuldham. How will Bhide handle the situation?

4479.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4479.description: The colony members prepare to welcome the new family, unaware that two tricksters are plotting to steal the tempo filled with their belongings. Will the plan get exposed?

4480.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4480.description: The Gokuldham members cannot believe their eyes as camels walk into their neighbourhood. The new family arrives in style, leaving everyone curious and surprised about their grand entry.

4481.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4481.description: The society gives a warm welcome to Ratan, Rupa and their family, but the big question remains. Will they blend into the colony life with ease or will trouble make its way to their new beginning?

4482.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4482.description: As the new family settles into the colony, they are shocked to learn that their tempo filled with belongings has gone missing. How will the family handle this unexpected crisis?

4483.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4483.description: With panic spreading in the colony after the missing tempo, the society members call upon Inspector Pandey. Will he be able to crack the case and bring relief to everyone?

4484.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4484.description: Inspector Pandey arrives in Gokuldham to investigate the missing tempo, but the driver shifts the blame onto Bhide. Will Inspector Pandey uncover the real culprit?

4485.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4485.description: The new family cannot step into their home because their tempo is missing, and as the situation turns tense, Inspector Pandey begins questioning Bhide and Madhvi to find out what really happened.

4486.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4486.description: Inspector Pandey joins hands with the colony members to trace the missing tempo. But will their search finally lead them to a solid clue?

4487.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4487.description: The colony joins Inspector Pandey to track down the missing tempo. Excitement turns into shock when the tempo they find isn't the right one. Now, with time slipping away, will they be able to locate their belongings?

4488.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4488.description: The thieves go on the run after the media exposes the stolen tempo. Now the pressure is on as the colony and Inspector Pandey try to catch them before they disappear.

4489.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4489.description: The colony members rejoice when they hear that the tempo thieves have taken the vehicle to Sodhi's garage for repairs. But the big question remains, will they finally be able to catch them this time?

4490.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4490.description: When the colony members reach Sodhi's garage, they are shocked to see the mechanic tied up while the thieves are nowhere to be seen. How will they track down the culprits now?

4491.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4491.description: The thieves manage to trick the colony members and escape once again. Now Inspector Pandey and the Gokuldham residents join forces for the chase. But will they be fast enough to catch them this time?

4492.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4492.description: Inspector Pandey and the Gokuldham members corner the thieves from all directions, leaving no room for escape. Will the Binjolas reclaim what was stolen from them?

4493.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4493.description: Tapu comes up with a smart idea to trace the thieves, and the colony pins all their hopes on him. Will this plan finally work or will the culprits escape yet again?

4494.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4494.description: The pressure mounts on Inspector Pandey as the tempo thieves bluff him and escape. Later, he surprises everyone by bringing the tempo back to the society. How did Inspector Pandey manage to catch the thieves?

4495.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4495.description: With the tempo recovered and belongings restored, the new family finally settles in. The Gokuldham members gather together to give them a heartfelt welcome, marking a fresh start in the colony.

4496.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4496.description: As the Binjolas settle into the society, Bhide and the others begin planning for Ganesh Utsav while Tapu Sena takes charge of the preparations. What new adventure will this celebration bring?

4497.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4497.description: The new family begins their journey in Gokuldham colony and on Ganesh Utsav they make a heartfelt request to Bhide. Will the colony members come together to make it happen?

4498.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4498.description: Gokuldham Colony comes alive with festive decorations and joy as the society prepares to welcome Bappa. Later, Tapu Sena steps in and lays down a set of rules before everyone.

4499.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4499.description: The colony members warmly embrace the new rules set by Tapu Sena and begin putting them into practice. Later, the Binjola kids lay down a condition before anyone can relish the prasad. What could it be?

4500.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4500.description: The Binjola kids refuse to let anyone eat the prasad until Bappa is offered his share first. As their demand starts getting out of hand, how will the colony members handle the situation?

4501.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4501.description: Tensions rise as devotees begin complaining about not receiving the prasad. Later, Bhide is called in to resolve the matter. How will Gokuldham Society handle this situation?

4502.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4502.description: Champaklal tries to convince the children to eat and drop their stubbornness. But just then, another problem arises. How will the society handle it?
