4503.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4503.description: The colony members eagerly wait for Tapu's idea to unfold so they can begin the Rangarang Program. During the aarti, the plan is set into motion. But will it be enough to convince the kids?

4504.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4504.description: Veer and Bansri are deeply heartbroken after learning what the colony members have done. As the society leaves everything in Bappa's hands, how will the children be convinced?

4505.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4505.description: Moved by the devotion of Veer and Bansri, Lord Ganesh himself appears before them and assures them that he has accepted their laddoos. Later, the children gather everyone in the society compound.

4506.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4506.description: All the members offer their prayers and prasad before Bappa. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena takes on the task of distributing the prasad to those whose names are on the list.

4507.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4507.description: As the Rangarang program begins, the members offer a heartfelt Ganesh Vandana in different languages and celebrate the event with joy.

4508.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4508.description: Taarak recites a poetry and after the elders, it is now time for the Tapu Sena to perform. Will everyone enjoy their act?

4509.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4509.description: Tapu Sena puts together a surprise birthday plan for Pinku, but Iyer walks in unexpectedly. Will their surprise still work out as planned?

4510.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4510.description: Tapu Sena informs Bhide and the society members about Pinku's surprise birthday. As everyone gathers at the clubhouse, will Pinku arrive to be surprised?

4511.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4511.description: The society members gather in the clubhouse and celebrate while waiting for Pinku. Just then, Gogi reveals that Pinku is not at home. Where could he be?

4512.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4512.description: Tapu Sena learns the traditional steps of Garba, while Veer and Bansri head to Bhide's house for tuition. Will the class go smoothly?

4513.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4513.description: Sonu scrapes the wall paint while cleaning before her friend's visit. How will Bhide react, and will he agree to get it repainted?

4514.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4514.description: Disguised as a customer, a man tries to steal from Jethalal's shop but Bagha catches him. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal for help in buying wall paints.

4515.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4515.description: Bhide confidently assures Madhvi and Sonu that he will paint Sonu's room himself. But how will it actually turn out?

4516.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4516.description: Madhvi and Sonu clean up the mess made by Bhide and ask him to give up on painting Sonu's room himself. Later, Bhide starts looking for a painter.

4517.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4517.description: A Lucknowi painter arrives at Bhide's house to paint Sonu's room. Will he be of help or bring more trouble for the Bhide family?

4518.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4518.description: Bhide hires a new painter for Sonu's room, but the painter dozes off before starting the work. How will Bhide get the room painted?

4519.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4519.description: Tapu Sena decides to help paint Sonu's room while Sonu considers cancelling her plan of calling her friend home. Later, Madhvi comes up with a solution. What is it?

4520.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4520.description: As Sonu's room gets painted with Asian Paints, Bhide and Madhvi decide to give their entire house a fresh new look. While the painting is underway, the Bhide family enjoys some much-needed relaxation time.

4521.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4521.description: Bagha and Nattu Kaka excitedly wait to show Jethalal the new banner outside the shop. But will Jethalal appreciate their effort or end up scolding them instead?

4522.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4522.description: Jethalal and the others enjoy practising garba in the shop, while the Mahila Mandal excitedly plans the upcoming Navratri celebrations. What surprises and fun moments await the Gokuldham residents this festive season?

4523.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4523.description: Ratan and Roopa go missing on the first day of Navratri, leaving everyone in the society worried and curious. Just as the celebration begins to feel incomplete, they arrive with a big surprise that leaves everyone stunned. What could it be?

4524.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4524.description: Tapu Sena and the other members decorate the clubhouse beautifully for the Garba celebrations. As everyone gathers to play, who will steal the spotlight on the dance floor?

4525.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4525.description: The Garba competition heats up as the members showcase their best moves and festive spirit. Who will emerge as the star performer?

4526.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4526.description: The Garba competition continues in full swing as everyone showcases their best moves. Later, the winners are honored with a beautiful winning garland.

4527.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4527.description: Anjali scolds Taarak for eating outside food while she has prepared a healthy salad for him at home. How will Taarak manage to get out of this tricky situation?

4528.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4528.description: Anjali takes Dr. Hathi's advice to help Taarak reduce his weight. Later, the men of Gokuldham discuss Taarak's diet and fitness plan in their own amusing way as they try to come up with a plan to convince Anjali.

4529.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4529.description: Taarak and his friends brainstorm ways to escape his healthy tiffin. Later, Jethalal deals with an unusual customer at his shop.

4530.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4530.description: As Taarak gets ready to enjoy the delicious food sent by Jethalal, Anjali suddenly arrives at his office. Will Taarak get caught or manage to escape the situation?

4531.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4531.description: All the men of the colony come together to secretly make Sunday a fun day for Taarak by getting him all his favourite food behind Anjali's back. Will their plan succeed?

4532.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4532.description: While Anjali visits Ratan and Roopa's house to prepare diet food, Jethalal and the others continue their Mission Masaledaar to help Taarak. Will their plan succeed?

4533.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4533.description: Bhide tries to distract Anjali so that Taarak's food can be delivered. But just then, Anjali walks in while the delivery is taking place. Will Mission Masaledaar succeed or end in trouble?

4534.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4534.description: Taarak tries to win Anjali's forgiveness with a heartfelt poem. Later, Anjali agrees to stay but sets a condition to punish Taarak and his friends. What will her punishment be?

4535.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4535.description: Veer and Bansri get scolded for bursting crackers in the society compound. Later, the members of Gokuldham society gear up to celebrate the festival of lights with great joy and excitement.

4536.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4536.description: A woman named Rambha arrives at Gokuldham Society to meet Popatlal. Could she finally be the girl of Popatlal's dreams?

4537.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4537.description: Babita and Iyer give a box of laddoos to the Bhides, the same one that has been secretly circling around the society. When Bhide passes it on to the Sodhi family, will the laddoo box finally find its rightful owner again?

4538.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4538.description: To track down his laddoo box, Popatlal first asks Taarak and then the other members continue questioning each other in the society. Will he discover that his box has been passed around the entire neighbourhood?

4539.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4539.description: Everyone gathers in the clubhouse, hoping the laddoo box will finally be found. Later, Popatlal performs a magic trick that leaves the members stunned. How will they react to this unexpected surprise?

4540.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4540.description: On Babita's request, Iyer offers to drop Jethalal to the office, but his car refuses to start. Later, the entire Binjola family gathers for an important discussion. What big matter are they about to reveal?

4541.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4541.description: The Binjolas invite Batuk Maharaj to help them name their new scooter. With everyone pitching in ideas, will they finally settle on the perfect name?

4542.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4542.description: Champaklal's friends tease him for not donating to the old-age home. Feeling upset, he later talks to Tapu about it. How will Champaklal handle the situation?

4543.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4543.description: Jethalal deals with a new set of customers at his shop, while Taarak reminds him about handing over the cheque to the old age home. Will Jethalal finally complete the task this time, or will fresh hurdles come his way again?

4544.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4544.description: Jethalal visits the bank to request a new cheque book and later sits down to prepare the cheque. But is another hurdle waiting to stop him this time?

4545.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4545.description: Jethalal loses the receipt for a payment and panics, knowing he already told Bapuji it was done. Will he find a way out of this mess?

4546.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4546.description: After losing the receipt, Jethalal hides from Champaklal in the society and tries to contact the auto driver, hoping he might have left it there. Will Jethalal be able to find the missing receipt?

4547.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4547.description: Jethalal pins his hopes on Iyer to find the missing receipt, while Champaklal keeps calling to ask about it. Later, he calls Bagha and Nattu Kaka but none of them respond. Will he find the receipt?

4548.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4548.description: Jethalal rushes to his shop to search for the missing receipt but ends up having to pay a fine along the way. With Champaklal calling him repeatedly, how will Jethalal explain the situation about the lost receipt?

4549.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4549.description: Tapu comes up with a plan to help Jethalal by creating a fake receipt and asks him to show it to Champaklal. But will Champaklal see through their plan?

4550.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4550.description: Nattu Kaka and Bagha arrive just in time to hand over another fake receipt to Champaklal, exposing Jethalal and Tapu's lie. How will Jethalal face Champaklal's anger now?

4551.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4551.description: Champaklal decides to punish Jethalal and Tapu by announcing that he's leaving for Bhachau. Later, Rupa arrives with food for the Gada family.

4552.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4552.description: While Tapu Sena enjoys a game of cricket, Veer and Bansri provoke Goli against Tapu, leading him to challenge Tapu. Who will emerge victorious?

4553.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4553.description: Bhide and Goli collide, causing Tapu's catch to be dropped and the challenge to be lost. Later, the Mahila Mandal decides to join in and play cricket.

4554.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4554.description: Madhavi and Babita accidentally break the glass of their own house while playing cricket, leaving everyone worried about Bhide's reaction. Meanwhile, Bhide learns about the incident and assumes Tapu is behind it. How will the misunderstanding unfold?

4555.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4555.description: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight regarding Tapu and the broken glass, and only Inspector Pandey can control the chaos. Will they resolve the case or confuse Pandey even more?

4556.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4556.description: Bhide and Iyer put their side of the story before Inspector Pandey, and Jethalal explains his as well. Soon after, the Mahila Mandal arrives at the police station. Will Madhavi and Babita admit what really happened?

4557.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4557.description: The Mahila Mandal finally admit that they were the ones who broke the window glass, clearing Tapu of all blame. With the truth out, Bhide and Iyer are left embarrassed and now must find a sincere way to apologise to Jethalal.

4558.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4558.description: Bhide grows tense as he struggles to find someone to fix the broken glass. Later, Popatlal snaps at him and chases him around the society. What caused his outburst?

4559.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4559.description: Bhide gives Abdul a lesson on saving water. Later, at the shop, Abdul tells everyone he has a surprise waiting for them. What could it be?

4560.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4560.description: Abdul celebrates with everyone in the society as he completes 500 days with his cycle. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call to interview a high profile criminal who is about to be released from jail.

4561.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4561.description: Popatlal meets Chunnilal Talatode outside the jail to take his interview. Later, Chunnilal enquires about his lucky cycle which happens to be with Abdul. How will this turn out?

4562.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4562.description: Chunnilal tries to buy the cycle from Abdul but flees the moment he spots Popatlal. Later, he hatches a plan to sneak into Gokuldham. Will he manage to reclaim his lucky cycle?

4563.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4563.description: Chunnilal's men offer Abdul an unusually high price for his cycle, raising suspicion. With Abdul refusing to sell, how will they try to take it now?

4564.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4564.description: The society members can't stop discussing the huge offer Abdul received for his cycle. Later, they call Babu Chipke to inspect it. What will he discover?

4565.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4565.description: Babu Chipke assures everyone in Gokuldham that the cycle is nothing extraordinary. Still, the members grow curious and try to uncover its secret, while Chunnilal thinks of a way to snatch it.

4566.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4566.description: Ratan tells a story while everyone keeps wondering what's really special about the cycle. Later, Roshan suggests getting it checked by her uncle. What will they discover about the cycle now?

4567.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4567.description: The Gokuldham members head out to meet Rustom to uncover the truth about the cycle. Meanwhile, Chunnilal makes his plan to reclaim it. What happens when their paths collide?

4568.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4568.description: While Champaklal raises a solid point about the cycle, Chunnilal Talatode arrives in Gokuldham disguised as Dinesh Ghoda. What is he plotting now?

4569.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4569.description: Just as Chunnilal is about to take the cycle out of the society he runs into Popatlal. Popatlal lays down a condition before he will allow Chunnilal to take it. What will Chunnilal do?

4570.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4570.description: Suspicion around the cycle keeps growing in the society, and everyone tries to protect it. Meanwhile, Chunnilal comes up with a new plan to steal it. What happens next?

4571.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4571.description: Chunnilal finally puts his plan into motion and heads to Gokuldham Colony to steal the cycle. Will the society members be able to save it in time?

4572.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4572.description: Chunnilal manages to steal the cycle, leaving Bhide and Abdul stunned. How will they get it back now?

4573.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4573.description: Using their quick thinking, Tapu Sena swaps Abdul's cycle, leaving Chunnilal annoyed when he realises he stole the wrong one. Later, while trying to remove the mark from the cycle, they uncover something unexpected. What could it be?

4574.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4574.description: The society members are stunned to discover that the cycle is made of gold. Will Chunnilal come up with yet another plan to steal it?

4575.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4575.description: Abdul and the society celebrate his newfound fortune after discovering the gold cycle. While everyone enjoys taking a ride, Chunnilal hatches a plan to slip into Gokuldham and reclaim the cycle.

4576.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4576.description: Chunnilal storms into Gokuldham with his men and tries to take the cycle at gunpoint. How will the society deal with this threat?

4577.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4577.description: Chunnilal and his men kidnap Abdul and demand the gold cycle in exchange. Will the Gokuldham members give up the cycle to save him?

4578.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4578.description: Gokuldham members come together to plan Abdul's rescue in exchange for the cycle, while Abdul remains held at a remote spot. How will they manage to bring him back safely?

4579.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4579.description: Gokuldham members head out with the cycle to rescue Abdul at the spot Chunnilal mentioned, while the rest of the society anxiously waits back home. What unfolds next?

4580.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4580.description: Chunnilal's men trick the Gokuldham members, blindfold them, and take them to an isolated location. Meanwhile, the others pray for their safety. Will the Gokuldham members outsmart Chunnilal and his gang?

4581.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4581.description: Chunnilal gets the cycle and the Gokuldham members get Abdul. Before they can escape, they trick the gang. Will they manage to get away with the cycle?

4582.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4582.description: Gokuldham celebrates Abdul's return, but curiosity grows over how Chunnilal got the gold cycle. What new secret will come to light?

4583.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4583.description: Abdul, Ratan and Dr Hathi discuss putting the gold cycle behind them. Later, Sodhi plays a prank on Popatlal when he complains of feeling cold.

4584.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4584.description: The Gokuldham men tease Popatlal for feeling cold. Later, Champaklal insists on taking Jethalal out for exercise. Will Jethalal agree?

4585.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4585.description: Champaklal and his friends enjoy a Zumba session at the park. Meanwhile, Jethalal waits for Tapu and Champaklal to return as he needs to leave for the office. Later, one of Champaklal's friends arrives at the house and finds it locked.

4586.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4586.description: Jethalal scolds Bagha and Nattu Kaka for calling him to work early, while Tapu keeps Nanji Kaka entertained at home as they wait for Champaklal. But where has Champaklal gone?

4587.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4587.description: Tapu Sena sets out to search for Champaklal and later informs Bhide and Popatlal. Will they be able to find him?

4588.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4588.description: The search for Champaklal continues as the Gokuldham members circulate his photo and ask around about his whereabouts. Where has Champaklal gone?

4589.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4589.description: Champaklal climbs a tree to help a child retrieve his kite but gets stuck. How will Tapu Sena and the others bring him down safely?

4590.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4590.description: The entire society gathers at the park to support Champaklal and bring him food, while Tapu and Gogi look for a way to help him get down. How will they manage it?

4591.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4591.description: The Gokuldham members devise a plan to bring Champaklal down and turn to Bagha for help. Will he find a solution?

4592.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4592.description: The Gokuldham members bring ladders and tie them together to help Champaklal get down, but he spots a snake on the tree. How will he come down now?

4593.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4593.description: Trapped in a tree, Bapuji faces fresh danger as a snake slithers towards him. Can the colony members rescue him in time?

4594.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4594.description: Abdul calls a snake charmer to rescue Champaklal by catching the snake. But will this solution create more problems instead?

4595.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4595.description: Tapu calls the Dahi Handi team to help bring Champaklal down from the tree. Will this plan work?

4596.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4596.description: Inspector Pandey suspects Champaklal was attempting suicide, creating another problem for him. Later, Nanji Kaka arrives to meet Champaklal. Will he learn about the tree incident?

4597.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4597.description: Champaklal reminisces about his younger days with Tapu and Jethalal and recalls legendary actor Dharmendra. Later, the other members also share their memories of the late actor Dharmendra.

4598.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4598.description: In memory of the late actor Dharmendra, the Gokuldham colony celebrates New Year's Eve, joined by Sanket Gokhale.

4599.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4599.description: The program continues with the society members dressing up as Dharmendra ji from his iconic films. Later, they come together to play a quiz based on Dharam ji and his memorable career.

4600.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4600.description: The Dharam Ji celebration continues in Gokuldham as the members share interesting facts and trivia about the legendary actor, while also dancing and singing his famous songs.

4601.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4601.description: The Dharam Ji fever continues in Gokuldham as the members showcase their dancing skills. Which member will shine?

4602.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4602.description: Tapu and Sonu steal the spotlight with their performance, followed by Taarak's heartfelt words on the legendary stardom and grace of the late actor Dharmendra.

4603.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4603.description: Veer and Bansari pull off a prank by writing a cryptic thought for the day and challenging everyone to decode it. Will they be able to figure it out?

4604.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4604.description: On the first day of the new year, Jethalal reaches his shop and finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka asleep outside the godown in an inebriated state. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha explain this situation?

4605.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4605.description: Jethalal's tension spikes when Bawri turns up at the shop on the very first day of the year. Later, the new area head of Topo Mobile visits Gada Electronics with a fresh offer and scheme. How will Jethalal make the most of it?

4606.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4606.description: Jethalal invites all the Gokuldham members to his shop to avail the scheme offered by Topo Mobiles. As everyone promises to arrive on time, will Jethalal end up facing new troubles?

4607.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4607.description: With renewed positivity, Jethalal heads to his shop determined to sell 50 mobile phones within two hours, but the Topo Mobile parcel is yet to arrive. Will Jethalal achieve his target?

4608.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4608.description: It's almost 11 am and the Topo Mobile stock has still not arrived at Gada Electronics. As chaos builds up outside the shop, how will Jethalal and his team manage the Topo Mobile crisis?

4609.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4609.description: Jethalal shares his worries with the Gokuldham residents as customers continue to wait outside the shop. Later, Inspector Pandey arrives looking to buy a Topo Mobile as well. How will Jethalal manage to meet all these demands?

4610.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4610.description: As customers continue to pour in for Topo Mobile and time keeps slipping away, will Jethalal manage to sell 50 mobile phones within two hours?

4611.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4611.description: As everyone begins unboxing their phones, they realise they've been given toy phones instead of real ones. Just as Jethalal celebrates his win, how will the furious customers react?

4612.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4612.description: As the crowd tries to break into Gada Electronics, Jethalal pulls the shutter down to save himself. With Inspector Pandey ready to arrest him, how will Jethalal prove his innocence?

4613.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4613.description: The Gokuldham members chase after a kite and reminisce about their childhood memories of flying kites. Later, Rupa and the kids decide to go to Jaipur for the Patang Utsav. Will they be able to make the trip?

4614.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4614.description: As Rupa decides to go to Jaipur, her maasi brings a rishta for Popatlal, revealing that Babli has set a challenge: she will marry whoever manages to cut her kite. Will Popatlal finally find his bride?

4615.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4615.description: The Gokuldham men are thrilled about Popatlal's trip to Jaipur, yet they doubt whether he will be able to cut Babli's kite. Later, Popatlal brings out his special kite, only for Veer and Bansri to tear it. How will he compete now?

4616.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4616.description: The Gokuldham members explore Jaipur as Popatlal heads out to buy a kite for his big challenge. Meanwhile, the rest of the Gokuldham men eagerly await the day of the contest.

4617.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4617.description: The Gokuldham members enjoy a lively evening in Jaipur. Later, Popatlal gears up for his much awaited challenge with Babli.

4618.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4618.description: As Babli arrives for the challenge, Popatlal steps forward to meet her and the competition begins. Will Popatlal emerge victorious?

4619.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4619.description: As Babli continues to cut everyone's kites, Popatlal waits for 4 pm to enter the competition. Will he manage to cut Babli's kite?

4620.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4620.description: The competition between Babli and Popatlal intensifies as both contestants try to cut each other's kites. Who will win the contest?

4621.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4621.description: Bhide is stopped by Inspector Pandey while returning home. Later, he grows anxious about the arrangements for the Republic Day program.

4622.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4622.description: Sundar travels all the way from the USA and stays back for the Republic Day program. Later, the members prepare enthusiastically for the celebrations.

4623.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4623.description: Bhide takes on the responsibility of anchoring the Republic Day program and shares facts about India through a quiz round. How will the members perform in the game?

4624.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4624.description: The Gokuldham members pick chits and share interesting facts about different states. As the competition heats up, who will win the round?

4625.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4625.description: The competition continues as they keep learning about various states. Who will emerge victorious?

4626.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4626.description: The members continue discussing various states and their key facts. Who will answer correctly within the time limit, and who will face the punishment?

4627.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4627.description: As Popatlal waits for his chance to punish Bhide, Bhide gives the correct answer. Later, all the members come together for a dance to celebrate the country.

4628.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4628.description: Bhide struggles to write the thought for the day as Veer, Bansri, and Sodhi try to help him. Later, a couple arrives at Gada Electronics. Will they make a purchase or land Jethalal in trouble?

4629.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4629.description: Jethalal grows anxious when the email confirming his dealership fails to arrive, even as news of the deal spreads everywhere. Will he be able to finally secure the dealership?

4630.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4630.description: Excitement runs high as Jethalal prepares for a crucial meeting to finalise his authorised dealership. With everyone rooting for him, will he succeed?

4631.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4631.description: Jethalal is on cloud nine as he finally receives the papers confirming his dealership. But with his luck, will the deal go through smoothly or will new hurdles stand in the way?

4632.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4632.description: As Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha celebrate securing the Topo Mobile dealership, Bawri arrives with sweets for them. What will happen once they eat them?

4633.description: Everyone at Gada Electronics struggles to stay awake after eating the laddoos just as customers walk in to shop. Later, they try eating chillies to fight the drowsiness. Will their plan succeed?

4634.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4634.description: Jethalal waits for Babita's friend to arrive and shop while struggling to stay awake. Later, when she finally comes, she spots an alcohol bottle in Jethalal's hands. How will this misunderstanding be resolved?

4635.description: Taarak tries to take leave from work to help Jethalal. Meanwhile, Champaklal wants to go to Gada Electronics to congratulate him. What will happen when he sees Jethalal in that condition?

4636.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4636.description: Anjali and Babita do everything they can to stall Champaklal's visit to Jethalal's shop. Later, Taarak turns to Bhide for help. Will they manage to keep Champaklal from reaching Gada Electronics?

4637.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4637.description: As Taarak struggles to find a rickshaw, Champaklal and Bhide head toward Gada Electronics. In this race against time, can Taarak get there and help Jethalal before Champaklal arrives?

4638.description: Taarak takes a U-turn after receiving a call from his boss, while Bhide does everything he can to delay Champaklal's visit. Later, Taarak turns to Sodhi for help. How will he come to Jethalal's rescue?

4639.description: Taarak reaches the shop and finds Ratan and Sodhi lying there in an inebriated state. Later, Dr Hathi, Popatlal, and Taarak also end up eating the laddoos. What will happen when Champaklal arrives?

4640.description: Champaklal reaches the shop and finds all the men lying there, with an alcohol bottle nearby, making him assume they are drunk. Later, Pankaj, Jethalal's competitor, arrives and tries to take advantage of the situation.

4641.description: Pankaj approaches the police and Sara from Topo Mobile, accusing Jethalal of throwing a party inside his shop. As everyone is found passed out, will Jethalal face consequences?

4642.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4642.description: Bawri rushes into the shop and reveals the truth about the sleep inducing laddoo mix up. Later, Inspector Pandey conducts a breath analyser test. Will they be found guilty?

4643.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah

4644.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4644.description: After the sleeping laddoo incident, the Gokuldham men struggle to fall asleep at night. How will they deal with this new problem?

4645.description: Unable to sleep, the Gokuldham men head out for a late night walk. Soon, they find themselves caught in a misunderstanding with a woman. How will they clear up this fresh confusion?

4646.description: Veer and Bansri gear up with their water guns to attack Ratan and Rupa. Later, Taarak's poem ends up upsetting Anjali. How will he make things right?

4647.description: Ratan introduces Popatlal to Chutki Baba, claiming he can help solve his marriage woes. What will happen when Popatlal finally meets Chutki Baba?

4648.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4648.description: Chutki Baba gives Popatlal a special remedy, promising it will help him find a bride soon. As Holika Dahan draws near, will Popatlal manage to complete the ritual in time?

4649.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4649.description: Popatlal is devastated after losing the ring given to him by Chutki Baba, which he believes will finally lead him to his life partner. Will the Gokuldham members help him recover it?

4650.description: After Popatlal completes his ritual, the Gokuldham members gather to celebrate Holika Dahan with poems, games, and laughter. How will this Holika Dahan turn out for Popatlal?

4651.description: Jethalal and Babita get into a playful Holi challenge where Jethalal must find Babita within an hour while she hides. Will Jethalal win the challenge, or will he have to face Iyer's punishment?

4652.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4652.description: As Holi celebrations begin, Jethalal and Babita kick off their challenge. Will Team Jethalal manage to find Babita and win the game?

4653.description: Team Jethalal spreads out across the colony to search for Babita. As the hunt intensifies, will they manage to find her, or will Jethalal lose the challenge?

4654.description: Team Jethalal intensively searches for Babita across their respective houses, while Iyer helps her stay hidden so she cannot be caught. With time running out, will Babita finally be found?

4655.description: Team Jethalal reaches the clubhouse, convinced that Babita is hiding there. Later, their search leads them to the terrace. Will Team Jethalal finally catch Babita there?

4656.description: With just 12 minutes left, Jethalal instructs his team to search the temple, the garden, and the society entrance. Is he about to lose the challenge, or will he turn the game around and win?

4657.description: Iyer comes up with a very strict punishment for Jethalal, leaving him dejected. Will Iyer soften his stance, or will Jethalal have to bear the consequences?

4659.description: Bhide returns home with the happy news of buying a gold jewellery set for Sonu. Later, they head to the jewellery shop. Will they run into any trouble there?

4663.description: Bhide is taken by the police along with the gold jewellery after the Bhallas are caught. Later, the police and the Bhallas go missing. How will the Bhides deal with this fraud?

4664.description: Bhide and Madhavi are taken to the police station. As they narrate the entire incident to Inspector Pandey, will they be found guilty or innocent?

4665.description: Bhide and Madhavi request Inspector Pandey to help them find the real culprit. Before he can help them, the Gokuldham men enter the police station with the Bhallas and the fake policemen. Will Bhide and Madhavi be found innocent?

4666.description: The Gokuldham men chase the thieves and narrate the entire incident to Inspector Pandey. Later, Bhide and Madhavi get a new gold set for Sonu.

4667.description: Popatlal gets a joke book as a present for Champaklal. Meanwhile, Bhide asks a question to the kids in his tuition class. Will they be able to answer it correctly?

4670.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4670.description: The Gokuldham residents play a quiz on Shri Ram and learn about his great deeds.

4671.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4671.description: The quiz continues with some of the Gokuldham residents answering correctly and others getting it wrong, followed by a group of children singing bhajans in praise of Shri Ram.

4672.description: The Mahila Mandal asks Bhide for the terrace keys, but he denies the request and Popatlal interferes. How will this issue be resolved?

4673.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4673.description: Tapu Sena has taken on the responsibility of cleaning the terrace, making it ready for the Mahila Mandal. Will they finish it in time?

4674.description: Bhide, Madhavi and Popatlal are ready to leave with Sodhi, but a stain on Popatlal's jacket causes a delay. How will this be resolved?

4675.description: While trying to change his clothes in a hurry, Popatlal falls to the ground and gets hurt. How will he make it to the samaroh?

4676.description: Popatlal lashes out at Bhide, making him decide to resign from his post as the society secretary. How will the other Gokuldham residents react to this?

4678.description: The entire society gathers as Bhide is ready to resign. Will the members be able to resolve the conflict between Popatlal and Bhide?

4679.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4679.description: Popatlal firmly puts forth his arguments against Bhide. Will Bhide finally resign from his post as the society secretary?

4680.description: The society members come together to convince Bhide not to resign, while Popatlal finally apologises for his mistake. What decision will Bhide take now?

4681.description: After Jethalal promises to find a contractor for the society's repair work, he struggles to arrange one. Will he be able to live up to his promise?

4682.description: The society members celebrate the completion of the terrace work while other repairs are still pending, and Bhide asks everyone to arrange additional funds.

4683.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4683.description: Jethalal and Taarak get into a conversation about dreams, while Rupa excitedly shows off the new jewellery she has bought.

4684.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah

4685.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4685.description: Ratan begins the preparations for the shop's anniversary celebration, while Rupa gets busy making fresh Mawa Kachori for the special day. How will their anniversary celebration turn out?

4686.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4686.description: Rupa and Ratan get ready to celebrate their shop's anniversary and seek blessings from Champaklal.

4687.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4687.description: The Mahila Mandal of Gokul Dham Society are heading out to shop at Rupa and Ratan's store, gearing up for a fun-filled spree together. What delights will they find?

4688.description: Along with the Mahila Mandal, Popatlal also reaches the saree shop and buys six sarees, as Rupa and Ratan's store creates excitement, with Bavri and Bagha joining the shopping fun.

4689.description: When Rupa realises her family's royal ring is missing, she turns to the Gokuldham members for help in the search. Will they be able to find it?

4690.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4690.description: While the Gokuldham members continue searching for Rupa's royal ring, she realises it must have slipped off while she was preparing kachoris. Will they manage to find it?

4691.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4691.description: Chaos unfolds in Gokuldham when a ring gets stuck in Chacha Ji's stomach and everyone pitches in to help.

4692.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4692.description: Chacha Ji is being taken to the hospital, but Ratan finds the ring at home. What is troubling Chacha Ji's stomach?

4693.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah

4694.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4694.description: Jethalal delays submitting the society repair cheque and asks Bhide for an extension. How will Bhide respond?

4695.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4695.description: Jethalal grows anxious when Bapuji doesn't return from the temple, until a shocking call discloses his whereabouts.

4696.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4696.description: As Gokuldham members search for Bapuji, he returns without his cap and in torn clothes. What could be the reason?

4697.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4697.description: Taarak and Jethalal confront Bapuji about his daring act, insisting he shouldn't take such risks. How will Bapuji respond to their concern?

4698.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4698.description: Bapuji asks Jethalal if he has donated to Ghushal and demands proof. Will Jethalal be able to justify himself?

4699.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4699.description: Bhide grows furious with Jethalal for delaying the society repair cheque and sets out determined to get it.

4700.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4700.description: Bhide informs Bapuji that Jethalal has forgotten to submit the society repair cheque. How will Bapuji react to this?

4701.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4701.description: Jethalal turns to Taarak for help, and Taarak comes up with a plan. Will it succeed?

4702.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4702.description: Taarak's strategy to help Jethalal with the cheque fails, and they must find a new one. What will they do next?

4703.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4703.description: Jethalal tells Bhide the truth and tries to bribe him, while Bapuji overhears. How will things unfold?

4704.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4704.description: Bhide summons the entire Gokuldham society to expose Jethalal's lie. But will he succeed in finding Jethalal's cheque or not?

4705.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4705.description: Bagha and Natu Kaka devise a new plan to rescue Jethalal. Will this strategy turn out in their favor?

4706.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4706.description: As Bagha's plan fails, an agitated Jethalal turns toward an illegal solution to fix his problem. But will Taarak stop him or stand by his side?

4707.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4707.description: With Gafoor bhai's help, Jethalal and Bagha hatch a new plan. Will it work?

4708.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4708.description: Gafoor Bhai helps create the society office key but secretly keeps a spare one for himself. What's his true reason behind holding onto it?

4709.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4709.description: Jethalal calls the entire Gokuldham society together to witness the missing cheque drama. Will this moment clear his name or reveal a hidden lie?

4710.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4710.description: Bhide exposes Jethalal's lie before the entire Gokuldham society. How will Bapuji respond to this revelation?

4711.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4711.description: Bapuji makes Jethalal, Bhide, Taarak, and Popatlal do sit-ups. Later, Jethalal calls Taarak over for an ice cream treat.

4712.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4712.description: Sodhi safely keeps his friend's money at home, but when Roshan unknowingly gives it to someone else, a sudden problem creates tension.

4713.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4713.description: The fruit vendor flees with Roshan's money. Can the Mahila Mandal come up with a plan to recover it?

4714.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4714.description: Sodhi is furious after his worker gives away money without asking, but when the truth about the Mahila Mandal comes out before him, what will he do?

4715.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4715.description: Sodhi's friend says the money cover was already opened while counting it, making Roshan worried. How will she handle the situation?

4716.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4716.description: After being cheated, the Gokuldham members now plan together how to get their money back from the fruit vendor.

4717.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4717.description: Sodhi is ready to attack the fruit vendor in anger. Will the Gokuldham members be able to stop him?

4718.description: Sodhi finds the vendor's house locked and starts to worry, did the fruit vendor run away with the cash?

4719.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4719.description: The entrance Golkuldam is suddenly covered with watermelons, making everyone wonder who they belong to and what will happen next?

4720.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4720.description: Gokuldham society members rush to help Bapuji after a shocking watermelon blockage traps him outside.

4721.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4721.description: While the gate blocked by watermelons, Gokuldham society members desperately search for a fruit buyer.

4722.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4722.description: Bhide contacts Mama with a desperate request, can he find a buyer for the watermelons?

4723.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4723.description: Tapu Sena explains the watermelon mystery, what shocking truth will Gokuldham society members discover?

4724.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4724.description: Tapu Sena reveals the truth, but will Gokuldham society members find a buyer for all those watermelons?

4725.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4725.description: Popatlal is determined to confront Bhide, but an unexpected call to Bapuji changes everything. What happens next?

4726.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4726.description: Taarak sets wrong alarm and oversleeps but can he make it on time after his boss' wake-up call?

4727.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4727.description: Everyone is looking at Taarak's Boss with surprise, but what has he done to grab all the attention?

4728.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4728.description: People are eager to take a photo with Taarak's boss, but what's the reason behind the excitement?

4729.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4729.description: Can Batuk Maharaj help Bhide find the ideal time to begin the society's renovation?

4730.description: A simple ritual takes an unexpected turn in Gokuldham. What has left everyone concerned?

4731.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4731.description: Popatlal is not convinced by the renovation arrangements. Will Bhide be able to justify them?

4732.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4732.description: Bagha and Bawri dream about their future home, and Bagha assures her that he will work tirelessly to make all her wishes come true.

4733.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4733.description: Bagha heads out for a special reason, but will everything go according to plan?

4734.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4734.description: Will Jethalal's unexpected condition test Bawri's patience and her commitment to Bagha?

4735.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4735.description: An unexpected guest drops by Gada Electronics, leaving Bagha puzzled and curious.

4736.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4736.description: Bagha gets a watch as a surprise gift from a visitor, leaving everyone wondering who it might be.

4737.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4737.description: Bagha receives a mysterious invitation from a stranger, but Tapu Sena, Popatlal, and Sodhi accompany him for support. What unexpected twist might lie ahead?

4738.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4738.description: Balam invites Bagha to his house and begins sharing memories from his past. Who exactly is Balam?

4739.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4739.description: A shocking truth from Balam catches Bagha off guard. What impact will it have on their lives?

4740.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4740.description: After meeting Balam, Bagha confides in Natu Kaka before setting out to meet Bawri. Will he tell her the truth?

4741.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4741.description: Bagha lied to the Gokuldham members about Balam's identity because he wanted to hide the truth and avoid questions about his childhood friend.

4742.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4742.description: Balam makes an offer to Bagha, but what decision will Bagha ultimately make?

4743.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4743.description: How far will Bagha go to accomplish Mission BBB?

4744.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4744.description: Will Bagha leave Bawri for his friend, or will he follow his heart and face the consequences?

4745.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4745.description: To stop the wedding, Bagha pretends to be drunk and creates a scene in front of everyone to push Bawri away. How will Bawri react?

4746.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4746.description: Bawri reaches Gokuldham Society and tells the Mahila Mandali about Bagha trying to stop the wedding. Will they support her?

4747.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4747.description: Mahila Mandali visits Gada Electronics to confront Bagha after learning about his attempt to stop the wedding. Will they stand by Bawri and against Bagha?

4748.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4748.description: Bagha asks Tapu to help stop the wedding, so how will Tapu support him now?

4749.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4749.description: Tapu dresses up and joins Bagha in the garden for a drama, but when Mahila Mandali arrives, will they believe she is Bagha's girlfriend or see through their act?

4750.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4750.description: After catching Bagha with another girl in the park, the Mahila Mandali warns him to stay away from Bawri. Unaware that the girl is actually Tapu in disguise, they firmly rebuke Bagha. Will the truth come out?

4751.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4751.description: Gokuldham Society is thrown into absolute chaos after the Mahila Mandali exposes a video of Bagha with a mysterious girl. But when Babuji claims she looks familiar, Tapu's hidden agenda faces sudden exposure.

4752.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4752.description: When Balam arrives at Bagha's house and learns that Bagha pretended everything just to break his relationship with Bawri, what will happen next when the truth starts coming out?

4753.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4753.description: Balam introduces himself as Bawri's childhood friend and expresses his desire to marry her. How will the Gokuldham members react to this shocking revelation?

4754.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4754.description: Heartbroken because of Bagha, Bawri decides to leave Mumbai and return to Kanpur. As the Mahila Mandali rushes to find her, will they be able to stop her and bring her back home?

4755.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4755.description: As Gokuldham residents urge Bawri to marry Balam, she revisits her cherished memories with Bagha. Will she be able to move on?

4756.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4756.description: Will Bawri say yes and get engaged to Balam, or will her heart choose a different path?

4757.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4757.description: As Bawri and Bagha end up in the same hospital, will Balam finally confess that he was the one who separated them?

4758.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4758.description: With Abdul's shop closed, the Purush Mandali heads to Jethalal's house with ice cream, but Tapu and Babuji surprise them with a fun prank.

4759.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4759.description: Jethalal arrives at the shop early, expecting a surprise from Natu Kaka and Bagha, but is left shocked to find the shop sealed. Who is behind it?

4760.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4760.description: As Iyer and Babita Ji bring their friend to the shop, Jethalal is left wondering how to manage the situation with the shop sealed.

4761.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4761.description: Taarak Mehta, Bagha, and Natu Kaka try to find the notice behind the shop sealing, but they discover that no notice was given. What will Jethalal do now?

4762.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4762.description: Even after Jethalal pays the fine, the municipal officials reveal they never sealed his shop. If not them, who put up the seal?

4763.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4763.description: After a customer informs Rita Reporter about Jethalal's sealed shop, she rushes to cover the story, but Natu Kaka and Bagha try to stop her.

4764.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4764.description: Clients are demanding payments, and rumors of Jethalal running away are spreading fast. How will he clear his name now?

4765.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4765.description: After learning that Jethalal's shop has been sealed, Babuji loses his temper and tells him to leave the house. How will Jethalal handle this difficult situation?

4766.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4766.description: Jethalal turns to Inspector Pandey Ji for help. Will he uncover who was really behind sealing Jethalal's shop?

4767.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4767.description: Monika arrives at Gada Electronics, but Pandey Ji says the shop is sealed. How will Jethalal handle the situation, and will Monika still give him the agency?

4768.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4768.description: Pandey Ji informs Jethalal that he is innocent, as the tax was unpaid by another shop owner, and due to a mistake, Gada Electronics was wrongly sealed.

4769.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4769.description: Bhide leaves overnight with his family. The next morning, Popatlal finds their house empty and their phones switched off, leaving the Gokuldham family wondering where the Bhide family has gone.

4770.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4770.description: Bhide stays at his uncle's house due to an unexpected dispute, while Madhvi and Sonu return to Gokuldham. As the renovation work remains pending, everyone in Gokuldham eagerly waits for Bhide to return.

4771.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4771.description: The Mahila Mandal wonders what Bhide is going to say in the meeting, and even Madhvi has no idea. As all the Gokuldham members gather, everyone eagerly waits to see what happens in the meeting.

4772.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4772.description: Everyone in Gokuldham is curious to know who Chachaji will choose for the Muh Dikhayi ceremony.

4773.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4773.description: The members of Gokuldham Society are excited about the Muh Dikhayi ceremony and eager to discover Bhide's surprise. What special surprise has Bhide planned?

4774.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4774.description: Champak Chacha entrusts Veer and Bansari with the honor of performing the Mukh Dikhayi ceremony, declaring that they represent the future of Gokuldham Society.

4775.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4775.description: The renovation work is finally complete, and everyone is happy to see the new Gokuldham Society. But Bhide has one more surprise waiting for everyone.

4776.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4776.description: As Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 18 glorious years, everyone shares their heartfelt thoughts. Just then, Asit Modi announces a special guest, leaving everyone excited to find out who it is.

4777.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4777.description: The residents of Gokuldham Society warmly welcome Spider-Man. His presence fills everyone with joy as he interact with each member.

4778.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4778.description: Gokuldham relives some of the most memorable moments from Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah, bringing back old memories and special emotions.

4779.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4779.description: The Gokuldham men's group praises Bhide for the successful renovation, but he suddenly reveals that a new problem has arisen. What could it be?

4780.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4780.description: After the Purush Mandal praises Bhide for the society's renovation, the Mahila Mandal and Tapu Sena plan a special surprise for him at his house.

4781.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4781.description: Everyone praises Bhide's management, but new renovation charges leave him stressed. Will he protect his promise to society members?

4782.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4782.description: After learning he owes the contractor an extra ₹5 lakh for the society's renovation, Bhide tells Madhavi, who urges him to seek Taarak's help. What will happen next?

4783.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4783.description: A prank on the society's renovation budget leaves Bhide stressed and confused as Gokuldham members enjoy his hilarious reactions.

4784.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4784.description: Jethalal learns that his friend wants Madhavi Bhabhi's pickles. Soon, the Bhide family gets busy preparing and delivering the order.

4785.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4785.description: Bhide heads to the market for lemons and chilies, while Madhavi seeks Roopa’s help. Can the Bhide family complete the order on time?

4786.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4786.description: The Bhide family successfully delivers all pickle orders on time and receives great feedback, leaving Bhide delighted with their achievement.

4787.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4787.description: Madhavi fears a piece of her bangle broke in the pickle. Tapu Sena panics as Bhide faces an FDA raid. Will it be found, or will FDA charges follow?

4788.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4788.description: Madhavi’s pickle licence is at risk, prompting Gokuldham Society members to unite and help the Bhide family overcome the crisis.

4789.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4789.description: A counterfeit of Madhavi's pickle product hits the market, leaving the Bhide family in trouble. Will the FDA uncover the truth?

4790.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4790.description: It's a relief for the Gokuldham society as the truth behind the duplicate pickle unfolds.

4791.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4791.description: Abdul sparks total confusion among Chachaji and the Mahila Mandal after spotting Popatlal carrying a bride in his arms.

4792.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4792.description: Popatlal manifests his future wife with a statue and asks the Purush Mandali to choose a photo to showcase.

4793.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4793.description: The Mahila Mandal helps Popatlal choose a photo and reveals Bhide’s role. Later, Popatlal playfully scares Bhide at the soda shop.

4794.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4794.description: Madhavi’s earrings go missing, followed by Bapuji’s gold chain. The compound springs into action, but can the missing chain be found?

4795.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4795.description: The search for Madhvi’s earrings turns chaotic as Goli discovers money and sweets, but the earrings remain missing and the house becomes a mess!

4796.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4796.description: As another theft shocks Gokuldham, the Purush Mandali gathers to investigate who's behind the incidents.

4797.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4797.description: Jethalal wakes up to find Bapuji’s gold chain missing, while Babita Ji’s gold bracelet also disappears, leaving everyone shocked.

4798.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4798.description: Bhide informs the police about the theft, and Inspector Chalu Pandey arrives soon after to investigate the case and search for clues.

4799.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4799.description: Inspector Chalu Pandey finds the same theft pattern and begins searching for the culprit. Later, Bhide calls a night meeting to plan precautions.

4800.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4800.description: Everyone is worried about the thefts and comes up with different ideas, but Tapu suddenly gets a plan that could change everything.

4801.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4801.description: Everyone gathers for a meeting at the clubhouse, but when Jethalal points out the risk of a theft at home, everyone suddenly rushes back!

4802.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4802.description: During the meeting, Iyer suggests taking turns guarding the society in pairs for an hour each night. Afterward, everyone hurries home to secure their gold in secret hiding spots.

4803.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4803.description: Tapu Sena keeps a close watch on Gokuldham as everyone stays alert for the mysterious thief. Will they finally catch the culprit?

4804.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4804.description: The Purush Mandali asks Tapu Sena to rest and takes over the night watch to catch the thief and stop the thefts in Gokuldham Society. Will they succeed?

4805.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4805.description: Taarak and Jethalal catch a masked man using itching powder and a blanket, but their victory turns awkward when they discover Inspector Chalu Pandey.

4806.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4806.description: After Sodhi leaves his balcony door open to catch the thief, his home and several others are robbed that night. Will the police find the thief?

4807.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4807.description: Gokuldham residents await Chalu Pandey as he arrives with expert officer James to solve the theft mystery. Will they catch the thief?

4808.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4808.description: Chalu Pandey finds the stolen jewellery at Popatlal’s house and arrests him. Will the Gokuldham members prove his innocence?

4809.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4809.description: Purush Mandali backs Popatlal at the police station. As he blames a mannequin for the thefts, will Chalu Pandey believe him?

4810.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4810.description: Chalu Pandey gives Purush Mandali time to prove Popatlal’s innocence and find evidence to get him out of jail.

4811.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4811.description: Purush Mandali discusses what happened at the police station before heading to Popatlal’s house to find evidence and prove his innocence.

4812.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4812.description: Purush Mandali hear a sound from the mannequin and panic as its saree slips off, leaving everyone terrified. What will happen next?

4813.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4813.description: Purush Mandali shares their terrifying experience with Chalu Pandey, who visits Gokuldham Society to uncover the mystery of Popatlal's mannequin.

4814.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4814.description: Jethalal requests Chalu Pandey to come at night, assuring him that he will get proof along with evidence, but will Chalu Pandey make it and uncover the truth behind the mannequin mystery?

4815.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4815.description: Tapusena uncovers a shocking secret about the mysterious doll, leaving everyone stunned. Ratan suggests calling a baba, and Jethalal calls Bagha for help.

4816.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4816.description: Bagha and Bawri visit Gokuldham Society, where Bawri shares a baba’s address. Bhide, Bagha and Iyer reach there, but the dark surroundings and ghost stories scare everyone.

4817.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4817.description: They finally reach Laltan Baba, but chaos erupts when he thinks a ghost is inside Bagha and starts hitting him, leading to an unexpected spectacle.

4818.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4818.description: Bagha, Iyer, and Bhide bring Laltan Baba to Gokuldham. Can he put an end to the ghostly scare?

4819.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4819.description: The residents of Gokuldham remain terrified by the ghost. Lalten Baba arrives with a lantern and rope, hoping his unusual plan will solve the mystery.

4820.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4820.description: Jethalal and Ratan help secure Lalten Baba's trap, while Lalten Baba, Bhide and Iyer head to Popatlal's house to face the ghost.

4821.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4821.description: As Lalten Baba encounters the ghost, panic spreads in Gokuldham. Fear grows when Bhide and Iyer appear in skeleton costumes and a lantern breaks.

4822.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4822.description: Everyone in Gokuldham is frightened by rumors of a ghost and begins to believe Bapuji is possessed, leading to confusion and panic among the residents.

4823.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4823.description: With Chalu Pandey’s ultimatum nearing its end, the search for clues takes an unexpected turn when Popatlal’s mannequin goes missing.

4824.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4824.description: Bhide and Tapu Sena discover that Lalten Baba is a fraud. With no clue left to prove Popatlal's innocence, the Gokuldham members pray to God.

4825.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4825.description: A video recorded by Binjola's kids reveals the truth behind the thefts. Following Bapuji's clues, Gokuldham begins its search.

4826.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4826.description: The Gokuldham members try to catch the cat with the help of Binjola’s kids. Will their plan succeed and help free Popatlal from jail?

4827.title: NEW Episode 4827 - Pandey Got Trapped in Jethalal and Bhide's Web! | Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
4827.description: Tapu Sena and the Purush Mandali reach the police station with evidence to expose the real culprit. Will Popatlal be proven innocent?

4828.title: NEW Episode 4828 - Gokuldham Residents Succeed in Rescuing Popatlal! | Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Cha...
4828.description: Chalu Pandey tracks down the real culprits behind the theft. After they confess, Popatlal is cleared of all charges and proven innocent.

4829.title: NEW Episode 4829 - क्या Popatlal Phir फ़सेगा चोरी के इल्ज़ाम में ! | Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah

4830.title: NEW Episode 4830 - Jethalal is in New Trouble! | Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah

4831.title: NEW Episode 4831 - Tapu Sena's Pranks Cause Trouble for Bhide! | Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
